title: Public Transit Time and Fare Design: Ridership Maximization Under Income Disparity
affiliations: Indiana University - Kelley School of Business and Cornell University

detail.title: Public Transit Time and Fare Design: Ridership Maximization Under Income Disparity
detail.abstract: Amid the prolonged public transit ridership decline, we study how a ridership-maximizing transit agency serving areas spatially segregated by income should set area-specific fares and travel times when facing constraints on operating budget and policy complexity. We develop a bilevel model that captures the interaction between the transit agency's decision and riders' transportation mode choice, which is governed by a micro-founded time-money allocation model that links income to value of time. We compare four policies motivated by contemporary practices in large U.S. transit systems: no differentiation (ND) with uniform fare and time; price differentiation (PD) which only allows fares to differ by income area; time differentiation (TD) where only travel times differ; or full differentiation (FD) that allows both to differ. Our analysis proceeds in three steps. First, we characterize the optimal fares and travel times under each of the four policies and how these decisions vary across income areas. Under FD, we further characterize the optimal incremental budget allocation rule. Second, combined with calibration to Chicago data, we offer practical insights on the ridership loss and distribution change of single-lever policy (TD and PD) relative to FD. Third, we examine how total budget and income disparity level affect the optimal fares, travel times, absolute and incremental budget allocation for each of the four policies. Taken together, our analysis guides when to prioritize price versus time differentiation and how to sequence reforms from ND toward FD via PD or TD, highlighting potential Title VI equity concerns along the trajectory.

AI.tldr: 该研究针对收入空间隔离的公共交通系统，开发了一个双层模型来优化不同收入区域的票价和旅行时间，比较了四种差异化政策，为从统一政策向完全差异化政策的改革路径提供指导。
AI.research_question: 在运营预算和政策复杂性约束下，服务于收入空间隔离区域的公共交通机构应如何设定区域特定的票价和旅行时间以最大化乘客量？
AI.motivation: 公共交通乘客量长期下降，需要研究如何在预算和政策复杂性约束下，针对不同收入区域优化票价和旅行时间设置，以提高整体乘客量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于时间-金钱分配模型的微观基础理论，将收入与时间价值联系起来；双层模型捕捉交通机构决策与乘客交通方式选择之间的互动。
AI.method: 开发双层优化模型，比较四种差异化政策：无差异化(ND)、价格差异化(PD)、时间差异化(TD)、完全差异化(FD)；结合芝加哥数据进行校准分析。
AI.findings: 1) 完全差异化政策下最优票价和旅行时间的特征及增量预算分配规则；2) 单一杠杆政策相对于完全差异化的乘客量损失和分布变化；3) 总预算和收入差异水平对各政策最优决策的影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 建立了考虑收入空间隔离的公共交通优化理论框架；2) 提出了从统一政策向完全差异化政策过渡的改革路径理论；3) 揭示了价格与时间差异化在不同条件下的优先级。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为交通机构提供从无差异化向完全差异化政策过渡的具体改革路径；2) 指导何时优先考虑价格差异化或时间差异化；3) 识别改革过程中潜在的Title VI公平性问题。

title: Moral Philosophy and Archetypes in the Symbolic Cohesion of the Shepherdess’s Tale
affiliations: EDUKIVOTOS and

detail.title: Moral Philosophy and Archetypes in the Symbolic Cohesion of the Shepherdess’s Tale
detail.abstract: This paper analyzes the moralizing value of Rafael Pombo’s tale La Pastorci­ta within the Colombian cultural tradition, interpreting the story as a symbolic device of social regulation. Through an ethical and political reading, the text explores how fear, threat, and the feared figure function as pedagogical mechanisms guiding individual behavior toward the preservation of collective order. By linking excerpts from the tale with the theories of Thomas Hobbes and Niccolò Machiavelli, the study demonstrates how the pedagogy of fear becomes legitimate when oriented toward the common good and social stability. The analysis argues that the tale operates as a modern myth that translates abstract norms into effective narrative images, reinforcing values of obedience, responsibility, and communal cohesion.

AI.tldr: 该论文分析Rafael Pombo的童话《La Pastorci­ta》在哥伦比亚文化传统中的道德教化价值，将其解读为社会规训的象征装置。通过伦理和政治视角，研究探讨恐惧、威胁和恐惧形象如何作为引导个体行为以维护集体秩序的教学机制。结合霍布斯和马基雅维利的理论，论证恐惧教育在导向共同利益和社会稳定时的合法性。分析认为该童话作为现代神话，将抽象规范转化为有效的叙事意象，强化服从、责任和社群凝聚的价值观。
AI.research_question: Rafael Pombo的童话《La Pastorci­ta》在哥伦比亚文化传统中如何通过恐惧的象征机制实现社会规训和道德教化？
AI.motivation: 探索哥伦比亚文化传统中童话作品如何作为社会规训工具，特别是通过恐惧机制来塑造个体行为和维护社会秩序。理解文学文本如何与政治哲学理论相结合，形成有效的道德教育手段。
AI.theoretical_framework: 主要理论框架包括：1）托马斯·霍布斯的政治哲学（社会契约、恐惧作为社会秩序基础）；2）尼科洛·马基雅维利的政治理论（权力、恐惧作为统治工具）；3）符号学理论（文本作为象征装置）；4）教育学理论（恐惧作为教学机制）；5）神话理论（现代神话的社会功能）。
AI.method: 采用文本分析方法，结合伦理和政治解读：1）对《La Pastorci­ta》文本进行细读分析；2）识别文本中的恐惧、威胁和恐惧形象；3）将文本片段与霍布斯和马基雅维利的理论进行对比分析；4）探讨恐惧作为教学机制的运作方式；5）分析文本如何将抽象规范转化为叙事意象。
AI.findings: 研究发现：1）《La Pastorci­ta》中的恐惧机制有效引导个体行为朝向集体秩序；2）恐惧教育在导向共同利益和社会稳定时具有合法性；3）该童话作为现代神话，成功将抽象的社会规范转化为生动的叙事图像；4）文本强化了服从、责任和社群凝聚等核心价值；5）恐惧的象征装置在哥伦比亚文化传统中发挥着持续的社会规训功能。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献：1）拓展了文学文本作为社会规训工具的理论理解；2）建立了童话研究与政治哲学的跨学科联系；3）发展了"恐惧教育学"的理论框架；4）深化了现代神话在社会秩序维护中的功能研究；5）为哥伦比亚文化研究提供了新的分析视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献：1）为教育工作者提供利用文学进行道德教育的参考；2）帮助理解哥伦比亚文化传统中的价值观传递机制；3）为社会规训研究提供具体案例分析；4）为文化政策制定者提供文学社会功能的洞察；5）促进对恐惧作为社会控制工具的批判性认识。

title: Real-Time Micro-Fulfillment Orchestration in Omnichannel Retail Using Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Framework

detail.title: Real-Time Micro-Fulfillment Orchestration in Omnichannel Retail Using Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Framework
detail.abstract: Micro-fulfillment centers (MFCs) have emerged as a response to growing e-commerce demands, yet their integration into omnichannel retail networks creates order routing challenges that traditional optimization struggles to solve efficiently. This paper introduces a multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) framework designed for adaptive order allocation across heterogeneous fulfillment nodes: MFCs, dark stores, and conventional distribution centers. Built on a Centralized Training with Decentralized Execution (CTDE) architecture, the framework allows individual agents to make rapid local decisions while preserving coordination at the network level. Computational experiments indicate a 23% reduction in fulfillment time, 18% lower per-order costs, and SLA compliance reaching 94.2% versus 91.2% for the strongest baseline. Performance remains stable across different network sizes and under varying demand conditions. These results suggest that decentralized AI approaches can effectively handle the dynamic nature of modern retail fulfillment.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个基于多智能体强化学习（MARL）的框架，用于解决全渠道零售网络中微履约中心（MFCs）的订单路由问题，通过集中训练分散执行（CTDE）架构实现自适应订单分配，相比基线方法显著提升了履约效率。
AI.research_question: 如何在全渠道零售网络中（包含微履约中心、暗店和传统配送中心）实现高效、自适应的订单分配和路由优化？
AI.motivation: 随着电子商务需求增长，微履约中心（MFCs）的出现带来了新的订单路由挑战，传统优化方法难以高效解决异构履约节点间的动态协调问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于多智能体强化学习（MARL）理论，采用集中训练分散执行（CTDE）架构，结合强化学习算法处理动态决策问题。
AI.method: 构建MARL框架，让每个履约节点作为智能体进行本地决策，通过集中训练实现网络级协调，进行计算实验验证框架效果。
AI.findings: 相比最强基线，该框架实现履约时间减少23%，单订单成本降低18%，SLA合规率达到94.2%（基线为91.2%），在不同网络规模和需求条件下保持稳定性能。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于MARL的自适应订单分配理论框架，证明了分散式AI方法能够有效处理现代零售履约的动态特性，为异构网络协调提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为零售商提供了可实施的智能订单路由解决方案，能够显著提升履约效率、降低成本并提高服务水平协议合规率，具有实际应用价值。

detail.title: Moral Philosophy and Archetypes in the Symbolic Cohesion of the Tale of Juan Matachin

publicationDetails.detailsText: Social Sciences Observatory and human resources in Ibagué | Edukivotos. Ibagué, Colombia 2026

detail.abstract: This paper examines the moralizing value of Rafael Pombo’s tale Juan Matachín within the Colombian cultural context, interpreting it as a narrative device for ethical and social regulation. Through an interdisciplinary approach combining literary analysis, moral philosophy, and political theory, the study explores the figure of the “anti-villain” as an ambivalent agent who, through fear, seeks to preserve the common good, social order, and harmony with nature. Drawing on Hobbes’s and Machiavelli’s reflections on fear as a foundation of order, the analysis shows how symbolic terror operates pedagogically to deter harmful behavior and reinforce communal norms. The tale is thus understood as more than children’s literature, functioning as a cultural archive that embeds collective values, mechanisms of social control, and an implicit ethic of ecological protection and community cohesion in the Colombian imaginary.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析Rafael Pombo的童话《Juan Matachín》在哥伦比亚文化背景下的道德教化价值，将其解读为一种伦理和社会规训的叙事装置。通过跨学科方法，探讨了"反恶棍"这一矛盾角色如何通过恐惧来维护共同利益、社会秩序和与自然的和谐。
AI.research_question: Rafael Pombo的童话《Juan Matachín》如何在哥伦比亚文化语境中作为伦理和社会规训的叙事装置运作？
AI.motivation: 探讨儿童文学如何超越单纯的娱乐功能，在特定文化语境中作为承载集体价值观、社会控制机制和生态保护伦理的文化档案发挥作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合霍布斯和马基雅维利关于恐惧作为秩序基础的理论，分析象征性恐怖如何发挥教育功能；运用道德哲学和政治理论框架解读文学文本的社会规训功能。
AI.method: 采用跨学科方法，结合文学分析、道德哲学和政治理论，对文本进行深度解读，探讨其作为文化档案的社会功能。
AI.findings: 《Juan Matachín》中的"反恶棍"角色通过制造恐惧来维护社会秩序和共同利益；象征性恐怖在故事中发挥教育作用，阻止有害行为并强化社区规范；该童话是哥伦比亚文化想象中嵌入集体价值观、社会控制机制和生态保护伦理的重要载体。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了文学作为社会规训装置的理论理解；深化了对"反恶棍"这一矛盾角色在道德教化中作用的认识；扩展了恐惧理论在文化分析中的应用，特别是象征性恐怖的教育功能。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解哥伦比亚文化中的价值观传承机制提供新视角；为教育工作者提供利用文学进行道德教育的理论依据；为文化政策制定者认识儿童文学的社会功能提供参考。

title: Media As Translator: Deconstructing Ophelia in the Era of Taylor Swift
affiliations: Guruvayurappan College

detail.title: Media As Translator: Deconstructing Ophelia in the Era of Taylor Swift
detail.abstract: This paper examines the significant role of media as a translator of meaning, focusing on how classical literary texts and figures are reinterpreted within the digital culture, enabling the translation of experience into new forms. It meditates on how the media participation, like interactive media and music video, critically interpreted and received the work. And how the representation of female agency and identity has changed today. Using Shakespeare’s Ophelia from the 17th century and the popular pop persona of Taylor Swift from the 21st century as a comparative framework. This research examines how Modern Digital media, through music videos, social platforms, and interactive media, reshape and subvert traditional narratives, such as patriarchy, into contemporary discourses of female agency and identity. By analyzing the tragic Portrayal of Ophelia in Hamlet and contrasting it with Taylor Swift’s self-represented narrative of recovery, empowerment, resistance, and self-authorship, the research paper enlightens how the subjectivity of female experience transforms under media. This is woven to the notion of Marshall McLuhan’s ₋ media as an extension of human perception, permitting translation of experience into new forms. This interdisciplinary inquiry reveals how traditional conservative literary texts are renegotiated and reconstructed into a cultural framework. This flips the gender dynamics and presents a reclamation of voice through participatory media. This analysis proclaims the urgency and necessity of understanding media not as a static document but as a performative and informative agent with political stakes in narrative representation.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨媒体作为意义翻译者的重要角色，分析古典文学文本和人物如何在数字文化中被重新诠释，将经验转化为新形式。通过比较莎士比亚的奥菲莉亚和泰勒·斯威夫特的流行形象，研究现代数字媒体如何重塑和颠覆传统叙事，促进女性主体性和身份的重构。
AI.research_question: 现代数字媒体如何通过音乐视频、社交平台和互动媒体重新诠释和颠覆传统文学叙事，特别是关于父权制的叙事，并将其转化为当代女性主体性和身份的话语？
AI.motivation: 传统文学文本在数字时代的重新诠释具有重要意义，特别是女性角色和身份在媒体中的表现方式发生了根本变化。需要理解媒体不仅是静态文档，而是具有政治意义的表演性和信息性媒介，能够翻转性别动态并重新获得话语权。
AI.theoretical_framework: 主要理论框架包括马歇尔·麦克卢汉的"媒体作为人类感知的延伸"理论，以及媒体作为经验翻译者的概念。同时涉及女性主义媒体研究和叙事重构理论。
AI.method: 采用比较分析方法，以17世纪莎士比亚《哈姆雷特》中的奥菲莉亚和21世纪流行歌手泰勒·斯威夫特作为比较框架，分析音乐视频、社交平台和互动媒体中的叙事重构。
AI.findings: 研究发现数字媒体能够将传统保守的文学文本重新协商和重建到文化框架中，翻转性别动态，通过参与式媒体重新获得话语权。奥菲莉亚的悲剧性描绘与泰勒·斯威夫特的自我叙事（恢复、赋权、抵抗和自我创作）形成鲜明对比，展示了女性经验主体性在媒体影响下的转变。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献包括：1）扩展了麦克卢汉媒体理论在数字文化中的应用；2）发展了媒体作为意义翻译者的概念；3）为女性主义媒体研究提供了新的分析框架；4）提出了媒体作为表演性和信息性媒介的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献包括：1）揭示了参与式媒体在重构性别叙事中的力量；2）为文化生产者提供了重新诠释传统文本的方法；3）强调了理解媒体政治意义的重要性；4）展示了数字媒体如何促进女性主体性的表达和身份建构。

detail.abstract: This study examines the moralizing value of Rafael Pombo’s tale Juaco el Ballenero as a literary myth that articulates fear, transgression, and punishment in the construction of social order within the Colombian context. From an ethical-philosophical and sociological perspective, the analysis explores the figure of the anti-villain as a feared agent who, through morally ambiguous actions, seeks to protect the common good and communal balance. The discussion engages with Hobbes’s and Machiavelli’s theories of fear as a foundation of social order, as well as Kantian deontological ethics and Durkheimian moral sociology, revealing how the tale operates as a symbolic pedagogy that legitimizes norms, reinforces social cohesion, and regulates the relationship between community, nature, and authority.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了Rafael Pombo的童话《Juaco el Ballenero》作为文学神话的道德教化价值，探讨了反恶棍角色如何通过道德模糊的行为保护共同利益，以及恐惧、越轨和惩罚在哥伦比亚社会秩序建构中的作用。
AI.research_question: Rafael Pombo的童话《Juaco el Ballenero》作为文学神话如何通过恐惧、越轨和惩罚的叙事来建构哥伦比亚的社会秩序？
AI.motivation: 探讨文学文本如何作为社会秩序建构的工具，特别是在哥伦比亚语境下，理解文学神话如何通过道德教化来塑造社会规范、强化社会凝聚力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合霍布斯和马基雅维利的恐惧理论（作为社会秩序基础）、康德义务论伦理学、涂尔干道德社会学，构建伦理-哲学和社会学的分析框架。
AI.method: 采用伦理-哲学和社会学视角的文本分析，将童话作为文学神话进行符号学解读，探讨其道德教化功能和社会秩序建构机制。
AI.findings: 该童话作为象征性教育学，通过反恶棍角色的道德模糊行为，合法化社会规范，强化社会凝聚力，调节社区、自然和权威之间的关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了文学神话在社会秩序建构中的理论理解，整合了政治哲学、伦理学和社会学的跨学科视角，深化了对恐惧作为社会秩序机制的认识。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解哥伦比亚社会秩序的文化建构提供文学视角，为教育实践中的道德教化提供参考，为文学文本的社会功能分析提供方法论启示。

title: Machiavellian Marketing vs Empathy-Based Marketing: A Comparative Analysis for Influence in Modern Economies

detail.title: Machiavellian Marketing vs Empathy-Based Marketing: A Comparative Analysis for Influence in Modern Economies
detail.abstract:
Empathy based marketing has emerged as a dominant ethical framework in contemporary marketing discourse, emphasizing authenticity, trust, and emotional alignment between brands and consumers. This paper argues that such approaches reflect a legacy persuasion model increasingly misaligned with algorithmically mediated markets. In environments defined by attention scarcity, platform gatekeeping, and information asymmetry, influence operates less through mutual trust and more through control of perception. 

This study introduces Machiavellian Marketing as a post persuasion framework oriented toward perception engineering, narrative dominance, and strategic inevitability. Drawing on behavioral psychology, sociological theory, and observable platform dynamics, the paper contrasts empathy based marketing's moral assumptions with the structural realities of algorithmic influence. The analysis demonstrates that modern markets systematically reward psychological legibility and narrative control over ethical intent alone. Machiavellian Marketing is therefore positioned not as a rejection of human psychology, but as a pragmatic response to how influence functions under algorithmic conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"马基雅维利式营销"作为后说服框架，认为在算法主导的市场中，影响力更多通过感知工程和叙事控制实现，而非传统的共情营销所依赖的信任和道德意图。
AI.research_question: 在算法中介的市场环境中，共情营销的道德框架是否仍然有效？如何构建适应注意力稀缺、平台把关和信息不对称环境的新型营销框架？
AI.motivation: 共情营销作为当代营销话语中的主导伦理框架，强调品牌与消费者之间的真实性、信任和情感一致性。然而，这种基于传统说服模型的框架与算法中介的市场现实日益脱节，无法有效应对注意力稀缺、平台把关和信息不对称等结构性挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为心理学、社会学理论、平台动态分析；对比共情营销的道德假设与算法影响力的结构现实；马基雅维利主义在当代营销语境下的重新诠释。
AI.method: 理论分析框架，结合行为心理学原理、社会学理论和可观察的平台动态，对比分析共情营销与马基雅维利式营销在算法环境下的有效性。
AI.findings: 现代市场系统性地奖励心理可读性和叙事控制，而非单纯的道德意图；在算法条件下，影响力更多通过感知控制而非相互信任实现；马基雅维利式营销是对算法环境下影响力运作机制的务实回应。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"马基雅维利式营销"作为后说服理论框架；挑战共情营销的道德主导地位；建立算法中介市场中影响力运作的新理论模型；重新定义营销伦理在数字环境中的适用性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为营销从业者提供适应算法环境的实用框架；指导品牌在注意力稀缺环境中有效运作；帮助企业理解平台动态下的影响力机制；提供感知工程和叙事控制的实践策略。

title: The Lever-Based GTM Model: A Structural Analysis of Vendor–Partner–Customer Relationships in SaaS

detail.title: The Lever-Based GTM Model: A Structural Analysis of Vendor–Partner–Customer Relationships in SaaS

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests that could have influenced the research presented in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, patient data, or personal information, and therefore did not require ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Partner alliances have become an increasingly important go-to-market (GTM) strategy in the SaaS industry as vendors seek scalable alternatives to direct sales. Despite this trend, only a limited number of firms succeed in achieving sustained partner-led growth, while many struggle with partner disengagement, declining activity, or the eventual abandonment of partner programs. These failures are commonly attributed to execution-related factors such as insufficient partner capability, lack of motivation, or market-specific constraints. This paper argues that such explanations address symptoms rather than root causes. It proposes that the effectiveness of partner alliances is primarily determined by how the triadic relationship among Vendor, Partner, and Customer is structurally designed. This study introduces the Lever-Based GTM Model, which applies the principle of leverage from classical mechanics to analyze go-to-market systems. Within this framework, the Vendor is conceptualized as the point of force, the Partner as the fulcrum, and the Customer as the point of action. The model analyzes three dominant GTM approaches-Sales-Led Growth (SLG), Product-Led Growth (PLG), and OEM/Implementation-along two structural dimensions: Relational Distance and Force Direction. The central contribution of this paper is a structural explanation of recurring failures in partner-led growth, reframing them as predictable outcomes of relational misalignment rather than execution deficiencies. By shifting the analytical focus from tactics and incentives to structural configuration, this framework offers a unified lens for understanding why similar partner strategies produce divergent outcomes. The paper further applies the model to patterns observed in the Japanese SaaS market, suggesting that many challenges attributed to cultural factors instead reflect gaps in shared structural understanding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出杠杆式GTM模型，将SaaS合作伙伴联盟中的厂商、合作伙伴和客户关系类比为力学杠杆系统，认为合作伙伴增长失败的根本原因不是执行问题，而是三方关系的结构性错配。
AI.research_question: 为什么许多SaaS公司的合作伙伴联盟策略失败，而少数公司能实现持续增长？合作伙伴增长失败的根本原因是什么？
AI.motivation: SaaS行业越来越依赖合作伙伴联盟作为市场进入策略，但大多数公司面临合作伙伴参与度下降、活动减少或最终放弃合作项目的问题。现有解释多归因于执行层面的因素，但本文认为这些只是表象而非根本原因。
AI.theoretical_framework: 杠杆式GTM模型，借鉴经典力学中的杠杆原理，将厂商视为施力点、合作伙伴作为支点、客户作为作用点，分析三方关系的结构性设计。
AI.method: 理论框架构建，分析三种主要GTM方法（销售驱动增长、产品驱动增长、OEM/实施）在两个结构维度（关系距离和力方向）上的差异。
AI.findings: 合作伙伴增长失败的根本原因是三方关系的结构性错配，而非执行缺陷。相似的合作策略产生不同结果，是因为关系结构配置的差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）将杠杆原理应用于GTM系统分析；2）提供结构性解释框架，将合作伙伴失败重新定义为关系错配的可预测结果；3）将分析焦点从战术激励转向结构配置。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为SaaS公司设计合作伙伴联盟提供结构性指导；2）帮助理解日本SaaS市场中归因于文化因素的挑战实际上反映了共享结构理解的缺失；3）提供统一的分析框架解释相似策略的不同结果。

title: The Influence of National Identity on Consumer Preferences Between Local and Global Skincare Brand

detail.title: The Influence of National Identity on Consumer Preferences Between Local and Global Skincare Brand
detail.abstract: This study assesses the influence of national identity on consumer preferences between local and global skincare brands among residents of Valenzuela City, Philippines, in response to globalization challenges and the push for consumer nationalism in the beauty sector. Although skincare consumer behavior has been widely studied globally, limited focus has examined how national identity through marketing mix elements influence preference between local and global brands in the Philippine market. To address this gap, the study explored demographic profiles, national identity's extent of influence via the 4Ps (product, price, place, promotion), identify consumer preference through (personal identity, social identity, social categorization, distinct social group), and their relationships. Employing a quantitative correlational design, researchers surveyed 200 purposively selected respondents aged 18 and above using a structured four-point Likert-scale questionnaire, analyzed through frequencies, weighted means, and Pearson correlations. Findings indicated moderate to strong positive influences and significant relationships across variables, rejecting the null hypothesis, with promotion and place as primary drivers local brands excelling in cultural pride and affordability, global ones in innovation and prestige. Grounded in Social Identity Theory, the study concludes that national identity enhances local appeal yet demands targeted strategies for market gains, providing guidance for brands, and future research on sustained dynamics in the Philippine skincare industry.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨菲律宾Valenzuela市居民的国家认同如何通过营销组合4Ps影响其对本土与全球护肤品牌的偏好，发现国家认同对本土品牌偏好有中等至强烈的正向影响，其中促销和渠道是主要驱动因素。
AI.research_question: 国家认同如何通过营销组合元素（产品、价格、渠道、促销）影响菲律宾消费者对本土与全球护肤品牌的偏好？
AI.motivation: 全球化挑战下，美容行业推动消费者民族主义，但菲律宾市场缺乏关于国家认同如何通过营销组合影响本土与全球品牌偏好的研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于社会认同理论，探讨个人认同、社会认同、社会分类和独特社会群体等维度对消费者偏好的影响。
AI.method: 采用定量相关设计，对200名18岁及以上受访者进行目的性抽样调查，使用四点李克特量表问卷，通过频率、加权均值和皮尔逊相关分析数据。
AI.findings: 研究发现变量间存在中等至强烈的正向影响和显著关系，拒绝零假设；促销和渠道是主要驱动因素；本土品牌在文化自豪感和价格可负担性方面表现优异，全球品牌在创新和声望方面更胜一筹。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了社会认同理论在菲律宾护肤市场的适用性，揭示了国家认同通过营销组合影响品牌偏好的具体机制，为消费者民族主义研究提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为本土品牌提供基于文化自豪感和价格优势的市场策略建议，为全球品牌提供创新和声望定位指导，为菲律宾护肤行业的可持续发展提供实践参考。

title: Enhancing the Wisdom of AI-Assisted Crowds: Theory and Experimental Evidence
affiliations: Indiana University - Kelley School of Business - Department of Operation & Decision Technologies,  and INSEAD - Technology and Operations Management

detail.title: Enhancing the Wisdom of AI-Assisted Crowds: Theory and Experimental Evidence
detail.abstract: Accurate forecasts are critical for financial and business decision making. Such forecasts may be generated by human experts or by artificial intelligence (AI) technologies. A decision maker can benefit from the distinct advantages that each source may offer by providing AI assistance to the experts, allowing them to augment the information contained in the AI forecast by incorporating their own knowledge about the variable of interest. When multiple experts are available, accuracy can be further improved by utilizing the wisdom of crowds, forming a consensus by averaging each of their AI-assisted forecasts. However, the potential accuracy of a crowd of AI-assisted forecasters may be limited by two structural features. First, because the AI assistance is valuable to each expert at an individual level, the opinion of the AI can end up being overrepresented in the crowd's consensus. Second, the experts may fail to appropriately utilize the AI assistance when forming their forecasts, either under-or overemphasizing the information it provides. Using a stylized Bayesian model of information aggregation, we develop a procedure that can recover the most accurate consensus forecast given all information collectively observed by the AI technology and every expert in the crowd. This procedure works by pivoting the average AI-assisted forecast either toward or away from the crowd's average initial forecast. We test the performance of the proposed aggregation method in three laboratory experiments and find that it provides superior accuracy than the unassisted crowd of forecasters, the AI technology on its own, and the AI-assisted crowd.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种新的聚合方法，通过调整AI辅助预测与专家初始预测的权重，解决AI在群体预测中被过度代表的问题，从而获得更准确的共识预测。
AI.research_question: 如何有效整合AI辅助预测和专家知识，克服AI在群体预测中被过度代表的问题，从而获得最优的共识预测？
AI.motivation: 准确的预测对金融和商业决策至关重要。虽然AI辅助专家预测可以结合两者的优势，但在群体预测中AI的观点可能被过度代表，且专家可能无法恰当利用AI辅助信息，限制了预测准确性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于贝叶斯信息聚合模型，构建了一个理论框架来分析AI辅助预测中的信息整合问题，特别关注AI信息在群体中的过度代表现象。
AI.method: 开发了一种新的聚合程序，通过调整AI辅助预测与专家初始预测的权重（向或远离群体平均初始预测调整），然后通过三个实验室实验验证该方法的性能。
AI.findings: 提出的聚合方法在准确性上优于：1) 无AI辅助的专家群体；2) 单独的AI技术；3) 简单的AI辅助群体预测。该方法能有效恢复所有信息源（AI和所有专家）共同观察到的信息。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 理论化了AI辅助预测中信息聚合的挑战；2) 提出了解决AI过度代表问题的理论模型；3) 发展了最优共识预测的恢复程序。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为组织提供了改进预测准确性的实用方法；2) 指导如何有效整合AI和专家知识；3) 提供了可操作的预测聚合技术，适用于金融和商业决策场景。

reference: Harvard Negotiation Law Review, Vol. 30, No. 1, pp. 1-51, 2025; Texas A&M University School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper
title: Lawyers' Client-Inclusive Negotiations: The "New Mediation"?
affiliations: Texas A&M University School of Law and University of California, Davis - School of Law, University of California, Davis - School of Law

detail.title: Lawyers' Client-Inclusive Negotiations: The "New Mediation"?

publicationDetails.detailsText: Harvard Negotiation Law Review, Vol. 30, No. 1, pp. 1-51, 2025
Texas A&M University School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper
publicationDetails.journalName: Texas A&M University School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: When proponents initially urged the courts to institutionalize mediation for the resolution of general civil cases, they argued that the procedure would be superior to trial—and also to lawyers’ settlement negotiations—in terms of parties’ exercise of self-determination, satisfaction with outcomes, and opportunity for voice. These claims, however, rested on certain assumptions, particularly regarding the implementation of mediation and lawyers’ settlement negotiations. In mediation, the parties were to take center stage, with the mediator assisting them by facilitating their communication and negotiation so that they could reach a customized resolution. Lawyers’ settlement negotiations in general civil litigation, meanwhile, were assumed to be lawyeronly affairs that excluded the clients. Since then, scholars and other observers have often written about how much mediation has evolved. In the contemporary legal landscape, one of the models used frequently in the courts (and by private providers as well) is an evaluative, lawyer-and-caucus-dominated procedure. The evolution of lawyers’ practice in settlement negotiations has not received commensurate attention. Data has begun to suggest, however, that a substantial percentage of these negotiations may include the clients. We propose that this “client-inclusive” approach to lawyers’ settlement negotiations might outperform—or at least match the performance of—the lawyer-dominated evaluative model of mediation, using many of the same criteria initially used to promote mediation. Paradoxically, just as arbitration has evolved into the “new litigation” and mediation has become the “new arbitration,” lawyers’ client-inclusive negotiations could represent the “new mediation.” If this is so, courts should also evolve by considering the use of “client-inclusive” negotiations to satisfy judicial orders to participate in mediation and law schools should prepare students to competently implement this procedure.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了律师主导的评估式调解与客户参与式谈判的对比，认为后者可能比前者更能实现当事人自决、满意度和表达机会等目标，建议法院和法学院应重视客户参与式谈判。
AI.research_question: 客户参与式律师谈判是否比律师主导的评估式调解更能实现当事人自决、满意度和表达机会等目标？
AI.motivation: 调解最初被推广时承诺能提供优于审判和律师谈判的当事人自决、满意度和表达机会，但现实中调解已演变为律师主导的评估式程序，而律师谈判却可能包含了更多客户参与，这种变化需要重新评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于替代性纠纷解决（ADR）理论、当事人自决理论、程序正义理论，以及调解与谈判的演变理论。
AI.method: 理论分析和文献综述，结合现有数据观察律师谈判中客户参与的趋势。
AI.findings: 客户参与式律师谈判可能在实现当事人自决、满意度和表达机会等方面优于或至少等同于律师主导的评估式调解。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了ADR演变的新理论框架：仲裁演变为"新诉讼"，调解演变为"新仲裁"，而客户参与式谈判可能成为"新调解"。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议法院考虑将客户参与式谈判作为调解的替代方案，法学院应培养学生掌握这一程序，以更好地满足司法需求。

title: The Paradox of Governance Calibration at Machine Speed: Why Human Intervention Cannot Meet the Decision Moment

detail.title: The Paradox of Governance Calibration at Machine Speed: Why Human Intervention Cannot Meet the Decision Moment

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this research, as it did not involve human participants, personal data, or experimental procedures.
declarations.funderStatement: The author declares no financial or non-financial conflicts of interest related to this research.

detail.abstract:
Organizations across sectors are under growing pressure to deploy artificial intelligence rapidly while governing its use rigorously and remaining accountable for outcomes. Over the past several years, AI governance has evolved in material ways. What began as largely retrospective oversight—policy review, documentation, and periodic audit—has moved toward operational observability. Many organizations now operate with near-continuous visibility into live AI systems, supported by sandboxes, controlled pilots, detailed logging, and post-incident reconstruction.

These advances are not cosmetic. They have improved transparency, reduced certain classes of risk, and made accountability more concrete. Governance today is closer to execution than at any previous point.

Yet as governance has moved closer, a persistent unease has emerged.

Across an increasing number of operational domains, AI systems now make decisions at machine speed—optimizing, adapting, and acting in milliseconds within delegated bounds. In these environments, governance mechanisms continue to operate on human timescales. Even where systems are observable in near-real time, intervention typically requires confirmation, escalation, and authorization. By the time these processes complete, decisions have already executed—often repeatedly and at scale.

This paper argues that the resulting tension is not a failure of governance, intent, or competence. It is a structural timing constraint. Governance happens in time, and AI decisions increasingly occur outside the window in which human intervention can reliably act.

The distinction between oversight and control is therefore central. Oversight enables organizations to observe system behavior, assess outcomes, and respond after execution. Control requires the ability to interrupt or redirect decisions before consequences unfold. As decision speed accelerates, these two functions diverge. Visibility improves, but control arrives only after the decision moment has passed.

This divergence reshapes accountability. In machine-speed systems, responsibility increasingly attaches upstream—away from individual decisions and toward the conditions under which decisions are allowed to occur. Accountability is exercised through design choices, constraints, and pre-commitments made before deployment, and through rigorous reconstruction after the fact. While these mechanisms can limit damage and support learning, they do not restore decision moment control.

The paper examines why proposals for real-time or continuous governance struggle in practice, including constraints related to authority, accountability ambiguity, scale, and system distortion. It then documents governance adaptations that do scale under these conditions, including constraint-based decision governors, explicit autonomy scoping, pre-commitment architectures, and replay-based accountability. These approaches acknowledge irreversibility as a governance condition rather than treating it as a failure.

The implications extend beyond any single organization or regulatory regime. As AI systems become more deeply embedded in operational decision flows, the challenge of governance shifts from intervention to calibration. The central question is no longer who is responsible in the moment, but when responsibility can still act.

Understanding this timing constraint is essential for regulators, boards, and leaders seeking credible governance in an era of machine-speed decision-making—without promising control that cannot be exercised in practice.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了AI治理面临的结构性时间约束问题：随着AI系统以机器速度做出决策，传统基于人类时间尺度的治理机制无法在决策时刻进行有效干预，导致监督与控制功能分离，责任向上游转移。
AI.research_question: 在AI系统以机器速度做出决策的背景下，治理机制如何应对结构性时间约束，实现有效的监督与控制？
AI.motivation: 组织面临快速部署AI与严格治理的双重压力，虽然AI治理已从回顾性监督发展到操作可观测性，但当AI以毫秒级速度决策时，人类时间尺度的治理机制无法在决策时刻进行干预，形成结构性时间约束。
AI.theoretical_framework: 监督与控制的区分理论、时间约束理论、责任上游转移理论、不可逆性作为治理条件而非失败的理论。
AI.method: 概念分析与理论构建，通过分析AI治理实践中的时间约束问题，提出适应性治理框架。
AI.findings: 1. 监督与控制功能在高速决策环境中分离；2. 责任向上游转移至设计选择和约束条件；3. 实时治理在实践中面临权威、责任模糊、规模和系统扭曲等约束；4. 适应性治理机制包括约束型决策治理器、明确自治范围、预承诺架构和回放式问责。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出AI治理的结构性时间约束理论；2. 区分监督与控制在高速决策环境中的不同功能；3. 建立责任上游转移的理论框架；4. 将不可逆性重新定义为治理条件而非失败。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为组织提供可扩展的治理适应方案；2. 帮助监管者、董事会和领导者理解时间约束的现实；3. 提供具体治理工具如约束型决策治理器和预承诺架构；4. 避免承诺实践中无法实现的实时控制。

title: Dying Declaration as an Evidence

detail.title: Dying Declaration as an Evidence

keywords: Who Are not Considered as a Witness

detail.abstract: This paper examines the admissibility and evidentiary value of statements made by persons who are dead or otherwise unavailable as witnesses under Section 32 & related provisions of the Indian Evidence Act, 1872 and the corresponding provisions of the Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023. It situates these exceptions within the general rule favouring direct oral evidence given on oath and subjected to cross-examination, and explains why, in limited situations the law nevertheless accepts hearsay as relevant and reliable. The discussion begins with the legal status of dead persons and the jurisdictional basis for recognising their intentions and statements even after the extinction of legal personality. It then analyses the requirements for invoking Section 32, including death, absence, incapacity, or unreasonable expense or delay in securing attendance, and emphasises the need to first prove these foundational facts. The core of the paper is a doctrinal and case-law based analysis of the specific categories of statements covered: dying declarations relating to the cause of death or the circumstances of the transaction; statements made in the ordinary course of business; declarations against pecuniary or proprietary interest; opinions on public rights, customs or matters of general interest; declarations as to relationship; and documents relating to transactions relevant to custom or right. The paper further addresses statements expressing collective feelings relevant to a matter in issue and explains the conditions under which former testimony becomes relevant in subsequent proceedings under section 33. Through leading English and Indian decisions, it evaluates when dying declarations are treated as complete, how courts assess their liability, and how far such statements alone can sustain conviction in criminal trials.

AI.tldr: 该论文分析了印度《1872年证据法》第32条及相关条款以及《2023年巴拉蒂亚·萨克希亚·阿迪尼亚姆》相应条款中关于死者或其他无法作证者陈述的可采性和证据价值。论文将这些例外置于支持宣誓直接口头证据并接受交叉询问的一般规则背景下，解释了法律在有限情况下仍接受传闻证据作为相关和可靠证据的原因。
AI.research_question: 在印度证据法体系下，死者或其他无法作证者的陈述在何种条件下具有可采性和证据价值？这些例外规定如何与支持直接口头证据的一般规则相协调？
AI.motivation: 在司法实践中，当关键证人死亡或无法出庭时，其先前陈述的证据价值问题具有重要实践意义。需要明确法律在坚持直接证据原则的同时，为何以及如何在特定情况下接受传闻证据，以确保司法公正和效率。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于印度《1872年证据法》第32条及相关条款的法理分析，结合《2023年巴拉蒂亚·萨克希亚·阿迪尼亚姆》的相应规定，运用法律解释学方法，分析传闻证据例外的理论基础。
AI.method: 采用教义分析和判例研究相结合的方法，系统分析第32条涵盖的具体陈述类别，包括临终陈述、日常业务陈述、财产利益声明、公共权利意见、亲属关系声明等，并通过英国和印度的主要判例评估其证据价值。
AI.findings: 论文明确了援引第32条的前提条件（死亡、缺席、无能力、不合理费用或延误），分析了各类陈述的可采性标准，特别指出临终陈述在特定条件下可单独支持刑事定罪，但需谨慎评估其可靠性。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统梳理了死者陈述证据例外的法理基础，解释了法律人格消灭后仍承认其意图和陈述的管辖权依据，为传闻证据例外规则提供了理论支撑。
AI.practical_contributions: 为司法实践提供了明确的操作指南，包括如何证明基础事实、评估各类陈述的证据价值、判断临终陈述的完整性标准等，有助于统一裁判尺度，提高司法效率。

detail.abstract: In the course of their professional activities, specialists continuously expand their knowledge and skills, thereby increasing their personal potential. Often, the professional education acquired at the beginning of a career remains the only basis for further independent improvement of knowledge.

AI.tldr: 专业人员通过持续学习和技能提升增加个人潜力，但初始职业教育往往是后续独立知识改进的唯一基础
AI.research_question: 专业人员如何基于初始职业教育进行持续的知识和技能提升？初始职业教育在职业生涯发展中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 专业人员需要持续学习以适应职业发展需求，但实践中往往依赖初始职业教育作为唯一基础，这可能限制其长期发展潜力
AI.theoretical_framework: 终身学习理论、人力资本理论、职业发展理论、知识管理理论
AI.method: 文献综述、理论分析、概念框架构建
AI.findings: 专业人员确实通过持续学习提升个人潜力，但初始职业教育在后续独立学习中起到关键基础作用，可能成为限制因素
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对职业教育与终身学习关系的理解，提出了初始教育在职业生涯中的基础性作用理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为职业教育设计提供启示，强调需要建立支持持续学习的机制，帮助专业人员超越初始教育的限制

title: From Adoption to Outcomes: AI-Specific Implementation Gaps in the First 18 Months

detail.title: From Adoption to Outcomes: AI-Specific Implementation Gaps in the First 18 Months

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial, professional, or personal interests that could have influenced the research or its interpretation.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The study relies on secondary sources and conceptual analysis. No original data were collected from human participants, and no ethical approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Despite widespread experimentation, most organisations struggle to translate artificial intelligence initiatives into sustained operational or economic value. Public commentary frequently attributes these difficulties to leadership failure, cultural resistance, or generic transformation challenges. Drawing primarily on Gartner's AI/Human Readiness research and MIT NANDA's empirical analysis of enterprise AI deployments, this paper argues that early AI outcomes are constrained instead by a small number of AI-specific execution gaps that systematically recur across organizations regardless of sector or AI use case. These gaps arise from structural mismatches between probabilistic, learning-based systems and organisational designs optimised for deterministic processes and linear accountability. The paper identifies and operationalises these gaps, outlines how they manifest in practice, and highlights concrete signals associated with improved outcomes in the first 6-18 months of implementation.

AI.tldr: 大多数组织难以将AI项目转化为持续价值，主要问题不是领导力或文化阻力，而是AI特有的执行差距——概率性学习系统与确定性组织设计之间的结构性不匹配。
AI.research_question: 为什么大多数组织难以将人工智能项目转化为持续的运营或经济价值？这些困难的根本原因是什么？
AI.motivation: 尽管AI实验广泛开展，但大多数组织在将AI项目转化为持续价值方面遇到困难。公众评论通常归因于领导力失败、文化阻力或一般转型挑战，但本文认为这些解释不够准确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Gartner的AI/人类准备度研究和MIT NANDA对企业AI部署的实证分析，提出AI特有的执行差距理论，强调概率性学习系统与确定性组织设计之间的结构性不匹配。
AI.method: 结合Gartner的AI/人类准备度研究和MIT NANDA对企业AI部署的实证分析，识别和操作化AI执行差距，分析这些差距在实际中的表现。
AI.findings: 识别出少量但系统性的AI特有执行差距，这些差距在不同组织和AI用例中反复出现。这些差距源于概率性学习系统与为确定性过程和线性问责优化的组织设计之间的结构性不匹配。论文还识别了与实施前6-18个月改善结果相关的具体信号。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了AI执行差距理论框架，挑战了将AI失败归因于领导力或文化阻力的传统观点，强调AI系统与组织设计之间的结构性不匹配是根本原因。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供了识别和解决AI执行差距的具体方法，指出了改善AI实施结果的具体信号，帮助组织更有效地将AI项目转化为持续价值。

detail.abstract:
תקציר בעברית: טכנולוגיית הבלוקצ'יין, שזכתה לחשיפה רחבה עם הופעתו של מטבע הביטקוין בשנת 2008, מהווה תשתית טכנולוגית חדשנית ובעלת פוטנציאל לשינוי עמוק של מערכות כלכליות, עסקיות ומשפטיות. טכנולוגיה זו מאפשרת רישום, אימות ואחסון של מידע בצורה מבוזרת, מאובטחת ובלתי ניתנת לשינוי, ללא צורך בגורם מתווך מרכזי. לצד מטבעות קריפטוגרפיים, התפתחו יישומים מרכזיים נוספים ובהם חוזים חכמים והצעות מטבע ראשוניות (ICO), אשר מציבים אתגרים משפטיים ואתיים משמעותיים.

עבודה זו בוחנת את עקרונות היסוד של טכנולוגיית הבלוקצ'יין, לרבות מנגנוני הביזור, הפומביות, הבלתי־שינוי והקונצנזוס, ומנתחת את יישומיה המרכזיים בהקשר המשפטי. בהמשך נידונות הסוגיות המשפטיות הנובעות מהפעלת חוזים חכמים, מסחר במטבעות קריפטו והנפקות מטבע ראשוניות, תוך עמידה על הפערים הקיימים בין המסגרת הטכנולוגית האוטונומית לבין דיני החוזים, דיני ניירות ערך והרגולציה הפיננסית המסורתית.

לבסוף, מוצגת סקירה השוואתית של פתרונות חקיקתיים שננקטו במדינות שונות, בדגש על ארצות הברית, ונבחנת המציאות הרגולטורית בישראל. העבודה מצביעה על קיומה של לקונה משפטית המחייבת התאמה רגולטורית, ומדגישה את הצורך בפיתוח מסגרת חקיקתית מאוזנת שתאפשר חדשנות טכנולוגית לצד הגנה על אינטרסים ציבוריים, ודאות משפטית ושלטון החוק.


English Abstract: Blockchain technology, which gained widespread attention with the emergence of Bitcoin in 2008, constitutes an innovative technological infrastructure with the potential to profoundly transform economic, business, and legal systems. This technology enables the recording, verification, and storage of information in a decentralized, secure, and immutable manner, without reliance on a central intermediary. Alongside cryptocurrencies, additional key applications have emerged, including smart contracts and Initial Coin Offerings (ICOs), which present significant legal and ethical challenges.

This paper examines the foundational principles of blockchain technology, including decentralization, transparency, immutability, and consensus mechanisms, and analyzes its primary applications from a legal perspective. It further explores the legal issues arising from the implementation of smart contracts, cryptocurrency trading, and ICOs, highlighting the tensions between autonomous technological frameworks and traditional legal doctrines such as contract law, securities regulation, and financial oversight.

Finally, the paper provides a comparative review of legislative and regulatory responses adopted in various jurisdictions, with a particular focus on the United States, and examines the regulatory landscape in Israel. The study identifies a legal gap that necessitates regulatory adaptation and emphasizes the need for a balanced legislative framework that promotes technological innovation while safeguarding public interests, legal certainty, and the rule of law.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文探讨区块链技术的法律挑战，特别是智能合约、加密货币交易和ICO引发的法律问题，分析了现有法律框架与去中心化技术之间的冲突，并比较了不同国家的监管应对，强调需要平衡技术创新与公共利益保护的立法框架。
AI.research_question: 区块链技术（特别是智能合约、加密货币和ICO）如何与现有法律框架（合同法、证券法、金融监管）产生冲突？需要什么样的监管适应来平衡技术创新与公共利益保护？
AI.motivation: 区块链技术作为去中心化、不可篡改的创新基础设施，对经济、商业和法律系统具有深刻变革潜力，但智能合约、加密货币和ICO等应用带来了显著的法律和伦理挑战，现有法律框架与自主技术架构之间存在紧张关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于合同法理论、证券法理论、金融监管理论，以及区块链技术的核心原则：去中心化、透明性、不可篡改性和共识机制。
AI.method: 理论分析区块链技术基本原则和应用，法律问题分析，以及比较法研究（重点分析美国和以色列的监管应对）。
AI.findings: 1. 区块链技术与传统法律框架存在显著冲突；2. 存在法律空白需要监管适应；3. 不同国家采取了不同的监管策略；4. 需要平衡的立法框架来促进创新同时保护公共利益。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 系统分析了区块链技术法律挑战的理论框架；2. 识别了自主技术系统与传统法律原则之间的理论张力；3. 提出了监管适应的理论需求。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供监管建议；2. 为企业提供法律合规指导；3. 为以色列等国家提供具体的立法参考；4. 促进技术创新与法律确定性的平衡。

title: Fast and Stable Normal SABR Approximations
affiliations: Independent and Independent

detail.title: Fast and Stable Normal SABR Approximations
detail.abstract:
The aim of this paper is to compare different approximations to the "Normal SABR'' model including some novel approximations which do not appear in the literature. In particular the focus is on computationally efficient and arbitrage free approximations, which are suitable for real-world industrial applications.

We also provide simplified derivations of many of the results, based on a novel result on the transition density of a general local volatility model which may be of interest in its own right. It is exact in moneyness, as opposed to similar expressions obtained which use averaging approximations for the higher order terms.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了Normal SABR模型的不同近似方法，包括一些文献中未出现过的新颖近似。重点在于计算高效且无套利的近似方法，适合实际工业应用。论文还基于局部波动率模型转移密度的新结果，提供了许多结果的简化推导。
AI.research_question: Normal SABR模型的不同近似方法中，哪些是计算高效、无套利且适合工业应用的？
AI.motivation: 需要为Normal SABR模型找到适合实际工业应用的近似方法，这些方法需要计算高效且无套利，而现有文献中的方法可能不够完善。
AI.theoretical_framework: Normal SABR模型、局部波动率模型、转移密度理论、无套利定价理论
AI.method: 比较分析法：比较不同近似方法，包括文献中已有的和新提出的近似；基于局部波动率模型转移密度的新结果进行简化推导
AI.findings: 提出了新的近似方法，这些方法在计算效率和避免套利方面优于现有方法；基于转移密度的新结果提供了更精确的推导，特别是在行权价方面是精确的
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了Normal SABR模型的新近似方法；2. 发展了局部波动率模型转移密度的新理论结果；3. 提供了比现有方法更精确的推导方法
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供了适合工业应用的Normal SABR模型近似方法；2. 这些方法计算高效且无套利；3. 简化了推导过程，便于实际应用

detail.title: Status of Muslim Women in Higher Education in the Thoubal District of Manipur

publicationDetails.detailsText: Himachal Pradesh University Journal, Volume 13, No. 1. Pp. 116-124; 2023

detail.abstract: This study focuses on the higher education of Muslim (Meitei Pangal) women in the Thoubal District of Manipur. The primary objective is to identify the challenges faced by Muslim women pursuing higher education in this specific district. The research employed a descriptive survey methodology, selecting a total of 45 Muslim women for interview from various higher educational institutions in the district through Simple Random sampling. The researcher utilized self-developed questionnaires for data collection, gathering information from both primary and secondary sources. The collected data underwent analysis using statistical techniques to derive percentages. The study's findings revealed that 85% of the respondents encountered financial difficulties. Additionally, 92% of the participants expressed that the distance to various educational institutions from their residences was considerable. These findings provide a comprehensive overview of the status of Muslim women in higher education within this particular district of Manipur. Furthermore, it is anticipated that the outcomes of this study will catalyze positive qualitative changes in the realm of education, particularly benefitting Muslim women in the district.

AI.tldr: 本研究调查了曼尼普尔邦Thoubal地区穆斯林（Meitei Pangal）女性在高等教育中面临的主要挑战，发现85%受访者遭遇经济困难，92%认为教育机构距离过远。
AI.research_question: 曼尼普尔邦Thoubal地区穆斯林女性在追求高等教育过程中面临哪些具体挑战？
AI.motivation: 关注特定地区（Thoubal地区）特定群体（穆斯林女性）在高等教育中的处境，揭示她们面临的障碍，为改善教育公平提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 教育机会平等理论、女性教育障碍理论、少数民族教育参与理论
AI.method: 描述性调查研究，采用简单随机抽样从地区高等教育机构选取45名穆斯林女性进行访谈，使用自编问卷收集数据，结合主次来源信息，运用统计技术进行百分比分析。
AI.findings: 85%受访者面临经济困难，92%认为教育机构距离居住地过远，揭示了该地区穆斯林女性在高等教育中的主要障碍。
AI.theory_contributions: 为少数民族女性教育障碍理论提供了具体地区案例，丰富了教育机会不平等研究在特定宗教和地域背景下的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供具体数据支持，有助于设计针对性的教育支持措施（如经济援助、交通改善），促进该地区穆斯林女性的教育参与，推动教育公平。

title: A Model of Artificial Jagged Intelligence
affiliations: University of Toronto - Rotman School of Management

detail.title: A Model of Artificial Jagged Intelligence
detail.abstract: Generative AI systems often display highly uneven performance across tasks that appear "nearby": they can be excellent on one prompt and confidently wrong on another with only small changes in wording or context. We call this phenomenon Artificial Jagged Intelligence (AJI). This paper develops a tractable economic model of AJI that treats adoption as an information problem: users care about local reliability, but typically observe only coarse, global quality signals. In a baseline one-dimensional landscape, truth is a rough Brownian process, and the model "knows" scattered points drawn from a Poisson process. The model interpolates optimally, and the local error is measured by posterior variance. We derive an adoption threshold for a blind user, show that experienced errors are amplified by the inspection paradox, and interpret scaling laws as denser coverage that improves average quality without eliminating jaggedness. We then study mastery and calibration: a calibrated user who can condition on local uncertainty enjoys positive expected value even in domains that fail the blind adoption test. Modelling mastery as learning a reliability map via Gaussian process regression yields a learning-rate bound driven by information gain, clarifying when discovering "where the model works" is slow. Finally, we study how scaling interacts with discoverability: when calibrated signals and user mastery accelerate the harvesting of scale improvements, and when opacity can make gains from scaling effectively invisible.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了"人工锯齿智能"概念，描述生成式AI在看似相似任务上表现不稳定的现象。通过经济模型分析用户采用决策，发现全局质量信号与局部可靠性之间的信息不对称问题，并探讨了用户校准、学习曲线以及规模扩展对AI系统可发现性的影响。
AI.research_question: 生成式AI系统在看似相近任务上表现高度不稳定的现象（人工锯齿智能）如何影响用户采用决策？用户如何通过学习和校准来应对这种局部不确定性？规模扩展如何与系统可发现性相互作用？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI系统经常在看似相似的任务上表现出极端不一致的性能，这种"锯齿状"行为给用户采用带来了挑战。用户通常只能观察到全局质量信号，但实际关心的是局部可靠性，这种信息不对称影响了AI系统的有效采用和价值实现。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 人工锯齿智能理论：将AI性能的不稳定性建模为信息问题；2. 布朗运动过程：将真实能力建模为粗糙的布朗过程；3. 泊松过程：模型知识点分布；4. 贝叶斯推断框架：最优插值和后验方差计算；5. 检查悖论：解释经验误差放大现象；6. 高斯过程回归：用户学习可靠性地图的模型；7. 信息增益理论：学习速率界限分析。
AI.method: 采用经济建模方法，构建一维任务景观模型。将真实能力建模为布朗运动过程，模型知识建模为泊松过程采样点。通过贝叶斯推断分析最优插值和后验方差，推导盲用户采用阈值。使用检查悖论分析经验误差放大，通过高斯过程回归建模用户学习过程，分析信息增益驱动的学习速率界限。
AI.findings: 1. 盲用户采用存在阈值，经验误差因检查悖论而放大；2. 规模扩展定律改善平均质量但不消除锯齿性；3. 校准用户即使在不满足盲采用条件的领域也能获得正期望价值；4. 用户学习可靠性地图的速率受信息增益限制；5. 规模扩展与可发现性存在复杂交互：校准信号和用户掌握度可加速规模效益收获，而系统不透明性可能使规模增益实际上不可见。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出"人工锯齿智能"概念框架；2. 建立AI采用的经济信息模型；3. 将检查悖论应用于AI误差分析；4. 发展用户校准和学习理论；5. 建立规模扩展与可发现性的交互理论；6. 提供信息增益驱动的学习速率分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为AI系统设计者提供理解用户采用障碍的框架；2. 指导如何通过提供校准信号改善用户体验；3. 帮助用户制定有效的学习策略来发现AI能力边界；4. 为规模扩展策略提供理论依据；5. 强调系统透明度对价值实现的重要性；6. 为AI产品开发和部署提供实用指导。

title: The impact of the Covid-19 pandemic on worker careers: do different job opportunities matter?
affiliations: Government of the Federal Republic of Germany - Institute for Employment Research (IAB), Institute for Employment Research (IAB) and Institute for Employment Research (IAB)

detail.title: The impact of the Covid-19 pandemic on worker careers: do different job opportunities matter?
detail.abstract: This paper exploits that the Covid-19 pandemic came as an unexpected shock that temporarily reduced the ratio of vacancies to seekers. We use this unique setting to understand the importance of job opportunities for the impact of unemployment on workers’ careers. Compared to individuals who became unemployed under more benign conditions, we find greater and lasting adverse effects on earnings. We provide evidence that lower job opportunities lead unemployed individuals to take up jobs that are further down the occupationspecific wage distribution. Finally, we substantiate the importance of job prospects by using exogenous variation in the pandemic’s effect on occupations.

AI.tldr: 利用新冠疫情作为外生冲击，研究就业机会减少如何影响失业者的职业发展。发现相比正常时期失业者，疫情期间失业者收入下降更严重且持久，原因是他们被迫接受工资更低的工作。
AI.research_question: 就业机会的多少如何影响失业对工人职业生涯的长期影响？
AI.motivation: 新冠疫情作为外生冲击，暂时降低了职位空缺与求职者的比例，为研究就业机会对失业后果的影响提供了独特自然实验环境。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于劳动力市场搜索匹配理论，关注就业机会（职位空缺与求职者比例）对失业者再就业质量和长期收入的影响。
AI.method: 利用新冠疫情作为外生冲击，比较疫情期间失业者与正常时期失业者的职业发展差异；使用疫情对不同职业影响的异质性作为工具变量。
AI.findings: 1. 疫情期间失业者相比正常时期失业者收入下降更严重且持久；2. 就业机会减少导致失业者接受工资更低的工作；3. 疫情对不同职业的异质性影响证实了就业前景的重要性。
AI.theory_contributions: 为劳动力市场搜索匹配理论提供了实证支持，明确了就业机会在决定失业长期后果中的关键作用，丰富了关于经济冲击对劳动力市场影响的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了重要启示：在经济衰退期间，维持足够的就业机会对减轻失业的长期负面影响至关重要；有助于设计更有效的劳动力市场干预措施。

title: Liquidity, Government Bonds, and Sovereign Debt Crises

detail.title: Liquidity, Government Bonds, and Sovereign Debt Crises
detail.abstract: This paper studies the Eurozone sovereign debt crisis through the lens of funding liquidity in government bonds. Using newly collected data on repo haircuts from LCH Clearnet Ltd, the paper identifies liquidity shocks with a high-frequency structural VAR, separately from sovereign risk shocks, and shows that reductions in funding liquidity substantially increased yields on peripheral government bonds. To explain these effects, a general equilibrium model with financial frictions reproduces the empirical dynamics of a liquidity shock, capturing the rise in bond returns, the flight-to-liquidity, and the contraction in aggregate activity during the crisis. The model further highlights how liquidity and sovereign risk interact, generating a feedback loop that amplifies market stress. Evidence from the COVID-19 pandemic, including ECB haircut reductions, corroborates the role of this funding liquidity channel.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过政府债券融资流动性视角研究欧元区主权债务危机，使用LCH Clearnet的回购折扣数据识别流动性冲击，发现融资流动性减少显著提高了外围国家债券收益率，并通过一般均衡模型解释这些效应，揭示了流动性与主权风险相互作用的反馈循环。
AI.research_question: 融资流动性冲击如何影响欧元区主权债务危机期间的外围国家政府债券收益率？流动性与主权风险之间如何相互作用并放大市场压力？
AI.motivation: 理解欧元区主权债务危机的机制，特别是融资流动性在危机中的作用，以及流动性与主权风险之间的相互作用如何加剧市场压力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于金融摩擦的一般均衡模型，包含融资流动性渠道和主权风险相互作用的理论框架。
AI.method: 使用LCH Clearnet新收集的回购折扣数据，通过高频结构VAR识别流动性冲击（与主权风险冲击分离），并构建包含金融摩擦的一般均衡模型进行理论分析。
AI.findings: 1. 融资流动性减少显著提高了外围国家政府债券收益率；2. 流动性冲击导致债券回报上升、流动性避险现象和总活动收缩；3. 流动性与主权风险相互作用形成反馈循环，放大市场压力；4. COVID-19疫情期间欧洲央行降低折扣的政策支持了融资流动性渠道的重要性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了包含金融摩擦的一般均衡模型，解释流动性冲击对债券市场的影响；2. 理论化流动性与主权风险的相互作用机制；3. 提供了融资流动性渠道的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了理解主权债务危机的新视角；2. 揭示了欧洲央行降低回购折扣等政策干预的有效性；3. 为市场参与者提供了风险管理的新见解；4. 对危机期间的市场动态提供了实证证据。

title: Design and Development of Aegis-1: An Integrated Prototype for Direct Air Capture and Electrochemical Conversion of Atmospheric CO₂ into Oxygen and Carbon Nanotubes

detail.title: Design and Development of Aegis-1: An Integrated Prototype for Direct Air Capture and Electrochemical Conversion of Atmospheric CO₂ into Oxygen and Carbon Nanotubes

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author(s) declare that there is no conflict of interest regarding the publication of this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, patients, or animals; therefore, ethical approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: The continuous rise in atmospheric carbon dioxide (CO₂) concentration is one of the most critical drivers of global climate change, necessitating the development of innovative technologies for both carbon capture and utilization. While conventional carbon capture approaches primarily focus on sequestration, limited attention has been given to systems that simultaneously remove CO₂ from ambient air and convert it into value-added materials. This research presents the design and development of Aegis-1, a prototype-scale integrated machine capable of capturing atmospheric CO₂ and converting it into oxygen and carbon nanotubes (CNTs) through a two-stage process involving chemical absorption and carbonate electrolysis. In the first stage, Aegis-1 employs a direct air capture mechanism using an aqueous monoethanolamine (MEA) solution promoted by piperazine (PZ) to selectively absorb CO₂ from ambient air. The use of the MEA-PZ blend enhances absorption kinetics, reduces residence time, and improves operational efficiency compared to conventional amine systems. The CO₂-rich solution is subsequently thermally regenerated to release high-purity CO₂ gas, enabling continuous cyclic operation. In the second stage, the released CO₂ is electrochemically converted using a molten carbonate electrolyte, where carbonate electrolysis produces solid carbon in the form of carbon nanotubes at the cathode and pure oxygen gas at the anode. The Aegis-1 system represents a novel integration of direct air capture with electrochemical CO₂ conversion, offering a pathway for negative-emission technology coupled with nanomaterial production. This paper discusses the working principles, chemical reactions, system architecture, and expected performance of the prototype, along with its environmental and techno-economic significance. Although the current work focuses on design and feasibility analysis, the proposed approach demonstrates strong potential for scalable carbon utilization, contributing to sustainable climate-mitigation strategies and advanced material manufacturing.

AI.tldr: 本文设计开发了Aegis-1原型机，将大气CO₂捕集与电化学转化相结合，通过胺溶液吸收和熔融碳酸盐电解两阶段过程，将CO₂转化为碳纳米管和氧气，实现负排放技术与纳米材料生产的集成。
AI.research_question: 如何设计开发一种能够同时从大气中捕集CO₂并将其转化为有价值材料（碳纳米管和氧气）的集成系统？
AI.motivation: 大气CO₂浓度持续上升是全球气候变化的关键驱动因素，现有碳捕集技术主要关注封存，而同时实现CO₂捕集和转化为增值材料的系统研究有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于直接空气捕集技术和电化学CO₂转化理论，结合化学吸收动力学和熔融碳酸盐电解原理。
AI.method: 采用两阶段过程：1) 使用MEA-PZ混合胺溶液的直接空气捕集机制；2) 熔融碳酸盐电解将CO₂转化为碳纳米管和氧气。
AI.findings: Aegis-1系统成功整合了直接空气捕集与电化学CO₂转化，MEA-PZ混合胺溶液提高了吸收动力学和操作效率，熔融碳酸盐电解可生产碳纳米管和纯氧。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了直接空气捕集与电化学CO₂转化集成的新理论框架，为负排放技术与纳米材料生产相结合提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了Aegis-1原型机，展示了可扩展的碳利用技术路径，为可持续气候缓解策略和先进材料制造提供了实用解决方案。

title: Multi-Scale Information Dynamics in Economic Systems: A Framework for Risk Management and Hedged Options Strategies
affiliations: Marmara University

detail.title: Multi-Scale Information Dynamics in Economic Systems: A Framework for Risk Management and Hedged Options Strategies
detail.abstract: This paper introduces a novel framework for understanding economic systems through multi-scale information dynamics (MSID). We propose that economic agents do not merely respond to information but actively produce it, and that economic meaning emerges from integrated information flows across multiple scales (individual, market, institutional, cultural). We formalize this framework using information theory (transfer entropy, mutual information) and develop an Economic Meaning Index (EMI) that quantifies the degree of information integration across scales. Using real-world financial data from 2008-2023, we demonstrate how EMI predicts regime changes and crisis periods more effectively than traditional volatility measures. We validate our framework through agent-based modeling simulations and show its practical application in hedged options strategies and risk management. Our results suggest that risk management should shift from volatility-based approaches to meaning-based approaches, where risk is understood as the degradation of cross-scale information coherence rather than mere price fluctuations.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个多尺度信息动力学(MSID)框架，认为经济主体不仅响应信息，还主动生产信息，经济意义产生于跨多个尺度(个体、市场、制度、文化)的整合信息流。作者开发了经济意义指数(EMI)来量化跨尺度信息整合程度，并证明EMI比传统波动率指标更能预测制度变化和危机时期。
AI.research_question: 经济意义如何从跨尺度的信息流中产生？如何量化这种跨尺度信息整合，并利用它来预测经济制度变化和危机？
AI.motivation: 传统经济模型主要关注价格波动和均衡，但忽视了信息在经济系统中的动态产生和整合过程。现有风险管理系统过度依赖波动率指标，无法有效预测系统性危机和制度变化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多尺度信息动力学(MSID)框架，结合信息理论(转移熵、互信息)，认为经济主体是主动的信息生产者而非被动响应者，经济意义产生于跨尺度信息整合。
AI.method: 1) 使用信息理论工具(转移熵、互信息)形式化MSID框架；2) 开发经济意义指数(EMI)量化跨尺度信息整合；3) 使用2008-2023年真实金融数据进行实证分析；4) 通过基于主体的建模模拟进行验证；5) 在套期保值期权策略和风险管理中应用。
AI.findings: EMI比传统波动率指标更有效地预测制度变化和危机时期。风险应被理解为跨尺度信息一致性的退化，而非仅仅是价格波动。基于意义的风险管理方法优于基于波动率的方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出多尺度信息动力学(MSID)新框架；2) 将经济意义概念化为跨尺度信息整合；3) 开发经济意义指数(EMI)作为量化工具；4) 重新定义风险为信息一致性的退化。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提供更有效的危机预测工具；2) 改进套期保值期权策略；3) 提出从波动率基础转向意义基础的风险管理新范式；4) 为金融机构和监管机构提供实用工具。

title: Capacity Assessment and Climate Impact Analysis of the Aegis-1 Direct Air Capture and Carbon Utilization System

detail.title: Capacity Assessment and Climate Impact Analysis of the Aegis-1 Direct Air Capture and Carbon Utilization System

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author(s) declare that there is no conflict of interest regarding the publication of this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, patients, or animals; therefore, ethical approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: The continuous increase in atmospheric carbon dioxide (CO₂) concentration is the principal driver of global warming and long-term climate change. Despite significant progress in renewable energy deployment, energy efficiency improvements, and emission control policies, these mitigation strategies remain insufficient to address the large volume of CO₂ already accumulated in the atmosphere. Consequently, active carbon dioxide removal technologies have become an essential component of long-term climate stabilization efforts. Direct Air Capture (DAC) has emerged as a promising approach capable of extracting CO₂ directly from ambient air, independent of emission sources. This paper presents a conceptual and prototype-based assessment of Aegis-1, a modular Direct Air Capture and Carbon Utilization machine designed to process ambient air, selectively capture CO₂, and convert a fraction of the captured carbon into carbon nanotubes (CNTs). Unlike conventional DAC systems that primarily rely on underground geological storage, Aegis-1 integrates carbon utilization pathways to ensure permanent carbon fixation while simultaneously generating value-added materials. The remaining captured CO₂ that is not used for CNT synthesis is directed toward stable and long-term utilization routes such as mineralization and solid material integration, preventing its re-release into the atmosphere. The study evaluates the projected air processing capacity of the Aegis-1 system, hourly CO₂ capture potential, carbon conversion rates, and secondary CO₂ utilization strategies. Furthermore, the potential impact of large-scale deployment of such systems on atmospheric CO₂ reduction and global warming mitigation is analyzed. By combining direct air capture with durable carbon utilization, Aegis-1 demonstrates a hybrid climate-technology framework that aligns environmental sustainability with industrial and economic feasibility, particularly in the context of emerging economies.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Aegis-1模块化直接空气捕集与碳利用系统，该系统不仅能从大气中捕获CO₂，还能将部分碳转化为碳纳米管，其余用于矿化等长期封存，提供了一种结合环境可持续性与经济可行性的气候技术框架。
AI.research_question: Aegis-1模块化直接空气捕集与碳利用系统如何通过结合CO₂捕获与碳纳米管生产，实现大气碳减排与气候稳定？
AI.motivation: 尽管可再生能源部署和能效改进取得进展，但现有减排策略不足以应对大气中已积累的大量CO₂，需要主动的碳移除技术作为长期气候稳定的必要组成部分。
AI.theoretical_framework: 直接空气捕集技术、碳利用与封存、碳纳米管合成技术、模块化系统设计、气候-技术整合框架。
AI.method: 概念与原型评估方法，包括系统空气处理能力分析、小时CO₂捕获潜力评估、碳转化率计算、二次CO₂利用策略分析，以及大规模部署对大气CO₂减少和全球变暖缓解的潜在影响分析。
AI.findings: Aegis-1系统能够有效处理环境空气、选择性捕获CO₂，并将部分捕获的碳转化为碳纳米管，其余CO₂通过矿化和固体材料整合实现长期封存，展示了结合直接空气捕集与持久碳利用的混合气候技术框架的可行性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将直接空气捕集与碳利用相结合的混合气候技术框架，突破了传统DAC主要依赖地质封存的局限，为新兴经济体提供了环境可持续性与工业经济可行性相协调的新路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了模块化DAC-CU机器原型，展示了碳纳米管生产与碳封存相结合的技术方案，为大规模部署提供了技术基础，有助于推动大气CO₂减少和全球变暖缓解的实际应用。

title: Integrated Carbon Capture Technologies for Climate Change Mitigation: An Interdisciplinary Review of Science, Engineering, Chemistry, Environment, and Business

detail.title: Integrated Carbon Capture Technologies for Climate Change Mitigation: An Interdisciplinary Review of Science, Engineering, Chemistry, Environment, and Business

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author(s) declare that there is no conflict of interest regarding the publication of this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, patients, or animals; therefore, ethical approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Climate change is one of the most critical global challenges of the twenty-first century, primarily driven by the continuous rise in atmospheric carbon dioxide (CO₂) concentrations resulting from industrialization, fossil fuel combustion, and large-scale urbanization. Although renewable energy expansion, electrification, and energy-efficiency improvements play a vital role in reducing emissions, these measures alone are insufficient to meet long-term climate stabilization targets, particularly for hard-to-abate sectors such as cement, steel, chemicals, and thermal power generation. In this context, carbon capture technologies have emerged as a complementary and strategic solution capable of reducing CO₂ emissions from industrial sources and removing carbon dioxide from ambient air. This paper presents a comprehensive interdisciplinary review of carbon capture technologies by integrating perspectives from science, engineering, chemistry, environmental studies, and business. The study examines fundamental scientific principles governing CO₂ separation, key engineering system designs, chemical absorption, adsorption, and conversion processes, as well as the environmental implications of large-scale deployment. In addition, economic feasibility, policy support mechanisms, and emerging business models related to carbon capture are discussed. The review highlights that while challenges related to energy demand, cost, and material durability remain, continued technological innovation and supportive regulatory frameworks can significantly enhance the viability of carbon capture technologies. The paper concludes that carbon capture, when implemented alongside emission reduction strategies, can play a vital role in achieving a low-carbon, sustainable, and climate-resilient future.

AI.tldr: 本文对碳捕集技术进行了跨学科综述，涵盖科学原理、工程设计、化学过程、环境影响及商业可行性，指出碳捕集作为补充减排策略对实现低碳未来的重要作用。
AI.research_question: 碳捕集技术如何作为补充策略帮助实现长期气候稳定目标，特别是在难以减排的工业部门？
AI.motivation: 气候变化是21世纪最严峻的全球挑战，仅靠可再生能源扩张、电气化和能效改进不足以实现长期气候稳定目标，特别是对于水泥、钢铁、化工等难以减排的行业。
AI.theoretical_framework: 跨学科框架整合了科学、工程、化学、环境研究和商业视角，涵盖CO₂分离的科学原理、工程系统设计、化学吸收/吸附/转化过程等理论基础。
AI.method: 采用综合性跨学科文献综述方法，整合多个学科领域的知识，系统分析碳捕集技术的各个方面。
AI.findings: 碳捕集技术面临能耗、成本和材料耐久性等挑战，但持续的技术创新和支持性监管框架能显著提升其可行性；碳捕集与减排策略结合对实现低碳未来至关重要。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了碳捕集技术的跨学科理论整合框架，将科学原理、工程设计、化学过程和环境影响系统性地联系起来。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、工业界和投资者提供了碳捕集技术部署的经济可行性分析、政策支持机制和新兴商业模式指导。

title: A Techno-Economic Climate-Tech Manufacturing Framework for Permanent Carbon Capture and Conversion into Stable Carbon-Based Products

detail.title: A Techno-Economic Climate-Tech Manufacturing Framework for Permanent Carbon Capture and Conversion into Stable Carbon-Based Products

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author(s) declare that there is no conflict of interest regarding the publication of this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, patients, or animals; therefore, ethical approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: The continuous rise in atmospheric carbon dioxide (CO₂) concentration represents one of the most pressing environmental and economic challenges of the modern era. Although renewable energy deployment and emission reduction strategies are essential components of climate mitigation, they are insufficient on their own to address accumulated and ongoing carbon emissions. As a result, carbon capture and permanent carbon removal technologies have emerged as critical tools within the global climate-tech ecosystem. This research paper proposes a technology-driven and business-oriented climate-tech manufacturing framework focused on capturing carbon dioxide and converting it into stable, non-emissive carbon-based materials. The proposed system utilizes chemical absorption techniques to capture CO₂ from ambient air and industrial emission sources, followed by controlled conversion processes that transform the captured carbon into solid materials with long-term stability. Unlike conventional carbon utilization pathways that involve fuels or short-lived products, which eventually release carbon back into the atmosphere, this approach ensures permanent carbon locking at the material level. From a business perspective, the model establishes revenue generation through the commercialization of durable carbon-based products rather than reliance on carbon credits or policy-driven incentives. These materials can be integrated into manufacturing, construction, and advanced material applications, creating direct market demand while simultaneously delivering environmental benefits. This alignment of climate impact with industrial value creation enhances the financial sustainability and scalability of carbon capture technologies. The study integrates technical feasibility with market dynamics, cost structure, and revenue mechanisms to evaluate the overall viability of the proposed framework. By bridging chemical technology, manufacturing innovation, and business strategy, the model demonstrates how climate-tech solutions can transition from experimental concepts to commercially viable enterprises. The proposed framework is particularly relevant for emerging economies, where industrial growth and climate responsibility must progress in parallel.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种技术驱动、商业导向的气候科技制造框架，通过化学吸收技术捕获大气和工业排放中的二氧化碳，并将其转化为稳定的固态碳基材料，实现永久碳封存，同时通过商业化碳基产品创造收入，而非依赖碳信用或政策激励。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一种既具有环境效益又具有商业可行性的碳捕获和永久封存技术框架，将捕获的二氧化碳转化为稳定的碳基材料，并通过市场化产品实现经济可持续性？
AI.motivation: 大气二氧化碳浓度持续上升是现代最紧迫的环境和经济挑战之一。尽管可再生能源部署和减排策略是气候缓解的重要组成部分，但仅靠这些不足以解决累积和持续的碳排放问题。因此，碳捕获和永久碳去除技术已成为全球气候科技生态系统的关键工具。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 气候科技制造框架理论：整合技术、制造和商业策略的系统方法
2. 永久碳封存理论：通过材料级碳锁定实现长期碳储存
3. 商业可持续性理论：通过产品商业化而非政策依赖实现经济可行性
4. 技术-市场协同理论：技术可行性与市场动态的整合
AI.method:
1. 技术方法：采用化学吸收技术从环境空气和工业排放源捕获二氧化碳，随后通过受控转化过程将捕获的碳转化为固态材料
2. 商业分析方法：整合技术可行性、市场动态、成本结构和收入机制，评估框架的整体可行性
3. 系统集成方法：桥接化学技术、制造创新和商业策略
AI.findings:
1. 技术可行性：化学吸收和转化技术能够将二氧化碳转化为稳定的碳基材料
2. 商业可行性：通过商业化耐用碳基产品（而非依赖碳信用）可以建立可持续的收入模式
3. 市场整合：碳基材料可集成到制造、建筑和先进材料应用中，创造直接市场需求
4. 环境-经济协同：气候影响与工业价值创造的结合增强了碳捕获技术的财务可持续性和可扩展性
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出了气候科技制造框架理论，将技术、制造和商业策略系统整合
2. 发展了永久碳封存理论，强调材料级碳锁定的重要性
3. 建立了技术-市场协同理论，为气候科技解决方案的商业化提供理论支持
4. 为新兴经济体提供了工业增长与气候责任并行发展的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 提供了一种可商业化的碳捕获和永久封存技术框架
2. 建立了不依赖政策激励的可持续商业模式
3. 为制造、建筑和先进材料行业提供了新的碳基材料来源
4. 为新兴经济体提供了同时实现工业发展和气候责任的实践路径
5. 展示了气候科技解决方案从实验概念向商业可行企业转型的方法

title: From Mobilization to Management: The 1989 Tiananmen Crisis as a Structural Turning Point

detail.title: From Mobilization to Management: The 1989 Tiananmen Crisis as a Structural Turning Point
detail.abstract: This paper argues that China's post-1989 democratic impossibility is best explained not by ideology but by the elimination of social organizational capacity. The mobilization of the 1980s was not the product of an emerging civil society, but a residue of the CCP's movement-based governance, intensified by the Cultural Revolution. The early reform era (1978-1989) remained institutionally indeterminate; Tiananmen escalated within this space and activated leaders' Cultural Revolution-shaped fears of organized mass politics and systemic disorder. After 1989, the regime retained democratic language yet redefined society as an object of management and pursued de-organizationalization, dismantling horizontal networks and removing the societal foundations required for democratization.

AI.tldr: 该论文认为，中国1989年后的民主不可能性主要不是由意识形态决定，而是由于社会组织能力的消除。1980年代的动员并非新兴公民社会的产物，而是中共运动式治理的残余，被文化大革命强化。早期改革时期（1978-1989）在制度上仍不确定；天安门事件在这一空间内升级，并激活了领导人受文革影响的恐惧。1989年后，政权保留了民主话语，但将社会重新定义为管理对象，并推行去组织化，拆除了民主化所需的社会基础。
AI.research_question: 为什么中国在1989年后未能实现民主转型？
AI.motivation: 解释中国民主转型的失败，挑战传统意识形态解释，强调社会组织能力的重要性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会运动理论、组织能力理论、政权韧性理论、文革历史影响理论。
AI.method: 历史制度主义分析，结合中国政治发展史、文革影响、改革时期制度变迁的质性研究。
AI.findings: 1980年代的动员是中共运动式治理的延续而非公民社会的兴起；天安门事件激活了领导人文革时期的恐惧；1989年后政权通过去组织化策略消除了民主化的社会基础。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出社会组织能力而非意识形态是民主转型的关键因素；强调历史制度连续性对政权韧性的影响；挑战传统公民社会理论对中国政治的解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 为中国政治稳定提供新的解释框架；对理解威权政体韧性有启示；为民主化研究提供中国案例的独特视角。

title: A Geospatial Analysis of Pluvial Flood Risk and Critical Infrastructure Vulnerability in Katy, Texas

detail.title: A Geospatial Analysis of Pluvial Flood Risk and Critical Infrastructure Vulnerability in Katy, Texas
detail.abstract: This study utilizes the Topographic Position Index (TPI) to model pluvial flood susceptibility in Katy, Texas, under a Hurricane Harvey-level rainfall scenario. Using SRTM elevation data and OpenStreetMap infrastructure networks, distinct hydraulic sinks were identified and their intersection with primary roadways calculated. The analysis reveals that over 25% of the road network is vulnerable to inundation. Furthermore, a mitigation strategy targeting the top five high-impact sinks was simulated, demonstrating that localized detention interventions could significantly enhance network resilience.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用地形位置指数(TPI)模拟德克萨斯州凯蒂市在哈维飓风级别降雨情景下的城市内涝易发性，识别出主要道路网络中有超过25%面临淹没风险，并证明针对前五大高影响汇水区的局部蓄洪干预可显著提升网络韧性。
AI.research_question: 在哈维飓风级别降雨情景下，德克萨斯州凯蒂市的城市道路网络面临多大的内涝淹没风险？以及通过针对性的局部蓄洪干预措施，能否有效提升道路网络的抗洪韧性？
AI.motivation: 随着极端降雨事件（如哈维飓风）频率和强度的增加，城市基础设施特别是道路网络面临严重的内涝威胁。需要开发有效的风险评估方法和缓解策略来增强城市韧性，减少洪水对交通系统的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于地形位置指数(TPI)的水文地形分析方法，结合城市基础设施网络分析理论，以及洪水易发性建模与韧性评估框架。
AI.method: 使用SRTM高程数据和OpenStreetMap基础设施网络数据，应用TPI识别水力汇水区，计算这些汇水区与主要道路的交集，评估道路网络淹没风险，并模拟针对前五大高影响汇水区的局部蓄洪干预效果。
AI.findings: 研究发现超过25%的道路网络在哈维飓风级别降雨情景下易受淹没；针对前五大高影响汇水区实施局部蓄洪干预可显著提升整个道路网络的抗洪韧性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将TPI地形分析方法应用于城市内涝风险评估，发展了基于基础设施网络交集的洪水易发性量化框架，为城市洪水韧性评估提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为凯蒂市提供了具体的道路网络内涝风险评估结果，识别了关键脆弱区域；提出了经济有效的局部蓄洪干预策略，为城市规划者和应急管理者提供了实用的决策支持工具。

title: A Methodological Framework for Auditing Norm-Sensitive Behaviour in Large Language Models: Research Design for Employment Contexts
