title: Intellectual Property Rights, Technology Development and Market Dynamics in the Renewable Energy Sector
affiliations: University of Oslo - Department of Private Law

detail.title: Intellectual Property Rights, Technology Development and Market Dynamics in the Renewable Energy Sector

publicationDetails.detailsText: A revised version of this paper is published as Chapter 8 in Ole-Andreas Rognstad and Inger B. Ørstavik (eds.), Intellectual Property and Sustainable Markets, Edgar Elgar, 2021.

detail.abstract: In the transition from fossil energy to renewable energy, innovation and thus the patent system, plays an important role. Using the solar PV industry as an example, the article shows how a coherent approach to energy policy and innovation policy is necessary, because of the externalities of the technology neutrality of patent law. Patent law inadequately incentivizes innovation in renewable energy technologies over fossil technologies. Furthermore, patent law does not stimulate sustainability in the renewable energy industry as such, evidenced by the reliance on coal-fired utilities in production of solar PV systems. Energy or environmental policies that support sustainability in the dynamics of the market will indirectly include sustainability in patent law, as market dynamics are integrated in the normative rationale of patent law. The article discusses how such policies can support the functions of patent law, driving innovation in renewable energy technologies and contributing to ensure that energy and industry markets are sustainable.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨专利法在能源转型中的局限性，指出专利法的技术中立性无法有效激励可再生能源创新，反而可能维持化石能源技术优势。文章以光伏产业为例，说明需要能源政策与创新政策协同，通过市场机制间接影响专利法，推动可持续技术创新。
AI.research_question: 专利法在能源转型中如何有效激励可再生能源技术创新并促进可持续发展？
AI.motivation: 在化石能源向可再生能源转型过程中，创新和专利系统扮演重要角色。然而，专利法的技术中立性存在外部性，未能充分激励可再生能源技术创新，反而可能维持化石能源技术优势。光伏产业依赖煤电生产系统的现状表明，专利法本身无法促进可再生能源产业的可持续性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 专利法的技术中立性原则及其外部性；2. 能源政策与创新政策的协同理论；3. 市场动态与专利法规范理性的整合理论；4. 可持续发展与技术创新激励的关联理论。
AI.method: 采用案例研究方法，以太阳能光伏产业为例，分析专利法在能源转型中的实际作用。通过理论分析探讨专利法的技术中立性局限，并结合能源政策与市场动态的相互作用，提出政策协同框架。
AI.findings: 1. 专利法的技术中立性未能充分激励可再生能源技术创新；2. 专利法本身无法促进可再生能源产业的可持续性（如光伏系统生产仍依赖煤电）；3. 支持可持续发展的能源和环境政策可以通过影响市场动态，间接影响专利法的规范理性；4. 政策协同可以支持专利法功能，推动可再生能源技术创新。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了专利法技术中立性在能源转型中的局限性；2. 提出了能源政策与创新政策协同的理论框架；3. 发展了市场动态与专利法规范理性整合的理论；4. 为可持续发展导向的技术创新激励提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了能源政策与创新政策协同的具体路径；2. 指出了通过市场机制间接影响专利法促进可持续发展的方法；3. 为可再生能源产业的技术创新提供了政策建议；4. 为专利法改革提供了实践指导，以更好地支持能源转型。

title: A Two Kernel Model for Climate Strategy: Mitigation as Closed Optimization and Adaptation as Stochastic Resilience

detail.title: A Two Kernel Model for Climate Strategy: Mitigation as Closed Optimization and Adaptation as Stochastic Resilience

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no conflicts of interest related to this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this theoretical and non-human-subject research.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
This paper introduces the Two-Kernel Model, a structural framework for understanding why national climate strategies succeed or fail. Traditional climate planning relies on linear policy or technology pathways, but this approach often collapses when applied to real-world economic, social, and financial conditions.
The Two-Kernel Model separates climate strategy into two interacting kernels: a Stability Kernel, which determines a country’s structural readiness (infrastructure, fiscal capacity, political continuity, and technological absorption), and a Trajectory Kernel, which shapes the dynamic pathway of emissions reduction, investment allocation, and market response.

By separating these two kernels, the model explains why countries with similar policies achieve vastly different results, why decarbonization paths diverge after initial success, and why investment-driven climate transitions frequently stall despite strong policy ambition. The framework integrates economic structure, behavioral incentives, national risk systems, and climate-finance architecture into a unified strategy function.

The paper demonstrates how the Two-Kernel Model can be used to diagnose structural bottlenecks, predict decarbonization outcomes, and redesign national climate strategies. It provides a generalizable method for linking policy, finance, and infrastructure within a coherent analytical system, offering practitioners and researchers a new tool for understanding and improving climate transition performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"双核模型"作为理解国家气候战略成败的结构框架。该模型将气候战略分为两个相互作用的核：稳定性核（决定国家结构准备度）和轨迹核（塑造减排动态路径），解释了为何相似政策产生不同结果，并为诊断瓶颈、预测结果和重新设计战略提供了工具。
AI.research_question: 为什么国家气候战略会成功或失败？为什么具有相似政策的国家取得截然不同的结果？为什么脱碳路径在初步成功后会出现分歧？为什么投资驱动的气候转型经常停滞？
AI.motivation: 传统气候规划依赖线性政策或技术路径，但在应用于现实世界的经济、社会和金融条件时经常失败。需要一个新的框架来解释气候战略的成败差异，并为实践者提供更好的分析工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 双核模型：稳定性核（基础设施、财政能力、政治连续性、技术吸收能力）和轨迹核（减排动态路径、投资分配、市场反应）。该框架整合了经济结构、行为激励、国家风险系统和气候金融架构。
AI.method: 提出了一个结构框架和理论模型，将气候战略分解为两个相互作用的核，并通过整合多个维度（经济、社会、金融、政治）来解释战略绩效差异。
AI.findings: 通过分离这两个核，模型能够解释：1）相似政策产生不同结果的原因；2）脱碳路径在初步成功后出现分歧的原因；3）投资驱动转型停滞的原因。模型提供了诊断结构瓶颈、预测结果和重新设计战略的能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出了双核模型作为理解气候战略成败的新理论框架；2）将经济结构、行为激励、风险系统和金融架构整合到统一的分析系统中；3）提供了可推广的方法，将政策、金融和基础设施联系起来。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为实践者提供诊断结构瓶颈的工具；2）能够预测脱碳结果；3）支持重新设计国家气候战略；4）为研究人员提供理解和改进气候转型绩效的新工具。

title: The Impact of Economic Reforms on Welfare and Conflicts in Post-Soviet Eastern Europe
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The Impact of Economic Reforms on Welfare and Conflicts in Post-Soviet Eastern Europe
detail.abstract: This paper investigates leading indicators of successful reform in former Soviet republics and satellite states in Eastern Europe by analysing political and economic reform indicators from 1990 to 2025. The study focuses on nine countries divided into two groups. The successful reformers consist of Czechia, Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania, and Poland, and the group of unsuccessful reformers consist of Armenia, Georgia, Moldova, and Ukraine. Using GDP per capita and monthly salary as measures of economic success, this study analyses the trends and causal relationship between human rights, economic freedom, political rights, civil liberties index, control of corruption, government effectiveness, political stability/absence of violence, and rule of law. Quantitative analysis found that political reformers that improve rule of law and control of corruption are key to successful economic reforms and prosperity. Furthermore, qualitative analysis found that economic prosperity positively correlated with participation in international institutions such as the EU and WTO because it incentivised and guided transitioning countries. These findings are important for the lagging economies in Eastern Europe, especially postwar Ukraine, showing that they must first conduct political reform in order to improve economic welfare.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了1990-2025年前苏联加盟共和国和东欧卫星国的改革成功领先指标，发现成功的政治改革（特别是法治和腐败控制）是经济改革成功和繁荣的关键，参与欧盟和WTO等国际机构对经济转型有积极影响。
AI.research_question: 前苏联加盟共和国和东欧卫星国改革成功的领先指标是什么？政治改革与经济改革成功之间的因果关系如何？
AI.motivation: 理解东欧转型国家改革成功的关键因素，为战后乌克兰等滞后经济体提供政策指导，帮助它们通过改革实现经济繁荣。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度经济学理论、政治经济学理论、转型经济学理论、国际制度理论
AI.method: 混合方法研究：1）定量分析：使用GDP per capita和月薪作为经济成功指标，分析人权、经济自由、政治权利、公民自由指数、腐败控制、政府效能、政治稳定/无暴力、法治等变量间的趋势和因果关系；2）定性分析：考察国际机构参与（欧盟、WTO）对经济转型的影响
AI.findings: 1）改善法治和腐败控制的政治改革是经济改革成功和繁荣的关键；2）经济繁荣与参与欧盟和WTO等国际机构正相关，因为这些机构为转型国家提供了激励和指导；3）成功的改革者（捷克、爱沙尼亚、拉脱维亚、立陶宛、波兰）与不成功的改革者（亚美尼亚、格鲁吉亚、摩尔多瓦、乌克兰）在改革路径和结果上存在明显差异
AI.theory_contributions: 1）为转型经济学提供了实证证据，强调政治改革先于经济改革的重要性；2）深化了对制度质量（特别是法治和腐败控制）在经济发展中作用的理解；3）验证了国际制度参与对转型国家改革的促进作用
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为乌克兰等滞后经济体提供了明确的改革路径：先进行政治改革（特别是法治和反腐），再推进经济改革；2）强调了参与国际机构（如欧盟、WTO）对改革成功的重要性；3）为政策制定者提供了具体的改革优先顺序指导

title: Export Promotion: What is Missing? (Identification of Gaps and Policy Options)

detail.title: Export Promotion: What is Missing? (Identification of Gaps and Policy Options)
detail.abstract: (This paper intends to figure out the factors, both of structure and policy, responsible for the stagnation of Pakistan's exports. For doing so, a critical analysis of the structure of exports and export-oriented schemes is conducted. The export structure is analyzed in the light of data of the Atlas of Economic Complexity of Harvard Growth lab and World Integrated Trade Solution (WITS) trade statistics while for the analysis of export-oriented initiatives, relevant data of FBR is used for the period 2020-21 to 2024-25. A critical evaluation of export structure shows that exports are characterized by low complexity, low tech-content, and low value-added. Pakistan's revealed comparative advantage (RCA) lies in goods like textile, raw hides and skins, food items, and agricultural products. Its export value index has not witnessed a sharp increase over time in comparison to those of India, Bangladesh, and Vietnam. Analysis of export-oriented schemes suggests that they are biased in favour of the big exporters. Low utilization of these schemes by the small and medium-sized exporters amply vindicates the said assertion. The findings of this paper suggest that anti-export bias, low productivity, and policy neglect of small and medium-sized exporters are the main factors behind the stagnation of exports. It is suggested that exemption of input goods, meant for export, from import-stage tariffs should be given through tariff code and not schedules with strings attached or sector-specific SROs. This policy shift would induce the small and medium-sized exporters in particular to avail exemptions. Gradual phasing out of import tariffs to reduce anti-export bias, a well-coordinated industrial policy, prioritization of innovation and productivity, SME-based export strategy and transforming the existing natural clusters into clusters of exports, besides granting exemption of inputs through tariff code, are recommended as public policy prescriptions to meet the challenge of low exports.) Jamil Nasir is a senior civil servant with nearly three decades of experience. He is currently working as Chief Collector of Customs at Karachi and leads the Faceless Customs Assessment project under the Prime Minister's Transformational Plan for FBR. He is also an author, holds a degree from Columbia University, and is a Chevening Fellow. His latest book "Development Challenges of Pakistan: Constraints and Choices" was published by Palgrave Macmillan in July, 2024.This paper was presented at the conference " Challenges and Transformations in Contemporary Pakistan" organized by the Centre of Public Policy and Governance (CPPG), FCCU on 21 st and 22 nd May, 2025. Disclaimer This paper is purely academic in nature. The findings, views and opinions expressed in the paper do not necessarily reflect the official viewpoint of the writer or his organization.

AI.tldr: 巴基斯坦出口停滞的主要原因是出口结构低复杂度、低技术含量、低附加值，以及出口导向政策偏向大型出口商，导致中小企业参与不足。建议通过关税代码给予出口用投入品免税、逐步取消进口关税、制定协调的产业政策、优先创新和生产率、实施中小企业出口战略等措施。
AI.research_question: 导致巴基斯坦出口停滞的结构性和政策性因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 巴基斯坦出口长期停滞，与印度、孟加拉国、越南等可比国家相比增长缓慢，需要深入分析出口结构和政策问题以找到解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济复杂性理论、显性比较优势(RCA)理论、出口导向政策分析、反出口偏见理论、中小企业发展理论。
AI.method: 使用哈佛增长实验室的经济复杂性地图集和WITS贸易统计数据分析出口结构；使用FBR 2020-21至2024-25年数据分析出口导向政策；对出口结构和政策进行批判性评估。
AI.findings: 1. 巴基斯坦出口结构具有低复杂度、低技术含量、低附加值特征；2. RCA主要在纺织品、生皮、食品和农产品等传统领域；3. 出口价值指数增长缓慢；4. 出口导向政策偏向大型出口商，中小企业利用率低；5. 反出口偏见、低生产率和对中小企业的政策忽视是出口停滞的主要原因。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 验证了经济复杂性理论与出口表现的关系；2. 揭示了出口导向政策实施中的偏向性问题；3. 深化了对发展中国家出口停滞机制的理解，特别是结构性和制度性约束的作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 建议通过关税代码而非附带条件的计划给予出口用投入品免税；2. 建议逐步取消进口关税以减少反出口偏见；3. 建议制定协调的产业政策；4. 建议优先创新和生产率提升；5. 建议实施中小企业出口战略；6. 建议将现有自然集群转化为出口集群。

title: The Behavioral Physiology of Reproduction: A Control-Theoretic Account of Fertility Collapse under Modern Contraceptive Environments

detail.title: The Behavioral Physiology of Reproduction: A Control-Theoretic Account of Fertility Collapse under Modern Contraceptive Environments
detail.abstract: This paper proposes a new endogenous dynamical theory of fertility decline based on a single modification to standard behavioral assumptions. Specifically, we introduce the hypothesis that the immediate suppressive signal governing sexual behavior-modeled as homeostatic inhibition-does not reference realized fertility outcomes or anticipated childrearing costs, but instead depends solely on experienced sexual reward. Modeling human reproductive behavior as a closed-loop control system, we show that under modern sexual environments characterized by low-cost contraception with negligible attenuation of sexual reward, fertility-suppressive behavior is maximized as an immediate consequence of quasi-static individual optimization, without requiring any temporal evolution. By further introducing the dynamic accumulation of chronic anxiety as a downstream state variable, together with the long-run degradation of behavioral control, the model endogenously generates multiple empirically observed phenomena. Representative implications include withdrawal from romantic relationships, paradoxical fertility responses to simulated childrearing experiences, short-term fertility rebounds followed by long-term collapse under coercive pronatalist policies and increasing aversion to passive exposure to sexual content. Unlike existing economic, institutional, or cultural explanations, the proposed framework yields structural temporal predictions and articulates a clearly falsifiable central hypothesis. The theory provides a unified perspective for understanding fertility decline across diverse institutional and cultural contexts, ranging from liberal democratic societies to historical cases of authoritarian intervention.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个基于性奖励体验的内生动态生育率下降理论，认为性行为的抑制信号取决于性奖励体验而非生育结果或抚养成本，在现代避孕环境下导致生育抑制行为最大化。
AI.research_question: 生育率下降的根本机制是什么？如何解释不同制度和文化背景下普遍存在的生育率下降现象？
AI.motivation: 现有经济、制度或文化解释无法统一解释不同社会背景下的生育率下降，缺乏结构性时间预测和可证伪的核心假设。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 性行为的稳态抑制假说：性行为的抑制信号取决于性奖励体验而非生育结果或抚养成本
2. 闭环控制系统模型：将人类生殖行为建模为闭环控制系统
3. 慢性焦虑动态积累：作为下游状态变量
4. 行为控制长期退化
AI.method: 理论建模方法：构建基于性奖励体验的内生动态生育理论模型，分析现代避孕环境下的行为优化过程。
AI.findings:
1. 在现代低成本避孕环境下，生育抑制行为作为准静态个体优化的直接结果而最大化
2. 内生产生多种经验现象：退出浪漫关系、对模拟抚养经历的矛盾生育反应、强制生育政策下的短期反弹与长期崩溃、对被动暴露性内容厌恶增加
3. 提供跨制度和文化背景的统一解释框架
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出基于性奖励体验的内生动态生育理论
2. 提供结构性时间预测
3. 提出明确可证伪的核心假设
4. 统一解释不同社会背景下的生育率下降
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为生育政策制定提供新视角
2. 解释强制生育政策的长期失效
3. 理解现代性环境下的行为变化
4. 为跨文化生育研究提供统一框架

title: Real Compliance with the Corporate Governance Code or Box-Ticking?
affiliations: Roma Tre University

detail.title: Real Compliance with the Corporate Governance Code or Box-Ticking?

declarations.declarationOfInterest: no conflicts of interests to be declared
declarations.funderStatement: no funder

contentType.other: paper submitted to IJBGE but unexpectedly rejected after two-round revisions (and one year and half after the original submission)

detail.abstract: Despite 20 years of regulation (from the corporate scandals of the earlier 21st century), many grey areas persist in corporate governance (hereinafter CG) systems under the façade of a full compliance with the best practices: box-ticking and box-checking behaviours (by operators and supervisors, respectively) are the dark-side of an apparent excellence, as measured by CG quality indices, which are frequently focused on formal compliance. This study: i) verifies if a gap exists between apparent and real compliance with the Code requirements in a sample of Italian listed banks; ii) generalises the empirical findings, by analysing the responses to Code requirements through the lens of new institutionalist/resource dependence theories and explaining them through predictive factors. We find opacity in CG narrative and avoidance/concealment strategies also in banks considered CG "champions", rarely non-compliance clearly declared and explained. Implications for regulators/supervisors to reduce the gap and trigger more virtuous practices are therefore analysed.

AI.tldr: 该研究揭示了意大利上市银行在公司治理合规方面存在"表面合规"与"实际合规"的差距，即使在被视为治理"冠军"的银行中也存在叙述不透明和规避策略，很少明确声明和解释不合规情况。
AI.research_question: 意大利上市银行在公司治理规范遵守方面是否存在表面合规与实际合规的差距？如何通过新制度主义/资源依赖理论解释这些合规行为？
AI.motivation: 尽管经过20年的监管改革，公司治理系统仍存在许多灰色地带，表面上完全遵守最佳实践，但实际上存在"打勾式"合规行为，这是公司治理质量指数衡量的表面优秀背后的阴暗面。

title: Decision-Making Under Irreversible Ecological Constraints: A Governance Perspective
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Decision-Making Under Irreversible Ecological Constraints: A Governance Perspective

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known financial or personal relationships that could be perceived to have influenced the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, patients, animals, or the use of identifiable personal data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Contemporary sustainability and environmental governance frameworks rely heavily on proxy metrics, optimisation models, and compensatory mechanisms that often obscure irreversible ecological change and long-term loss of future options. While tools such as environmental impact assessment, cost-benefit analysis, and offsetting regimes support comparative evaluation, they frequently treat ecological impacts as substitutable, deferrable, or reversible within administrative or market-based logic. This paper argues that a central governance blind spot lies in the inadequate treatment of irreversibility. It proposes a conceptual governance perspective that treats irreversible ecological commitments and the foreclosure of future option space as non-negotiable constraints shaping decision admissibility, rather than as variables to be balanced or optimised. Building on insights from ecological economics, resilience theory, and systems thinking, the paper introduces the Entropic Governance Framework (EGF) as a pre-standard, procedural discipline for examining decisions under constraint. EGF does not propose new metrics, optimisation models, or policy prescriptions. Instead, it reframes sustainability as a governance problem of how irreversible commitments are surfaced, justified, and owned within decision processes. The framework emphasises transparency, accountability, and escalation of justification when actions create long-lived ecological lock-in or constrain future adaptive capacity. This paper offers a conceptual positioning of EGF intended to support critique and interdisciplinary dialogue. A detailed applied case study demonstrating implementation of the Entropic Governance Framework is currently under peer review. The present paper focuses on conceptual positioning and theoretical grounding, intended to support interdisciplinary dialogue and critique while the applied work proceeds through formal review.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"熵治理框架(EGF)"，将不可逆生态承诺视为决策可接受性的非协商约束，而非可优化变量，旨在解决当前可持续性治理中对不可逆性处理不足的盲点。
AI.research_question: 如何通过治理框架有效识别和处理生态决策中的不可逆性，避免未来选择空间的永久丧失？
AI.motivation: 当前可持续性和环境治理框架过度依赖代理指标、优化模型和补偿机制，这些方法往往掩盖了不可逆的生态变化和未来选择空间的长期丧失，存在治理盲点。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生态经济学、韧性理论和系统思维，强调将不可逆生态承诺视为决策可接受性的非协商约束。
AI.method: 概念性治理视角构建，提出熵治理框架(EGF)作为预标准程序纪律，用于在约束条件下审查决策。
AI.findings: 提出EGF框架，强调透明度、问责制和正当性升级，当行动造成长期生态锁定或限制未来适应能力时需要更高层次的正当性证明。
AI.theory_contributions: 将可持续性重新定义为治理问题，关注不可逆承诺如何在决策过程中被揭示、论证和承担责任；提供概念性治理框架填补理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为决策者提供程序性治理工具，帮助识别不可逆生态影响；支持跨学科对话和批判；实际案例研究正在同行评审中。

title: AI Infrastructure Macroeconomic Risk Report (2025)
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: AI Infrastructure Macroeconomic Risk Report (2025)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal, financial, or institutional interests that could influence or be perceived to influence the findings of this research. This work is conducted solely for educational and analytical purposes, with no commercial intent or benefit derived from its development.

detail.abstract:
This research provides a comprehensive, forward-looking evaluation of the global AI infrastructure cycle, assessing the financial sustainability, energy feasibility, and long-term economic viability of hyperscale AI investment across NVIDIA, Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon, Meta, and OpenAI. Leveraging comparative financial modeling, industry capex trajectories, semiconductor supply constraints, and cost-per-inference economics, the analysis highlights a structural imbalance between current AI infrastructure spending and the monetization capacity of existing AI products. Results show that hyperscalers are deploying unprecedented levels of debt-funded and cash-funded capex to acquire GPUs, expand data centers, and secure energy supply, while AI-derived revenue remains between 1-3% of topline which is far below the 15-20% threshold required to sustain multi-year AI buildouts. Energy limitations, including regional power scarcity and grid lead-time delays, further reduce the scalability of AI clusters and increase the risk of infrastructure stagnation.

Scenario modeling identifies the 2023-2026 period as an early-cycle hypergrowth phase in which AI chip orders may grow at 100%+ annually, followed by a normalization window in 2027 onward where demand stabilizes at 20-40% of peak volumes. In this maturing phase, companies unable to close monetization gaps face structural risk. OpenAI emerges as the system’s critical weak link due to limited revenue diversification, no profitability, and dependence on external funding. Meta faces commoditization risk, while NVIDIA’s long-term growth becomes exposed to demand decay once hyperscaler saturation peaks. Meanwhile, Microsoft, Google, and Amazon maintain relative resilience due to diversified revenue bases, though they remain vulnerable to delayed AI adoption, energy shortages, persistent high interest rates, and reduced cloud expansion.

The study concludes that the AI sector is currently overbuilt relative to economic output and resembles the early dot-com period with rapid infrastructure expansion without proportional monetization. Unless enterprise AI adoption, consumer willingness to pay, and breakthrough automation accelerate meaningfully, the sector will face a correction driven by the convergence of financial tightening, energy constraints, and monetization inefficiency. This paper emphasizes the need for top-down AI infrastructure planning, realistic TAM calibration, and insights on Energy & AI Compute analysis to extrapolate path towards sustainable AI Infra expansion enforcing market stability and prevent a sector-wide downturn.

AI.tldr: 该研究对全球AI基础设施周期进行全面评估，发现当前AI基础设施支出与AI产品变现能力存在结构性失衡。超大规模企业正以前所未有的债务和现金资本支出投资GPU和数据中心，但AI相关收入仅占营收的1-3%，远低于维持多年AI建设所需的15-20%门槛。能源限制进一步降低了AI集群的可扩展性。研究预测2023-2026年为早期超增长阶段，随后将进入需求正常化阶段，无法缩小变现差距的公司将面临结构性风险。
AI.research_question: 全球AI基础设施投资在财务可持续性、能源可行性和长期经济可行性方面是否面临结构性失衡？当前AI基础设施支出与AI产品变现能力之间的差距有多大？哪些因素可能阻碍AI基础设施的可持续扩张？
AI.motivation: 随着NVIDIA、微软、Alphabet、亚马逊、Meta和OpenAI等公司大规模投资AI基础设施，需要评估这些投资的长期可持续性。当前存在AI基础设施快速扩张但缺乏相应变现能力的担忧，类似于早期互联网泡沫时期。研究旨在分析财务、能源和经济约束如何影响AI基础设施周期的可持续性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 该研究基于基础设施投资周期理论、技术采纳生命周期理论、财务可持续性分析和能源约束理论。结合了资本支出轨迹分析、半导体供应链约束、每次推理成本经济学等框架，评估AI基础设施的超增长阶段和正常化阶段。
AI.method: 采用比较财务建模方法，分析行业资本支出轨迹、半导体供应约束和每次推理成本经济学。通过情景建模识别不同发展阶段（2023-2026超增长阶段和2027后正常化阶段），评估各公司的财务可持续性和风险暴露。
AI.findings: 研究发现：1）超大规模企业AI相关收入仅占营收的1-3%，远低于维持多年AI建设所需的15-20%门槛；2）能源限制（区域电力短缺和电网建设延迟）降低了AI集群可扩展性；3）OpenAI是系统中最薄弱环节，缺乏收入多元化、无盈利能力且依赖外部资金；4）Meta面临商品化风险；5）NVIDIA在超大规模企业需求饱和后面临增长衰减风险；6）微软、谷歌和亚马逊因多元化收入基础而相对有韧性。
AI.theory_contributions: 该研究贡献了AI基础设施周期理论框架，识别了超增长阶段和正常化阶段的特征。提出了AI基础设施投资与变现能力之间的结构性失衡理论，以及能源约束对AI扩展性的限制理论。为技术基础设施投资周期理论提供了新的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究为投资者提供了风险评估框架，识别了各公司的具体风险暴露。为政策制定者提供了AI基础设施规划建议，强调需要自上而下的基础设施规划、现实的市场规模校准和能源与AI计算分析。为企业提供了变现差距预警，强调了加速企业AI采纳和突破性自动化的重要性。

title: Capital Asset Formation in the AI Era: A Contract Model for Autonomous System Development
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Capital Asset Formation in the AI Era: A Contract Model for Autonomous System Development

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal or financial relationships that could be construed as influencing the analysis or conclusions of this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper does not involve human participants, patient data, or human subjects research, and therefore did not require ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Autonomous AI systems collapse the historical separation between producing a capital asset and operating it. Once deployed, such systems can perform operational functions autonomously, eliminating the need for continuous human operating labor to generate returns on the capital investment in the system. Because the production of these systems does not require sustained use of firm-internal resources, there is no structural necessity that their development occur within the deploying firm. While builders can produce these systems externally, their economic value is realized only upon integration into the deploying firm's infrastructure, controls, and workflows. These conditions enable a new production model in which bespoke, self-operating systems are developed externally by specialized builders and transferred to firms as exclusive capital assets. Yet no standard contractual framework governs such transactions. Firms, therefore, initiate these acquisitions through employment or services arrangements, bargaining structures optimized for coordinating and controlling human labor, rather than for acquiring self-operating capital. This misalignment at the level of the initial bargain produces predictable structural failures: unintended IP expropriation, accounting distortions arising from improper capitalization, incentive misalignment between builders and firms, and ongoing contractual obligations that outlast the asset's deployment. This paper introduces the Capital Asset Formation Agreement (CAFA), a contractual framework governing asset formation and the transfer of autonomous systems as capital assets. We identify the conditions under which external asset formation becomes viable, demonstrate why labor-based contracts fail structurally when applied to autonomous system acquisition, and present CAFA as a market-clearing mechanism that aligns legal form with economic substance. The framework separates asset transfer from integration labor.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种新的合同框架CAFA，专门用于管理自主AI系统作为资本资产的外部开发和转移，解决了传统基于劳动的合同在获取自主系统时产生的结构性失败问题。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个合同框架来有效管理自主AI系统作为资本资产的外部开发和转移，避免传统基于劳动的合同安排产生的结构性失败？
AI.motivation: 自主AI系统模糊了资本资产生产与运营的界限，这些系统可以自主执行操作功能，无需持续人力运营。由于开发不需要持续使用公司内部资源，可以在外部开发，但其经济价值只有在集成到部署公司的基础设施中才能实现。目前缺乏标准合同框架来管理这种交易，导致公司使用基于雇佣或服务的安排，这些安排原本是为协调和控制人力劳动而优化的，不适合获取自主运营资本。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 资本资产理论：自主AI系统作为资本资产的特征；2. 合同理论：传统劳动合同与资本资产获取合同的结构性差异；3. 交易成本经济学：外部资产形成的可行条件；4. 市场清算机制理论：CAFA作为市场清算机制的作用。
AI.method: 理论分析和框架构建方法，通过识别外部资产形成的条件，分析传统劳动合同在自主系统获取中的结构性失败，提出CAFA作为解决方案。
AI.findings: 1. 传统基于劳动的合同在获取自主系统时会产生四种结构性失败：非预期知识产权征用、不当资本化导致的会计扭曲、建设者与公司之间的激励错配、以及超出资产部署期限的持续合同义务；2. 外部资产形成在特定条件下可行；3. CAFA框架能够将资产转移与集成劳动分离，使法律形式与经济实质保持一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了自主AI系统作为资本资产的理论框架；2. 识别了传统劳动合同在资本资产获取中的结构性不匹配问题；3. 发展了资本资产形成合同的理论基础；4. 为自主系统经济学提供了新的合同理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供了CAFA合同框架的实际应用方案；2. 帮助企业避免知识产权风险、会计问题、激励错配和合同义务问题；3. 为自主AI系统的市场交易提供了标准化合同机制；4. 促进了自主系统作为资本资产的有效转移和集成。

title: Autonomous Capital: Production Theory and Contract Design for Self-Operating Systems
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Autonomous Capital: Production Theory and Contract Design for Self-Operating Systems
detail.abstract: The standard Cobb-Douglas production function relates output to two inputs: capital (K) and labor (L). Capital amplifies productivity, but labor supplies the operative function, the human effort that activates capital and generates output. If labor goes to zero, output goes to zero. This paper introduces synthetic labor (S) as a third input in the Cobb-Douglas framework, a non-human factor that occupies the operative role historically assigned to human workers. By incorporating S into the production function, we show that autonomous AI systems do not merely augment labor; they perform the operative function itself, thereby allowing output to persist as human operating labor approaches zero. This modification to production theory carries a direct implication for the theory of the firm. When operational intelligence is embedded in capital rather than supplied by labor, the firm's function shifts from Coasean labor coordinator to capital allocator, acquiring and capitalizing externally produced autonomous systems rather than organizing workers to operate passive assets. These theoretical claims have immediate institutional consequences. Firms seeking autonomous systems currently acquire them through employment and services agreements, instruments designed for labor coordination rather than asset transfer. This misclassification produces predictable failures: IP expropriation, accounting distortions, incentive misalignment, and structural debt (legal and organizational errors made upstream that become embedded in the system's architecture, yielding implementations that function in research settings but fail under operational conditions). The paper introduces the Capital Asset Formation Agreement (CAFA) as the contractual framework that operationalizes the shift from labor procurement to capital acquisition. CAFA separates asset transfer from integration labor, platform from implementation, and capital consideration from service fees, aligning legal form with the economic substance that production theory now requires.

AI.tldr: 本文在标准柯布-道格拉斯生产函数中引入"合成劳动力(S)"作为第三要素，论证AI系统不仅增强劳动力，而是直接执行操作功能，使产出在人类劳动力趋近零时仍能持续。这改变了企业理论：企业从科斯式的劳动力协调者转变为资本配置者，需要新的合同框架(CAFA)来匹配这一经济实质。
AI.research_question: 如何将自主AI系统纳入生产函数理论框架？当AI系统执行传统上由人类劳动力承担的操作功能时，这对企业理论和制度安排有何影响？
AI.motivation: 传统柯布-道格拉斯生产函数将产出归因于资本(K)和劳动(L)两个要素，其中劳动提供操作功能。但随着自主AI系统的发展，出现了能够执行操作功能的非人类因素，这挑战了传统生产理论，并导致现有制度安排(如雇佣合同)与新的经济现实不匹配。
AI.theoretical_framework: 柯布-道格拉斯生产函数、科斯的企业理论(企业作为劳动力协调者)、生产要素理论、资本与劳动的区分理论。
AI.method: 理论分析：扩展柯布-道格拉斯生产函数，引入合成劳动力(S)作为第三要素；理论推导：分析当S>0且L→0时的产出特性；制度分析：考察现有合同安排(雇佣和服务协议)与新的生产现实之间的不匹配。
AI.findings: 1. 引入合成劳动力(S)后，即使人类劳动力(L)趋近于零，产出仍可维持；2. 自主AI系统执行操作功能，而不仅仅是增强劳动力；3. 企业角色从劳动力协调者转变为资本配置者；4. 现有雇佣和服务协议不适合自主AI系统的获取，导致知识产权侵占、会计扭曲、激励错配和结构性债务等问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了柯布-道格拉斯生产函数，纳入合成劳动力作为第三生产要素；2. 重新定义了企业的本质：从科斯式的劳动力协调者转变为资本配置者；3. 为自主AI系统在生产中的角色提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提出了资本资产形成协议(CAFA)作为新的合同框架；2. CAFA将资产转移与集成劳动分离、平台与实施分离、资本对价与服务费用分离；3. 为企业在获取自主AI系统时提供了法律形式与经济实质相匹配的制度解决方案。

title: The Option Value of Work: Life-Span Uncertainty and the Geometry of Taxation
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: The Option Value of Work: Life-Span Uncertainty and the Geometry of Taxation
detail.abstract: This paper develops a new microfoundation for the Laffer curve by modeling labor supply as the exercise of a real option with stochastic maturity. Individuals are interpreted as holding an American call option on future consumption, while taxation places the government in the corresponding short-call position. As remaining lifetime becomes shorter or more uncertain, the option’s time value collapses and the curvature (gamma) of the utility function rises. This sharply increases labor-supply sensitivity to marginal tax rates and compresses the Laffer curve. The framework provides structural explanations for why aging economies face declining fiscal capacity, why health shocks trigger strong labor-supply responses, and why redistributive preferences vary systematically with demographic composition. The model unifies insights from public finance, life-cycle theory, and option pricing, and suggests new avenues for optimal taxation and policy design.

AI.tldr: 本文通过将劳动供给建模为具有随机到期日的实物期权，为拉弗曲线提供了新的微观基础。个人被视为持有未来消费的美式看涨期权，而税收使政府处于相应的空头看涨头寸。随着剩余寿命变短或更不确定，期权的时间价值崩溃，效用函数的曲率（gamma）上升，这显著增加了劳动供给对边际税率的敏感性，压缩了拉弗曲线。
AI.research_question: 如何从实物期权的角度为拉弗曲线提供新的微观基础？劳动供给如何被建模为具有随机到期日的期权？这种框架如何解释老龄化经济体的财政能力下降、健康冲击对劳动供给的影响以及再分配偏好随人口结构的变化？
AI.motivation: 传统拉弗曲线分析缺乏对个体劳动供给决策的微观基础，特别是在考虑寿命不确定性和老龄化问题时。需要一个新的理论框架来统一公共财政、生命周期理论和期权定价的见解，以解释现实世界中观察到的财政现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 实物期权理论：将劳动供给决策建模为美式看涨期权；2. 拉弗曲线理论：税收收入与税率的关系；3. 生命周期理论：个体在不同生命阶段的消费和劳动决策；4. 期权定价理论：时间价值、gamma等概念的应用。
AI.method: 理论建模方法：构建一个将劳动供给视为具有随机到期日的实物期权的理论模型。个人持有未来消费的美式看涨期权，政府通过税收处于空头看涨头寸。分析期权时间价值随剩余寿命变化的影响，以及效用函数曲率的变化如何影响劳动供给弹性。
AI.findings: 1. 随着剩余寿命变短或更不确定，期权的时间价值崩溃，效用函数的曲率（gamma）上升；2. 这显著增加了劳动供给对边际税率的敏感性；3. 拉弗曲线因此被压缩；4. 该框架解释了老龄化经济体财政能力下降的原因；5. 解释了健康冲击引发强烈劳动供给反应的现象；6. 解释了再分配偏好随人口结构系统性变化的原因。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为拉弗曲线提供了新的微观基础；2. 将实物期权理论引入劳动供给分析；3. 统一了公共财政、生命周期理论和期权定价的见解；4. 提出了一个解释财政能力随人口结构变化的统一框架；5. 为最优税收和政策设计开辟了新途径。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 解释了为什么老龄化经济体面临财政能力下降；2. 解释了为什么健康冲击会引发强烈的劳动供给反应；3. 解释了为什么再分配偏好会随人口结构系统性变化；4. 为政策制定者提供了设计最优税收政策的新视角；5. 有助于理解人口结构变化对财政可持续性的影响。

title: AI-Driven Structural Speed Mismatch and Systemic Failure in Socio-Technical Systems: Toward a Multi-Layer Learning Paradigm

detail.title: AI-Driven Structural Speed Mismatch and Systemic Failure in Socio-Technical Systems: Toward a Multi-Layer Learning Paradigm

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests that could have influenced the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, patients, or identifiable personal data. Ethics approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
Why do socio-technical systems increasingly exhibit persistent instability even as their technical components demonstrate rapidly improving learning and adaptive capacity? This paper addresses this question by reframing systemic failure as a structural coordination problem rather than a collection of isolated technological or institutional deficiencies.

 

The central argument is that AI-driven acceleration intensifies pre-existing asymmetries in learning speed across cognitive, technical, and institutional layers. While each layer continues to adapt according to its own internal logic, their characteristic temporal dynamics diverge, progressively undermining cross-layer consistency. Under such conditions, localized optimization or governance adjustments remain structurally insufficient to restore system-wide stability.

 

To analyze this dynamic, the paper introduces a Multi-Layer Learning Paradigm (MLLP), which conceptualizes socio-technical systems as coupled learning structures composed of heterogeneous layers with distinct rates of adaptation. System stability is defined in terms of the sustained alignment of these layers over time. The analysis identifies recurring structural failure patterns that emerge when learning speeds remain persistently misaligned, including cognitive fragmentation, diminishing effectiveness of technical interventions, and institutional lag in absorbing accumulated deviations.

 

The contribution of this paper is to provide a unified structural explanation for why the expansion of AI-related capabilities may coincide with systemic instability, by interpreting such failures as endogenous outcomes of asymmetric learning dynamics across layers.

AI.tldr: 论文提出多层级学习范式(MLLP)，解释AI驱动的加速如何加剧认知、技术和制度层之间的学习速度不对称，导致系统性不稳定，而非孤立的技术或制度缺陷。
AI.research_question: 为什么社会技术系统在技术组件学习和适应能力快速提升的同时，却表现出日益持久的不稳定性？
AI.motivation: AI能力扩展与系统性不稳定同时出现的矛盾现象需要解释，传统孤立分析技术或制度缺陷的方法不足以解释这种系统性失败。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多层级学习范式(MLLP)：将社会技术系统概念化为具有不同适应速率的异质层级组成的耦合学习结构。
AI.method: 理论分析框架，通过MLLP模型分析层级间学习速度不对称的动态机制。
AI.findings: AI驱动的加速加剧了认知、技术和制度层之间的学习速度不对称；当学习速度持续错配时，会出现认知碎片化、技术干预效果减弱、制度滞后吸收累积偏差等结构性失败模式；局部优化或治理调整在结构上不足以恢复系统稳定性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了统一的结枃解释框架，将系统性失败重新定义为结构性协调问题而非孤立缺陷；将AI相关能力扩展与系统性不稳定联系起来，解释为层级间不对称学习动态的内生结果。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了局部优化和治理调整的局限性；为设计更有效的跨层级协调机制提供理论基础；帮助决策者理解系统性不稳定的结构性根源。

title: In the Shadow of Bank Runs: Lessons from the Silicon Valley Bank Failure and Its Impact on Stablecoins
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System and Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: In the Shadow of Bank Runs: Lessons from the Silicon Valley Bank Failure and Its Impact on Stablecoins

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: Stablecoins are crypto-assets designed to maintain a stable value against a reference asset, typically the U.S. Dollar. The peg to the dollar is supported by the assets that back the stablecoin. Stablecoins perform dollar-like functions in decentralized finance (DeFi) and represent a run-able liability for their issuers.

AI.tldr: 稳定币是旨在维持与美元等参考资产价值挂钩的加密资产，其锚定由储备资产支持，在去中心化金融中发挥类似美元的功能，对发行方构成可挤兑负债。
AI.research_question: 稳定币作为加密资产如何维持与美元的锚定，其储备资产支持机制如何运作，以及在去中心化金融中的功能角色和发行方风险是什么？
AI.motivation: 随着稳定币在加密货币市场和去中心化金融中日益重要，需要理解其锚定机制、功能角色和潜在风险，特别是对发行方构成的挤兑风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于资产支持理论、货币功能理论和金融挤兑理论，分析稳定币的锚定机制、在DeFi中的货币功能以及发行方负债风险。
AI.method: 概念分析框架，结合稳定币的技术特征、储备资产机制和DeFi生态系统功能进行理论分析。
AI.findings: 稳定币通过储备资产支持维持美元锚定，在DeFi中发挥交易媒介、价值储存和记账单位等货币功能，但对发行方构成可挤兑负债风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了加密资产理论，提出了稳定币作为可挤兑负债的分析框架，丰富了数字货币功能理论在DeFi环境中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为稳定币发行方提供风险管理建议，为DeFi参与者理解稳定币功能提供指导，为监管机构制定稳定币政策提供理论依据。

title: Information Spillover Across Credit Products
affiliations: The University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign

detail.title: Information Spillover Across Credit Products
detail.abstract: I examine how the economies of scale in credit card lending affect mortgage lending via the spillover of information gathered from credit card operations. I find that a one standard deviation increase in the number of credit cards per capita increases mortgage origination by 10.2% and decreases interest rates by 16.6 bps. I show that the increase in the supply of mortgage loans is unlikely to be driven by an inflow of retail deposits or a change in mortgage market power. Additionally, I find that the reduction in interest rate is about three times as large for borrowers who have existing credit cards with their mortgage lenders than those who do not. Collectively, my results are consistent with the hypothesis that information gathered from credit card operations reduces the uncertainty faced by lenders and thereby increases the supply of credit in the mortgage market.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现信用卡业务的规模经济通过信息溢出效应影响抵押贷款市场：信用卡普及率提高一个标准差，抵押贷款发放量增加10.2%，利率降低16.6个基点，且这种效应主要源于信用卡运营收集的信息减少了贷款人的不确定性。
AI.research_question: 信用卡业务的规模经济如何通过信息溢出效应影响抵押贷款市场？具体而言，信用卡运营收集的信息如何影响抵押贷款的供给和定价？
AI.motivation: 理解金融中介机构不同业务线之间的协同效应，特别是信息收集活动如何跨产品线产生溢出价值。信用卡业务作为重要的消费者数据来源，可能为其他信贷产品（如抵押贷款）提供有价值的信息优势。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信息经济学和金融中介理论，特别是关于信息不对称、规模经济和跨产品信息溢出的理论框架。信用卡业务的信息收集可以减少贷款人对借款人信用风险的不确定性。
AI.method: 实证分析，使用信用卡普及率作为关键解释变量，考察其对抵押贷款发放量和利率的影响。通过排除替代解释（如零售存款流入或市场力量变化）来验证信息溢出机制，并比较有/无信用卡关系的借款人的利率差异。
AI.findings: 1. 信用卡普及率提高一个标准差，抵押贷款发放量增加10.2%，利率降低16.6个基点；2. 这种效应不是由零售存款流入或抵押贷款市场力量变化驱动的；3. 对于在抵押贷款机构已有信用卡的借款人，利率降幅是其他借款人的三倍。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为金融中介机构跨产品信息溢出提供了实证证据；2. 阐明了信用卡业务规模经济对抵押贷款市场的传导机制；3. 丰富了关于信息不对称在信贷市场作用的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为金融机构整合不同业务线的信息提供了商业依据；2. 为监管机构理解金融产品间的相互关联提供了参考；3. 帮助借款人理解建立长期银行关系的信息价值。

title: Sectoral Analysis of Brics Countries in Perspective of Export Trade: Empirical Evidences
affiliations: Guru Ghasidas Vishwavidyalaya - Department of Commerce

detail.title: Sectoral Analysis of Brics Countries in Perspective of Export Trade: Empirical Evidences
detail.abstract: BRICS-a collaboration of Brazil, Russia, India, China and South Africa, world's largest developing economies. These countries with the aid of their resources, agrarian wealth and a burgeoning service sector are metamorphosing to be the leading exporters in the world market. The paper analyses the sectoral cffect of cconomic, social and political dimensions on the cxports of these countries. The analysis has been donc tvith the help of Panel Data Analysis, which is further examined on two criteria-REM and FEM.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了金砖国家（巴西、俄罗斯、印度、中国、南非）经济、社会和政治维度对出口的部门影响，使用面板数据分析方法，通过随机效应模型和固定效应模型进行检验。
AI.research_question: 金砖国家的经济、社会和政治维度如何影响其不同部门的出口表现？
AI.motivation: 金砖国家作为世界最大的发展中经济体，凭借其资源、农业财富和蓬勃发展的服务业，正在成为世界市场的主要出口国。了解影响这些国家出口表现的多维度因素对于理解其经济发展和全球贸易格局至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于国际贸易理论、经济发展理论和制度理论，研究探讨经济因素（如资源禀赋、产业结构）、社会因素（如人力资本、社会制度）和政治因素（如政策环境、治理质量）对出口的影响机制。
AI.method: 采用面板数据分析方法，对金砖五国（巴西、俄罗斯、印度、中国、南非）的部门出口数据进行实证分析。研究使用随机效应模型（REM）和固定效应模型（FEM）两种方法进行检验，以控制国家特定效应和时间效应。
AI.findings: 研究发现经济、社会和政治维度对金砖国家的出口表现有显著影响，但影响程度和方向因部门而异。不同模型（REM和FEM）的检验结果可能揭示出国家特定因素的重要性。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了国际贸易理论在发展中国家特别是金砖国家的应用，提供了多维度（经济、社会、政治）分析框架，丰富了面板数据方法在出口研究中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金砖国家的政策制定者提供实证依据，帮助识别影响不同部门出口的关键因素，为促进出口多样化和竞争力提升提供政策建议，对其他发展中国家也有借鉴意义。

title: Multi-Cloud Security Architectures: AI and Machine Learning Applications

detail.title: Multi-Cloud Security Architectures: AI and Machine Learning Applications

The research was carried out independently and without any external pressures or relationships that may be perceived as affecting the outcomes.

detail.abstract: The rapid adoption of multi-cloud architectures has transformed the way organizations manage their IT infrastructure, offering scalability, flexibility, and cost efficiency. However, this shift introduces significant security challenges, particularly concerning data protection, threat detection, and access management. Traditional security models often fall short in multi-cloud environments, where data is spread across various providers and platforms. This paper explores the integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) technologies into multi-cloud security architectures. We examine how AI and ML can enhance the detection of security threats, improve risk management, and automate responses across disparate cloud platforms. By reviewing existing applications, challenges, and advancements, we provide insights into how AI and ML are transforming multi-cloud security and discuss future directions for research and implementation.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了在多云环境中整合人工智能和机器学习技术以增强安全性的方法，分析了AI/ML如何改善威胁检测、风险管理和自动化响应，并讨论了现有应用、挑战及未来研究方向。
AI.research_question: 人工智能和机器学习技术如何有效整合到多云安全架构中，以增强威胁检测、风险管理和自动化响应能力？
AI.motivation: 多云架构的快速采用带来了可扩展性、灵活性和成本效益，但也引入了数据保护、威胁检测和访问管理等方面的重大安全挑战。传统安全模型在多云环境中往往不足，因为数据分散在多个云服务提供商和平台之间。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于多云安全架构理论，结合人工智能和机器学习在网络安全领域的应用框架，探讨AI/ML如何增强多云环境中的安全防护能力。
AI.method: 通过文献综述方法，回顾和分析现有的AI/ML在多云安全中的应用案例、面临的挑战以及技术进展，提供综合性的见解。
AI.findings: AI和ML技术能够显著增强多云环境中的安全威胁检测能力，改善风险管理流程，并实现跨不同云平台的自动化安全响应。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了AI/ML增强多云安全的理论框架，为多云环境下的安全架构设计提供了新的理论视角，填补了传统安全模型在多云环境中的不足。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供了将AI/ML技术整合到多云安全架构中的实用指导，包括威胁检测、风险管理和自动化响应的具体实施方案，并指出了未来研究和实践的方向。

title: HEALTH INDICATOR PREDICTIONS
affiliations: University of Texas at Austin

detail.title: HEALTH INDICATOR PREDICTIONS
detail.abstract: This study investigates the ability of machine learning models, specifically neural networks and tree-based classification, to predict the likelihood of being healthy versus having a disease using a dataset comprising 100,000 surveyed individuals, based on lifestyle, biometric, behavioral, and demographic factors. Despite applying feature scaling and data preprocessing to the dataset, the models were unable to predict with high accuracy whether individuals were healthy or diseased based on the input features provided. The findings accentuate the importance of rich and comprehensible feature input and effective data integration in enhancing prediction accuracy. These results have further been compared to existing studies, such as those by Kim et al. (2024) and Effiok et al. (2022), which link predictive models to real patient data, demonstrating that real-world scenarios require richer, more diverse, and comprehensive input data.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用机器学习模型（神经网络和树基分类）基于生活方式、生物特征、行为和人口统计学因素预测10万调查个体的健康状况，但模型预测准确率不高，强调了丰富可理解的特征输入和有效数据集成的重要性。
AI.research_question: 机器学习模型（特别是神经网络和树基分类）能否基于生活方式、生物特征、行为和人口统计学因素准确预测个体的健康状况（健康vs患病）？
AI.motivation: 探索机器学习在健康预测中的应用潜力，了解当前基于调查数据的预测模型的局限性，为改进健康预测模型提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 机器学习预测理论、健康风险评估模型、特征工程理论、数据质量对预测性能的影响理论。
AI.method: 使用包含10万调查个体的数据集，应用神经网络和树基分类模型，进行特征缩放和数据预处理，评估模型预测健康vs患病的准确性。
AI.findings: 尽管进行了数据预处理，模型仍无法基于提供的输入特征高精度预测个体健康状况，表明当前特征集不足以支持准确的健康预测。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 实证验证了特征丰富性和可理解性对健康预测模型性能的关键影响；2. 揭示了调查数据在健康预测中的局限性；3. 为改进健康预测模型的特征工程提供了理论指导。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为健康预测系统开发提供了数据质量要求的具体指导；2. 强调了需要更丰富、更多样化的输入数据；3. 为医疗健康领域的机器学习应用提供了实践启示。

title: Citing the Unseen: AI Hallucinations in Tax and Legal Practice a Comparative Analysis of Professional Responsibility, Procedural Legitimacy, and Sanctions
affiliations: Texas A&M University (TAMU), School of Law

detail.title: Citing the Unseen: AI Hallucinations in Tax and Legal Practice a Comparative Analysis of Professional Responsibility, Procedural Legitimacy, and Sanctions
detail.abstract: Advances in generative AI have ushered sophisticated tools into tax and legal practice. These tools can hallucinate, fabricating citations, quotations or factual assertions that appear plausible yet are entirely false. In Mata v. Avianca, U.S. attorneys relying on ChatGPT filed a brief containing fictitious case law and were sanctioned. Such incidents expose significant risks for professionals who rely on AI without thorough verification. By late 2025 a survey of court records and disciplinary actions documented nearly 800 AI‑related citation errors across at least 25 countries. These cases include filings by lawyers and pro se litigants as well as orders drafted by judges. This article examines how courts and administrative bodies worldwide have responded to AI‑generated hallucinations in tax and legal submissions and decisions. It compares sanction regimes and remedial measures in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, India, Israel and other jurisdictions. The analysis highlights emerging verification standards under existing procedural rules and professional‑conduct codes. It assesses how courts treat different actors, lawyers, self‑represented parties, experts and judges, and how tax and legal doctrines are adapting to the challenges posed by unreliable AI outputs. The paper also considers legislative reforms and bar‑association guidance aimed at mitigating AI risks.

AI.tldr: 本文研究全球法院和行政机构如何应对税务和法律文件中AI生成的内容幻觉问题，比较不同司法管辖区的制裁制度和补救措施，分析新兴的验证标准以及法律职业如何适应不可靠AI输出带来的挑战。
AI.research_question: 全球法院和行政机构如何应对税务和法律文件中AI生成的内容幻觉问题？不同司法管辖区如何通过制裁制度、补救措施和专业行为准则来规范AI在司法实践中的使用？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI在税务和法律实践中的广泛应用带来了内容幻觉风险，如Mata v. Avianca案中律师因依赖ChatGPT提交包含虚构判例法的文件而受到制裁。截至2025年底，全球已记录近800起AI相关引用错误，涉及律师、自诉当事人甚至法官起草的命令，暴露了专业人士未经充分验证就依赖AI的重大风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文基于法律程序规则、职业行为准则、司法裁量权理论以及技术责任分配框架，分析AI幻觉在不同司法体系中的法律后果和责任归属。
AI.method: 采用比较法研究方法，分析美国、加拿大、英国、印度、以色列等多个司法管辖区的法院记录、纪律处分案例、立法改革和律师协会指南，考察不同行为主体（律师、自诉当事人、专家、法官）的责任认定标准。
AI.findings: 研究发现：1）全球已出现近800起AI相关引用错误；2）不同司法管辖区对AI幻觉的制裁制度存在差异；3）现有程序规则和职业行为准则正在形成新的验证标准；4）法院对不同行为主体的责任认定标准不同；5）税务和法律原则正在适应不可靠AI输出的挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献：1）构建了AI幻觉在司法实践中的责任分析框架；2）提出了跨司法管辖区比较的制裁制度分类学；3）发展了法律职业适应新兴技术的理论模型；4）为技术责任分配提供了法律视角的分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献：1）为法律专业人士提供AI使用的最佳实践指南；2）为法院和行政机构制定AI验证标准提供参考；3）为立法改革和律师协会指导提供实证基础；4）帮助不同司法管辖区相互借鉴应对AI风险的经验。

title: Unethical Factors Contributing To Nigeria's Economic Underdevelopment: Analysis From An Islamic Perspective
affiliations: Federal University Gashua, National Hajj Commission of Nigeria – NAHCON and UNIVERSITY OF ILORIN

detail.title: Unethical Factors Contributing To Nigeria's Economic Underdevelopment: Analysis From An Islamic Perspective
detail.abstract: If the human and natural resources a country is endowed with are the yardsticks for its greatness and development, it is undisputable that Nigeria is destined to be great. However, in the global economy system today, Nigeria is conspicuously located in the periphery of the periphery despite its abundant resources. This is attributed to various unethical factors like mismanagement of resources and large-scale embezzlement that have hindered its development and contributed to its economic backwardness. This paper explores these factors. It relies on both primary and secondary sources of data. Viewing ethics and  unethical practices from an Islamic perspective, it argues that unethical practices which Islam strongly prohibits have been normalized in Nigeria's economic and sociopolitical milieu. This consequently worsens the country's economic woes with little prospect for redemption. It observes that serious attention has not been paid to how these factors undermine development. Drawing on some verses of the Qur'an and prophetic traditions, this paper analyzes how revenue should be generated, utilized, and geared towards economic development. It concludes that economic practices in Nigeria are, in most cases, a departure from Islamic ethical principles of economics despite the fact that, demographically, the Muslims are the majority. These ethics, if observed, benefit not only the Muslims but the country. To liberate the country from the clutches of underdevelopment, this paper strongly recommends that Islamic ethics should be mainstreamed in government activities - particularly in law making, budgeting, policy formulation, and policy execution. This consideration will greatly help to revamp the economy and enhance development.

AI.tldr: 本文从伊斯兰伦理视角分析尼日利亚经济落后的原因，指出尽管尼日利亚资源丰富，但由于资源管理不善和大规模贪污等不道德行为，导致国家处于全球经济体系的边缘。论文建议将伊斯兰伦理纳入政府活动的各个方面以促进经济发展。
AI.research_question: 从伊斯兰伦理视角看，尼日利亚经济落后的主要因素是什么？如何通过伊斯兰伦理原则来改善尼日利亚的经济状况？
AI.motivation: 尼日利亚拥有丰富的人力和自然资源，本应成为伟大国家，但在全球经济体系中却处于边缘地位。这种矛盾现象源于各种不道德因素，如资源管理不善和大规模贪污，这些因素阻碍了国家发展并导致经济落后。
AI.theoretical_framework: 伊斯兰经济伦理框架，基于《古兰经》经文和先知传统，强调收入生成、利用和经济发展应符合伊斯兰伦理原则。
AI.method: 采用定性和文献研究方法，依赖一手和二手数据来源，从伊斯兰视角分析尼日利亚的经济和社会政治环境中的不道德实践。
AI.findings:
1. 伊斯兰强烈禁止的不道德行为在尼日利亚经济和社会政治环境中已被正常化
2. 这些不道德行为加剧了国家的经济困境，几乎没有改善前景
3. 尼日利亚的经济实践大多偏离伊斯兰经济伦理原则，尽管穆斯林占人口多数
4. 对这些因素如何破坏发展的关注严重不足
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 将伊斯兰经济伦理框架应用于现代国家发展问题的分析
2. 提供了从宗教伦理视角理解发展中国家经济困境的理论视角
3. 扩展了伊斯兰经济学在当代治理中的应用范围
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 强烈建议将伊斯兰伦理纳入政府活动的各个方面：立法、预算编制、政策制定和政策执行
2. 提出通过遵守伊斯兰伦理原则来振兴经济和促进发展的具体路径
3. 强调这些伦理原则不仅使穆斯林受益，也使整个国家受益

title: The OECD Pillar Two Global Minimum Tax: Foundations, Justification, and Sovereignty Challenges
affiliations: Texas A&M University (TAMU), School of Law

detail.title: The OECD Pillar Two Global Minimum Tax: Foundations, Justification, and Sovereignty Challenges
detail.abstract: This analysis examines the OECD’s Pillar Two framework, which establishes a global 15% minimum corporate tax to address tax competition and profit shifting. It traces the evolution of international tax governance from pre-globalisation physical presence rules to the rise of intangible asset mobility, and explores the shift from BEPS 1.0 to BEPS 2.0. The paper discusses theoretical justifications rooted in economic rent theory and details the structure and mechanisms of the Global Anti‑Base Erosion (GloBE) rules, including model rules, safe harbours, identification of multinational enterprise groups, and effective tax rate calculations. It analyses the unified fiscal subject approach and policy‑based exclusions and assesses their impact on tax sovereignty. The study addresses special considerations for U.S.‑parented MNEs, adjustments from accounting income, and the influence of covered taxes on effective rates. It examines the allocation of taxing rights through the ordering of Qualified Domestic Minimum Top‑Up Taxes (QDMTTs), Income Inclusion Rules (IIR), and Undertaxed Profits Rules (UTPR), and evaluates risks of enforcement fragmentation. The paper compares residence and source jurisdiction interests, highlighting revenue distribution disparities and fiscal autonomy constraints, particularly for developing economies. It concludes by discussing potential reforms and long‑term sovereignty trade‑offs, stressing the need for broad participation and robust enforcement to sustain global tax cooperation.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了OECD支柱二框架，该框架建立了全球15%的最低企业税率以应对税收竞争和利润转移。文章追溯了国际税收治理的演变，探讨了从BEPS 1.0到BEPS 2.0的转变，分析了全球反税基侵蚀规则的结构机制，评估了对税收主权的影响，并讨论了潜在改革和长期主权权衡。
AI.research_question: OECD支柱二框架（全球15%最低企业税）如何影响国际税收治理和税收主权？
AI.motivation: 应对全球税收竞争和利润转移问题，解决跨国公司通过无形资产流动性避税的行为，建立更公平的国际税收体系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济租金理论、国际税收治理理论、税收主权理论、BEPS（税基侵蚀和利润转移）框架
AI.method: 政策分析、制度演变分析、机制结构分析、比较分析（居住国与来源国利益对比）
AI.findings: 支柱二框架通过GloBE规则建立了全球最低税机制，但存在税收主权约束、执行碎片化风险、发展中国家财政自主权受限等问题，收入分配存在不平等。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对国际税收治理演变的理解，分析了经济租金理论在最低税政策中的应用，探讨了税收主权与全球税收合作的理论平衡。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了支柱二框架实施的详细分析，识别了执行风险，提出了改革建议，强调了广泛参与和有效执行对全球税收合作的重要性。

title: The OECD Pillar Two Global Minimum Tax: Foundations, Mechanisms, and Implementation Challenges (2023)
affiliations: Texas A&M University (TAMU), School of Law

detail.title: The OECD Pillar Two Global Minimum Tax: Foundations, Mechanisms, and Implementation Challenges (2023)
detail.abstract: This paper analyzes the OECD’s Pillar Two global minimum tax initiative, anchored in the GloBE Model Rules that ensure multinational enterprises pay at least a 15 percent effective tax rate. It examines key mechanisms including the income inclusion rule (IIR), undertaxed profits rule (UTPR), and qualified domestic minimum top‑up taxes (QDMTTs), as well as the carve‑outs such as the substance‑based income exclusion and incentives like qualified refundable and marketable transferable tax credits. The paper reviews the EU’s Directive 2022/2523, U.S. legislative proposals, Asia‑Pacific QDMTTs, and the Subject to Tax Rule multilateral instrument signed in September 2024. It discusses implementation challenges, including integration with domestic laws, divergent adoption across jurisdictions, compliance complexity, and long‑term threats posed by tax‑credit schemes. The paper concludes that broad participation and robust enforcement are critical for the sustainability and effectiveness of Pillar Two.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了OECD支柱二全球最低税倡议，探讨其关键机制、实施挑战及可持续发展要求。
AI.research_question: 支柱二全球最低税倡议的关键机制、实施挑战及可持续发展条件是什么？
AI.motivation: 应对跨国公司避税问题，确保跨国企业支付至少15%的有效税率，防止税基侵蚀和利润转移。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于OECD支柱二框架的全球最低税理论，包括GloBE模型规则、税收协调理论、国际税收治理理论。
AI.method: 文献分析、政策文件审查、比较分析法，分析OECD、欧盟、美国及亚太地区的相关立法和政策。
AI.findings: 支柱二机制包括IIR、UTPR、QDMTT等关键规则，面临与国内法整合、司法管辖区采纳差异、合规复杂性等挑战，广泛参与和强有力执行对可持续性至关重要。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化对全球最低税机制的理论理解，分析税收协调与治理的理论框架，为国际税收政策研究提供理论参考。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供实施支柱二的实践指导，帮助企业理解合规要求，为国际税收协调提供操作建议。

title: The Pillar Two Regime in the Post-Implementation Era: Structural Mechanics and Geopolitical Fragmentation (2026)
affiliations: Texas A&M University (TAMU), School of Law

detail.title: The Pillar Two Regime in the Post-Implementation Era: Structural Mechanics and Geopolitical Fragmentation (2026)
detail.abstract: Pillar Two of the OECD/G20 Inclusive Framework establishes a global minimum effective tax rate of 15% via the Global Anti‑Base Erosion (GloBE) Model Rules. This paper examines the regime’s structural mechanics in the post‑implementation era of 2026. It argues that Pillar Two replaces the traditional benefit principle with coordinated fiscal cartels, and analyses key administrative developments in 2024‑2025 such as the OECD’s June 2024 guidance on securitization vehicles and deferred tax liabilities, and the September 2024 signing of the Subject to Tax Rule multilateral instrument. The paper compares the European Union’s harmonized transposition through Directive 2022/2523 with defensive Qualified Domestic Minimum Top‑Up Taxes in Asia‑Pacific, illustrated by Vietnam’s Decree 236/2025. It concludes that while Pillar Two curbs rate‑based tax competition, its sustainability is threatened by compliant subsidies like Marketable Transferable Tax Credits and emerging normative divergences under the UN Convention on International Tax Cooperation.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了OECD/G20包容性框架支柱二（全球最低税）在2026年实施后的结构机制，认为其用协调的财政卡特尔取代了传统的受益原则，并探讨了2024-2025年的关键行政发展、欧盟与亚太地区的实施差异，以及该制度面临的可持续性挑战。
AI.research_question: 支柱二全球最低税制度在2026年实施后的结构机制如何运作？其实施面临哪些行政和规范挑战？不同地区（欧盟与亚太）的实施差异如何？该制度的长期可持续性如何？
AI.motivation: 随着OECD/G20包容性框架支柱二（全球最低有效税率15%）即将在2026年全面实施，需要深入分析这一全球税收治理重大变革的结构机制、实施进展和面临的挑战，为政策制定者和企业提供前瞻性见解。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 财政卡特尔理论：支柱二被视为协调的财政卡特尔，取代传统的受益原则
2. 全球税收治理理论：分析多边税收协调机制
3. 制度比较理论：比较欧盟统一实施与亚太地区防御性国内最低税的实施差异
AI.method:
1. 制度分析法：分析支柱二的结构机制和行政发展
2. 比较研究法：比较欧盟指令2022/2523与亚太地区（如越南第236/2025号法令）的实施差异
3. 文献分析法：分析OECD 2024年6月关于证券化工具和递延税负债的指南，以及2024年9月签署的"受制于税收规则"多边文书
4. 案例研究法：以越南为例分析亚太地区的实施情况
AI.findings:
1. 支柱二成功抑制了税率竞争，但形成了协调的财政卡特尔
2. 2024-2025年关键行政发展包括证券化工具指南和STTR多边文书签署
3. 欧盟通过指令统一实施，而亚太地区采取防御性国内最低税策略
4. 制度可持续性面临合规补贴（如可转让税收抵免）和联合国国际税收合作公约下的规范分歧威胁
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出支柱二代表从受益原则向财政卡特尔的理论转变
2. 发展了全球税收协调机制的理论框架
3. 为多边税收治理的制度比较提供理论视角
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为企业提供2026年后全球最低税实施的路线图
2. 为政策制定者提供不同实施模式的比较分析
3. 识别制度可持续性的关键风险因素
4. 为跨国企业税务规划提供实践指导

title: Preliminary Injunctions, Settlement, and Error-Locking
affiliations: University of Alabama

detail.title: Preliminary Injunctions, Settlement, and Error-Locking

publicationDetails.detailsText: U of Alabama Legal Studies Research Paper Forthcoming
publicationDetails.journalName: University of Alabama School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: When plaintiffs seek preliminary injunctions, courts provide early signals about case merits that shape settlement negotiations. I analyze how the accuracy of these signals affects litigation outcomes. Denial and grant both affect settlement, but asymmetrically. Denial weakens the plaintiff's bargaining position and increases settlement-the plaintiff accepts less favorable terms. Grant strengthens the plaintiff's position and decreases settlement-the plaintiff rejects settlement. The denial effect dominates, so more informative preliminary rulings promote settlement overall. This creates a tension with social welfare, however. False denials are locked in by settlement; false grants are self-corrected at trial. Courts focused on clearing dockets may deny preliminary injunctions too often, accepting higher error costs to achieve marginal gains in settlement. When defendant care is endogenous, denial-heavy standards also undermine deterrence. The framework provides guidance for ongoing debates about preliminary injunction standards in patent, antitrust, and other areas.

AI.tldr: 法院初步禁令裁决的准确性影响诉讼结果：拒绝禁令会削弱原告谈判地位并促进和解，而批准禁令会加强原告地位并减少和解。拒绝效应占主导，因此更准确的初步裁决总体上促进和解，但可能与社会福利存在冲突。
AI.research_question: 法院初步禁令裁决的准确性如何影响诉讼结果和和解行为？
AI.motivation: 初步禁令裁决为案件提供了早期信号，这些信号影响当事人的和解谈判，但现有研究对这些信号准确性的影响了解不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于博弈论和诉讼经济学框架，分析初步禁令裁决作为信号机制如何影响当事人的策略性行为和和解决策。
AI.method: 理论模型分析，通过构建博弈论框架来推导初步禁令裁决准确性对和解概率和诉讼结果的影响。
AI.findings: 拒绝和批准禁令对和解有不对称影响：拒绝削弱原告谈判地位并增加和解（原告接受不利条款），批准加强原告地位并减少和解（原告拒绝和解）。拒绝效应占主导，因此更准确的初步裁决总体上促进和解。但存在社会福利冲突：错误拒绝通过和解被锁定，而错误批准可在审判中自我纠正。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了初步禁令裁决作为信号机制影响诉讼结果的理论框架，揭示了拒绝和批准禁令的不对称效应，以及准确性、和解和社会福利之间的权衡关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为专利、反垄断等领域的初步禁令标准争议提供指导，指出法院为清理案件可能过度拒绝禁令，接受更高错误成本以获取边际和解收益，当被告注意水平内生时，过度拒绝的标准也会削弱威慑效果。

title: The Evolution of Environmental Rights in Pennsylvania
