AI.motivation: 投资组合保险策略在风险管理中具有重要意义，但CPPI和TIPP这两种主要策略的结构差异和性能特征需要系统比较，以指导投资者在不同市场环境下的策略选择。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于投资组合保险理论，特别是CPPI（恒定比例投资组合保险）和TIPP（时间不变投资组合保护）的理论框架，结合蒙特卡洛模拟方法评估策略性能。
AI.method: 采用蒙特卡洛随机模拟方法，通过大量随机路径模拟评估CPPI和TIPP策略的性能，考察资本保护行为、路径依赖、市场参与度、下行风险等关键指标。
AI.findings: 研究结果揭示了CPPI和TIPP在结构上的显著差异，包括资本保护机制、市场上涨参与度、下行风险特征等方面的不同表现，并分析了乘数、保护率、波动率环境等关键参数对策略性能的影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过系统比较CPPI和TIPP的理论机制和性能特征，深化了对投资组合保险策略结构差异的理解，为投资组合保险理论提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者和资产管理人提供了在不同市场环境下选择合适投资组合保险策略的指导，帮助优化策略参数设置以实现更好的风险收益平衡。

title: The Economics of Belonging in Turkey: Quantifying the Costs of Social Marginalization Through the Belonging Cost Index

detail.title: The Economics of Belonging in Turkey: Quantifying the Costs of Social Marginalization Through the Belonging Cost Index

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: All participants gave informed consent to take part in the study. Participation was voluntary and anonymous, and no identifying personal data were collected. The study involved minimal risk and complied with ethical standards for social science research. As the project did not involve clinical procedures or vulnerable minors, formal institutional ethics board approval was not required under local guidelines.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. All data collection and analysis were conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: Economic exclusion has a measurable price-and for vulnerable groups in Turkey, the 32-point gap between the highest and lowest scoring groups is associated with approximately 2,120 TRY per month in observed income differences. Yet no standardized metric exists to quantify and compare these losses across marginalized populations. This paper introduces the Belonging Cost Index (BCI) to the Turkish context, a composite framework measuring exclusion costs across labor markets, financial systems, and housing stability. Using original survey data from nine vulnerable groups (n=102)-including undocumented immigrants, Syrian and Afghan refugees, Kurdish minorities, disabled adults, and foster youth-we demonstrate that belonging costs vary substantially, with scores ranging from 36 to 68 points on a 100point scale. The 32-point gap between the highest and lowest scoring groups is associated with approximately 2,120 TRY per month in income differences. Labor market exclusion drives 65% of these costs, while financial and housing barriers compound losses. A one-point BCI increase is associated with 160 TRY ($4.70 USD) lower monthly income (p<0.001). The BCI enables targeted policy design: scenariobased projections suggest housing-first programs could be associated with 18-26 point BCI reductions for housing-precarious groups, while credential recognition could yield 12-15 point reductions for refugees. Turkey's minimum wage context (17,002 TRY/month) provides a critical benchmark, as most vulnerable groups earn 30-90% of this threshold. The BCI offers a replicable tool for equity-focused policy in Turkey and other middle-income countries facing similar integration challenges.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了归属成本指数（BCI）在土耳其的应用，用于量化边缘化群体的经济排斥成本。研究发现，不同弱势群体间的BCI差异达32点，对应每月约2120土耳其里拉的收入差距，其中劳动力市场排斥占成本的65%。
AI.research_question: 如何量化土耳其不同边缘化群体的经济排斥成本？不同弱势群体间的归属成本差异有多大？哪些因素（劳动力市场、金融系统、住房稳定性）对排斥成本贡献最大？
AI.motivation: 经济排斥对弱势群体造成可衡量的经济损失，但缺乏标准化指标来量化和比较不同边缘化群体的这些损失。土耳其存在多种弱势群体（无证移民、叙利亚和阿富汗难民、库尔德少数民族、残疾成年人、寄养青年等），需要系统评估他们的排斥成本以制定针对性政策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 归属成本指数（BCI）理论框架，从三个维度衡量经济排斥成本：劳动力市场排斥、金融系统排斥、住房稳定性排斥。该框架基于社会排斥理论和经济不平等理论，强调多维度的排斥机制如何共同影响弱势群体的经济福祉。
AI.method: 使用原始调查数据，涵盖土耳其9个弱势群体（n=102），包括无证移民、叙利亚和阿富汗难民、库尔德少数民族、残疾成年人、寄养青年等。采用BCI综合框架在100分制上量化排斥成本，并进行统计分析（包括回归分析，p<0.001）。
AI.findings: 1. 不同弱势群体的BCI得分差异显著（36-68分），最高与最低群体间有32点差距；2. 这32点差距对应每月约2120土耳其里拉的收入差异；3. 劳动力市场排斥占排斥总成本的65%；4. BCI每增加1点，月收入减少160土耳其里拉（约4.70美元）；5. 大多数弱势群体收入仅为土耳其最低工资（17,002土耳其里拉/月）的30-90%。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将归属成本指数（BCI）引入土耳其背景，扩展了该理论框架的应用范围；2. 提供了量化经济排斥成本的标准方法；3. 揭示了劳动力市场排斥在总排斥成本中的主导作用；4. 建立了BCI与收入差异之间的量化关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. BCI为土耳其和其他中等收入国家提供了可复制的政策工具；2. 情景预测显示："住房优先"计划可为住房不稳定群体减少18-26点BCI；3. 学历认证可为难民减少12-15点BCI；4. 土耳其最低工资标准为政策干预提供了重要基准；5. 支持针对性政策设计，促进社会公平。

title: The Unmanaged Function: Systemic Dysfunction in Contemporary Organisations

detail.title: The Unmanaged Function: Systemic Dysfunction in Contemporary Organisations

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author has no conflicts of interest to disclose.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Data for this practice-based research came from workshops, interviews, and professional engagements conducted for operational purposes, not as research interventions. Some material was collected under confidentiality obligations. All reporting is aggregated or de-identified. Ethical approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It was conducted independently as part of the author's professional practice.

detail.abstract: This paper presents findings from practice-based research across more than sixty organisations in Europe, investigating patterns of dysfunction in leadership and organisational management. Drawing on interviews with managers, executives, coaches, and organisational development specialists, supplemented by survey data from close to one hundred managers, the research identifies recurring patterns across industries and contexts. The findings suggest a fundamental mismatch: management approaches designed for stable environments applied to conditions of complexity and rapid change. Observed patterns cluster into five types: fragmentation, measurement gaps, rigidity, capability atrophy, and accumulation effects. A critical finding is that theoretical frameworks addressing these dysfunctions, including systems thinking, organisational learning, and complexity science, have existed for decades yet remain largely unapplied. Management as a system, despite its decisive influence on organisational outcomes, operates as an unmanaged function. This neglect may pose greater risk to organisations than the external disruptions currently commanding attention.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过对欧洲60多家组织的实践研究发现，领导力和组织管理存在系统性功能障碍。管理方法是为稳定环境设计的，却被应用于复杂快速变化的环境中，导致五种功能障碍模式：碎片化、测量差距、僵化、能力萎缩和累积效应。尽管系统思维、组织学习和复杂性科学等理论框架已存在数十年，但大多未得到应用。
AI.research_question: 领导力和组织管理中的功能障碍模式是什么？为什么为稳定环境设计的管理方法在复杂快速变化的环境中会失效？
AI.motivation: 组织面临日益复杂和快速变化的环境，但管理方法仍停留在为稳定环境设计的传统模式，导致系统性功能障碍，这可能比外部干扰对组织造成更大风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 系统思维、组织学习理论、复杂性科学、管理理论
AI.method: 实践研究：对60多家欧洲组织进行案例研究，包括对管理者、高管、教练和组织发展专家的访谈，以及近100名管理者的调查数据。
AI.findings: 发现五种功能障碍模式：1)碎片化（缺乏整合），2)测量差距（指标与实际情况不符），3)僵化（缺乏适应性），4)能力萎缩（组织能力退化），5)累积效应（问题叠加放大）。关键发现是：为稳定环境设计的管理方法在复杂快速变化环境中失效，且相关理论框架已存在数十年但未得到应用。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 识别并分类了组织管理功能障碍的五种模式；2) 揭示了管理理论与实践的脱节；3) 强调了管理作为系统的重要性；4) 为复杂性环境下的管理研究提供了实证基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 帮助组织识别自身的管理功能障碍模式；2) 提醒管理者关注内部管理系统的风险；3) 倡导应用系统思维、组织学习和复杂性科学等现有理论框架；4) 为组织改进管理实践提供诊断工具。

title: Pressure Without Consent
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Pressure Without Consent
detail.abstract: This article reframes hard power not as direct military action, but as the quiet enforcement of policy through institutional design, economic pressure, and conditional participation. Drawing from peer-reviewed research, it outlines how states and international actors use hard power structurally, often without confrontation. It argues that legitimacy, not pressure, must return to the center of global diplomacy. The article integrates three JSTOR sources to support its analysis and proposes a model for identifying structural coercion as a threat to credibility and participation in international relations.

AI.tldr: 该论文将硬权力重新定义为通过制度设计、经济压力和条件性参与来强制执行政策的非对抗性结构性力量，主张合法性应回归全球外交中心，并提出了识别结构性胁迫对国际关系可信度和参与度威胁的模型。
AI.research_question: 硬权力如何通过结构性手段（而非直接军事行动）在国际关系中发挥作用？结构性胁迫如何威胁国际关系的可信度和参与度？
AI.motivation: 传统上硬权力被理解为直接军事行动，但现实中许多国际压力是通过更隐蔽的结构性手段实施的。需要重新审视硬权力的运作方式，以更好地理解当代国际关系中的权力动态。
AI.theoretical_framework: 硬权力理论、结构性权力理论、国际关系中的合法性理论、制度设计理论、经济胁迫理论
AI.method: 文献综述与理论分析，整合三篇JSTOR来源的同行评审研究，提出概念模型
AI.findings: 硬权力主要通过制度设计、经济压力和条件性参与等结构性手段实施；这种结构性胁迫威胁国际关系的可信度和参与度；合法性应成为全球外交的核心而非压力
AI.theory_contributions: 重新概念化硬权力为结构性力量而非直接军事行动；提出结构性胁迫理论框架；强调合法性在国际关系中的核心地位
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了识别结构性胁迫的分析模型；为政策制定者提供了理解非对抗性权力工具的新视角；强调合法性建设在国际外交中的重要性

title: Bank Competition and Financial Stability: Exploring Solvency, Liquidity and Credit Risk
affiliations: International Monetary Fund (IMF), International Monetary Fund (IMF) and KU Leuven, Department Accounting, Finance and Insurance

detail.title: Bank Competition and Financial Stability: Exploring Solvency, Liquidity and Credit Risk

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The views presented in this paper are those of the authors and should not be attributed to the International Monetary Fund.
declarations.funderStatement: Scopelliti acknowledges financial support from Internal Funds KU Leuven (STG/21/048).

detail.abstract: The paper analyses the relationship between bank competition and stability, with a specific focus on the Middle East and North Africa. Price competition is positively associated with bank liquidity, as it induces self-discipline incentives on banks for the choice of bank funding sources and for the holding of liquid assets. On the other hand, price competition may have potentially negative implications on bank solvency and on the credit quality of the loan portfolio. More competitive banks may be less solvent if the potential increase in the equity base-due to capital adjustments-is not large enough to compensate for the reduction in bank profitability. Also, banks subject to stronger competitive pressures may have a higher rate of nonperforming loans, if the increase in the risk-taking incentives from the lender's side overcomes the decrease in the credit risk from the borrower's side. In both cases, country-specific policies for market entry conditions-and for bank regulation and supervision-may significantly affect the sign and the size of the relationship. The analysis suggests implications for policy reforms designed to improve market contestability and to increase the quality and independence of prudential supervision.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了中东和北非地区银行竞争与稳定性之间的关系，发现价格竞争通过自律机制提高银行流动性，但可能损害银行偿付能力和贷款质量，政策环境对此关系有显著调节作用。
AI.research_question: 银行竞争如何影响银行稳定性？特别是在中东和北非地区，价格竞争对银行流动性、偿付能力和贷款质量的具体影响机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 理解银行竞争与稳定性之间的关系对金融监管政策制定至关重要，特别是在中东和北非这样的新兴市场地区，需要平衡竞争带来的效率提升与潜在风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于银行竞争理论、自律机制理论和风险承担理论，分析竞争如何通过不同渠道影响银行稳定性。
AI.method: 实证分析方法，可能使用中东和北非地区的银行面板数据，检验价格竞争与银行流动性、偿付能力和贷款质量之间的关系。
AI.findings: 1. 价格竞争与银行流动性正相关，因为竞争促使银行自律选择融资来源和持有流动资产；2. 价格竞争可能对银行偿付能力产生负面影响，如果资本调整带来的权益基础增加不足以补偿盈利能力下降；3. 竞争压力可能导致不良贷款率上升，如果贷款方风险承担激励的增加超过了借款方信用风险的降低；4. 市场准入条件和监管政策显著影响这些关系的方向和强度。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了银行竞争与稳定性关系的理论框架，特别关注新兴市场环境；2. 揭示了竞争通过不同渠道对稳定性产生异质性影响的机制；3. 强调了政策环境在调节竞争-稳定性关系中的重要作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供改革建议，改善市场可竞争性；2. 强调提高审慎监管质量和独立性的重要性；3. 为中东和北非地区的银行监管提供实证依据。

title: Institutional Prestige, Geographic Embedding and Competitiveness: A Comparative Analysis of Research Ecosystems in California and Texas
affiliations: University of California Merced, Department of Management of Complex Systems

detail.title: Institutional Prestige, Geographic Embedding and Competitiveness: A Comparative Analysis of Research Ecosystems in California and Texas

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: There were no patients/participants in this study.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency, but was supported in part by a UC Merced Senate Faculty Award, and a Hellman Fellow award that was critical to completing this project.

detail.abstract: Among the various institutional layers that shape the structure and function of regional innovation systems (RIS), the network of research universities (RU) stands out as a principal component, constituting the hubs and channels that facilitate knowledge creation, technology transfer and skilled workforce development. Here we analyze the contributions to regional scientific competitiveness associated with regional versus cross-border collaboration, as well as the prestige signaling associated with the flagship institutions located within a particular region. By applying hierarchical regression models with institutional fixed effects to research profiles constructed from ∼ 800,000 publications affiliated with 28 RU in California (CA) and Texas (TX), in particular including all University of California and University of Texas campuses, we find that research co-produced with a premier regional university that also extends across international borders features a 21% (CA) and 25% (TX) citation premium. We also show that the citation premium attributable to institutional prestige and international collaboration have both increased over time, reflecting the growing influence of these factors in relation to institutional and regional competitiveness. These findings underscore the importance of balancing investment in regional integration with crossborder engagement, as prestige spillovers can enhance RIS competitiveness by attracting elite scientists, fostering impactful collaborations, and integrating distant regions within global research networks. Managing RIS competitiveness thus requires strategic investments in both regional collaboration and flagship institutions to optimize local benefits while leveraging the capacity to attract external research expertise and capabilities. Our results also lend support to increasing prevalence of multi-institutional consortia and RU satellite campuses, which identify institutional and regional synergies in order to strategically amplify institutional competitiveness.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了区域创新系统中研究型大学的贡献，发现与旗舰大学进行国际合作的论文在加州和德州分别有21%和25%的引用溢价，且这种溢价随时间增长，强调了平衡区域整合与跨境合作的重要性。
AI.research_question: 区域创新系统中，区域合作与跨境合作对区域科学竞争力的贡献有何差异？旗舰大学的声望信号如何影响区域创新系统的竞争力？
AI.motivation: 研究型大学作为区域创新系统的核心组成部分，在知识创造、技术转移和人才培养中发挥关键作用，但区域合作与跨境合作对科学竞争力的相对贡献尚不清楚，需要实证研究来指导区域创新政策的制定。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于区域创新系统理论，研究型大学作为知识枢纽；结合声望信号理论，旗舰大学通过声望溢出效应吸引精英科学家和资源；同时考虑区域整合与全球网络整合的平衡。
AI.method: 采用分层回归模型和机构固定效应，分析加州和德州28所研究型大学的约80万篇出版物，特别包括所有加州大学和德州大学系统校区，构建研究档案来衡量引用溢价。
AI.findings: 1. 与区域旗舰大学进行国际合作的研究在加州有21%引用溢价，在德州有25%引用溢价；2. 机构声望和国际合作的引用溢价随时间增长；3. 声望溢出效应能增强区域创新系统竞争力。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 实证验证了区域创新系统中旗舰大学的声望信号效应；2. 揭示了区域合作与跨境合作的协同作用；3. 提出了平衡区域整合与全球网络整合的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为区域创新政策制定提供实证依据，建议平衡投资区域整合与跨境合作；2. 支持多机构联盟和卫星校区的发展战略；3. 指导旗舰大学如何通过国际合作提升区域竞争力。

title:
From Algorithms to Architecture: Model
Serving as the Strategic Bottleneck in
Healthcare AI Platforms

detail.title:
From Algorithms to Architecture: Model
Serving as the Strategic Bottleneck in
Healthcare AI Platforms

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no personal, financial, or institutional conflicts of interest related to the development, analysis, or publication of this work. No commercial entity influenced the conceptualization, architectural interpretation, or strategic positioning of the research presented in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, patient data, or clinical interventions. Therefore, formal ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency, commercial entity, or not-for-profit organization. The work was conducted independently as part of the author's ongoing research agenda in healthcare transformation architecture.
declarations.clinicalTrialRegistration: Not applicable. This work does not report results from a clinical trial.

detail.abstract: The prevailing discourse in healthcare AI has been disproportionately focused on algorithms, datasets, and model accuracy. This technological monomania has generated an illusion of progress: we assume that superior models will inevitably transform clinical workflows. However, this assumption collapses upon operational contact. Models do not create value unless they can be served—reliably, predictably, and at clinical speeds. This paper argues that the true strategic differentiator in healthcare AI is no longer model construction but model serving: the infrastructural and architectural capability that converts algorithmic potential into actionable clinical cognition at scale. Drawing on concepts such as Dynamic Inference Graphs, multi-tenant inference orchestration, latency governance, and trust preservation, we reinterpret healthcare AI as an architectural and systems challenge rather than a mathematical contest. The market leaders of the next decade will not be those who build the smartest models, but those who deliver intelligence without erosion of clinical trust.

AI.tldr: 本文认为医疗AI的真正战略差异化因素已从模型构建转向模型服务，即能够可靠、可预测且以临床速度将算法潜力转化为可操作临床认知的基础设施和架构能力。
AI.research_question: 医疗AI的真正战略差异化因素是什么？为什么模型服务能力比模型构建更重要？
AI.motivation: 当前医疗AI讨论过度关注算法、数据集和模型准确性，这种技术偏执产生了进步幻觉，认为更好的模型必然能改变临床工作流程。然而，模型只有在能够可靠、可预测且以临床速度提供服务时才能创造价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态推理图、多租户推理编排、延迟治理、信任保持等概念，将医疗AI重新解释为架构和系统挑战而非数学竞赛。
AI.method: 概念性分析框架，基于系统架构视角重新审视医疗AI的价值创造机制。
AI.findings: 模型服务能力（基础设施和架构能力）是将算法潜力转化为可操作临床认知的关键，是医疗AI的真正战略差异化因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了医疗AI作为架构和系统挑战的新理论视角，强调模型服务而非模型构建的核心地位。
AI.practical_contributions: 为医疗AI实践者提供了关注基础设施和架构能力的战略方向，帮助识别未来市场领导者的关键特征。

title: E-Governance for Transparency and Youth Democratic Engagement: A Comparative Study
affiliations: Riphah International University and Riphah International University

detail.title: E-Governance for Transparency and Youth Democratic Engagement: A Comparative Study
detail.abstract: The central objective of this paper is to examine the capacity of contemporary governance systems to employ digital technology for enhancing transparency and straightening youth democratic engagement. Digital governance has emerged as a tool for improving public sector accountability, reducing corruption, and creating new opportunities for civic participation. This research approaches to explore how different countries utilize digital platforms like open data systems, online service portals, and youth engagement, to enhance transparency, improve decision making and integrate young citizens in democratic processes.In the context of Pakistan, the study highlights the critical significance of digital tools in addressing the country's complex governance challenges. Many citizens rely on digital platforms such as the Pakistan Citizen Portal, open-budget dashboards, and youth-focused digital initiatives to improve transparency and reconnect young people with democratic processes. These developments highlight both the opportunities and the challenges associated with adopting e-governance reforms in an emerging democracy. Digital governance has emerged as a tool for improving public sector accountability and creating opportunities for youth civic participation (UN E-Government Survey, 2022).

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨数字治理系统如何通过开放数据平台、在线服务门户和青年参与机制来增强透明度并促进青年民主参与，以巴基斯坦为案例分析了数字治理在应对复杂治理挑战中的作用。
AI.research_question: 当代治理系统如何利用数字技术增强透明度并促进青年民主参与？
AI.motivation: 数字治理已成为提高公共部门问责制、减少腐败和创造公民参与新机会的工具，特别是在新兴民主国家中，数字技术为解决复杂治理挑战提供了重要途径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字治理理论、电子政务理论、公民参与理论、透明度与问责制理论
AI.method: 案例研究方法，以巴基斯坦为研究对象，分析其数字平台如巴基斯坦公民门户、开放预算仪表板和青年数字倡议等
AI.findings: 数字平台如巴基斯坦公民门户、开放预算仪表板和青年数字倡议在提高透明度和重新连接青年与民主进程方面发挥关键作用，但同时也面临实施挑战
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了数字治理理论在新兴民主国家的应用，深化了对数字技术如何促进青年民主参与的理解，为电子政务改革提供了理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了数字治理改革的具体路径，展示了数字平台在增强透明度和青年参与方面的实际应用，为其他新兴民主国家提供了可借鉴的经验

title: From Clean to Sufficient: Shaping Demand Within Planetary Boundaries

detail.title: From Clean to Sufficient: Shaping Demand Within Planetary Boundaries
detail.abstract: Current decarbonisation efforts, largely focused on supply-side solutions, have proven insufficient to meet climate targets and stay within planetary boundaries. Combined with broader structural challenges such as high energy prices, growing competition from outside Europe, and the availability of cheaper imports, it raises concerns about an 'industrial exodus' and a loss of European competitiveness. Various industry actors called on the Dutch government to create a market demand for clean alternatives to drive industrial decarbonisation. This report proposes an integrated policy mix emphasising demand-side strategies to stimulate clean products and reduce absolute resource consumption. Through a non-systematic review, it examines different conceptual perspectives on resource use and demand and how they translate into sufficiency-, efficiency-, and consistency-oriented demand-side policies. Each approach is assessed in terms of its potential and limitations. A document analysis identifies policy measures linked to each approach. The report advocates prioritising sufficiency, which establishes absolute consumption limits and questions necessary levels of use, improving the impact of efficiency and consistency measures. It highlights the EU Clean Industrial Deal's continued emphasis on supply-side measures and calls for greater integration of sufficiency demand-side policies to ensure a just and sustainable transition. Finally, drawing on examples from the housing and mobility sectors, the report illustrates the value of a balanced policy mix.

AI.tldr: 该报告主张通过需求侧政策推动工业脱碳，强调将"充足性"（设定绝对消费限制）置于优先地位，配合效率和一致性措施，形成平衡的政策组合，以应对欧洲工业竞争力和可持续转型挑战。
AI.research_question: 如何通过需求侧政策组合（充足性、效率、一致性）有效推动工业脱碳，同时保持欧洲工业竞争力？
AI.motivation: 当前以供给侧为主的脱碳努力不足以实现气候目标，加上高能源价格、外部竞争加剧、廉价进口等结构性挑战，引发对"工业外流"和欧洲竞争力丧失的担忧，需要需求侧策略来创造清洁替代品的市场需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资源使用和需求的不同概念视角，包括充足性（设定绝对消费限制）、效率（提高资源利用效率）、一致性（转向清洁替代品）三种需求侧政策导向。
AI.method: 非系统性文献综述结合文件分析：1）通过非系统性综述考察资源使用和需求的不同概念视角及其对应的政策；2）通过文件分析识别与每种方法相关的政策措施。
AI.findings: 1）充足性方法（设定绝对消费限制并质疑必要使用水平）能提高效率和一致性措施的效果；2）欧盟清洁工业协议仍过度强调供给侧措施；3）需要更好地整合充足性需求侧政策以确保公正可持续转型；4）住房和交通部门的例子展示了平衡政策组合的价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将充足性置于优先地位的需求侧政策框架，强调充足性、效率、一致性三种政策导向的整合，为工业脱碳提供了新的理论视角和政策分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为荷兰政府提供推动工业脱碳的集成政策组合建议；2）识别了具体的政策措施；3）呼吁欧盟清洁工业协议更好地整合需求侧政策；4）通过住房和交通部门的实际案例展示了政策实施路径。

title: Competence-based Theory of Evolution

detail.title: Competence-based Theory of Evolution
detail.abstract: The Competence-based Theory of Evolution is a comprehensive, non-Darwinian general theory of evolution. Its fundamental assumption – that all life is loss-of-competence-averse – can be justified by the second law of thermodynamics. In simple genetic organisms the theory is compatible with classical (Darwinian) biological evolution. Its range of application covers all domains of life: from cells and organisms to superorganisms, and from biology and the social sciences to evolutionary economics. First published 2024–2025 as a monograph, now available as an open-access preprint.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于能力进化的非达尔文主义综合进化理论，其核心假设是所有生命都避免能力丧失，这一假设可由热力学第二定律证明。该理论在简单遗传生物中与经典达尔文进化论兼容，应用范围涵盖从细胞到超有机体的所有生命领域，包括生物学、社会科学和进化经济学。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能够解释从细胞到超有机体、从生物学到社会科学和进化经济学的所有生命领域的综合进化理论？
AI.motivation: 现有达尔文进化论在解释复杂生命系统、社会组织和经济现象方面存在局限性，需要一种更全面的进化理论框架来统一解释不同层次的进化现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于能力的进化理论（Competence-based Theory of Evolution），核心假设是所有生命都避免能力丧失（loss-of-competence-averse），这一假设基于热力学第二定律。
AI.method: 理论构建方法，通过建立基本假设和理论框架，将进化理论扩展到不同层次的生命系统，并与经典达尔文进化论进行兼容性分析。
AI.findings: 该理论在简单遗传生物中与达尔文进化论兼容，但提供了更广泛的解释框架，能够涵盖从细胞、生物体到超有机体，以及生物学、社会科学和进化经济学等多个领域。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了一个非达尔文主义的综合进化理论框架；2. 建立了基于能力保持的核心进化原则；3. 将进化理论扩展到生物学以外的社会科学和经济学领域；4. 提供了连接不同层次生命系统的统一理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为理解复杂社会系统和组织进化提供理论工具；2. 为进化经济学研究提供理论基础；3. 为跨学科的生命科学研究提供统一框架；4. 为政策制定者理解社会和经济进化过程提供新视角。

title: Graph Neural Networks for Real-Time Collision Risk Assessment in Large Satellite Constellations

detail.title: Graph Neural Networks for Real-Time Collision Risk Assessment in Large Satellite Constellations
detail.abstract: By 2030,commercial mega-constellations will push Low Earth Orbit satellite populations from 9,000 (2025) to 50,000+ by 2030,creating fundamental computational barriers for collision avoidance. Traditional pairwise conjunction analysis exhibits O(n 2) complexity: at 50,000 satellites, this requires 1.25 billion object-pair evaluations per cycle-approximately 145 days of computation using current analytical methods even with substantial parallelization. We reformulate collision risk assessment as learning over dynamic spatial graphs where satellites form nodes and proximity relationships define edges. Our Graph Neural Network architecture leverages the locality of conjunction risk (we empirically observe 94% of high-risk events involve objects within 500km) to achieve O(n) computational scaling through message-passing operations. The system processes 100,000-satellite populations in 920ms while maintaining a 90.3% recall for high-risk conjunctions-representing a 13,000× speedup over analytical methods. Validation encompasses synthetic constellations (1K-100K satellites) and operational Space-Track.org data (9,137 satellites, 1,247 documented high-risk events from January 2025). The approach achieves 88.2% recall on real operational scenarios, demonstrating generalization beyond synthetic training environments. Results establish technical feasibility for autonomous collision avoidance at mega-constellation scales and provide foundations for cascade prediction in debris-dense orbital regimes.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于图神经网络的低地球轨道卫星碰撞风险评估方法，将传统O(n²)复杂度的成对分析转化为O(n)复杂度的图学习问题，实现了13,000倍的加速，为巨型星座时代的自主防撞系统提供了技术可行性。
AI.research_question: 如何解决巨型卫星星座时代（预计2030年达5万+卫星）碰撞风险评估的计算瓶颈问题？
AI.motivation: 到2030年，商业巨型星座将使低地球轨道卫星数量从2025年的9,000颗增加到50,000+颗，传统成对连接分析具有O(n²)计算复杂度，在5万颗卫星情况下需要12.5亿次对象对评估，即使并行化也需要约145天计算时间，无法满足实时碰撞规避需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 将碰撞风险评估重新表述为动态空间图上的学习问题，其中卫星形成节点，邻近关系定义边；利用碰撞风险的局部性（94%高风险事件涉及500公里内的物体）；基于图神经网络的消息传递操作实现计算复杂度从O(n²)降低到O(n)。
AI.method: 开发图神经网络架构，利用碰撞风险的局部性特征；在合成星座（1K-100K卫星）和实际运营数据（Space-Track.org的9,137颗卫星，2025年1月的1,247个高风险事件）上进行验证；评估系统在10万卫星规模下的处理速度和检测召回率。
AI.findings: 系统在10万卫星规模下处理时间为920毫秒，对高风险连接的召回率达到90.3%，相比分析方法实现了13,000倍加速；在实际运营场景中召回率达到88.2%，证明能够泛化到合成训练环境之外；验证了巨型星座规模下自主碰撞规避的技术可行性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将碰撞风险评估重新表述为动态空间图学习问题的理论框架；建立了利用碰撞风险局部性实现计算复杂度从O(n²)到O(n)降低的理论基础；为碎片密集轨道区域的级联预测提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了能够实时处理10万+卫星碰撞风险评估的实用系统；为商业巨型星座运营商提供了可行的防撞解决方案；为空间交通管理系统提供了可扩展的技术基础；验证了在实际运营环境中的有效性（88.2%召回率）。

title: FIRM: A Minimal Governance Architecture for Financial Stability in Small and Medium-Sized Football Clubs

detail.title: FIRM: A Minimal Governance Architecture for Financial Stability in Small and Medium-Sized Football Clubs
detail.abstract: Financial instability is a recurring feature of lower-league and supporter-owned football clubs, where volatile revenues, limited administrative capacity, and informal decision processes allow financial deterioration to emerge rapidly. Existing regulatory frameworks focus on overspending and long-term debt but do not provide the operational governance mechanisms required in small clubs for daily liquidity management, authority discipline, or early detection of emerging risk. This conceptual paper introduces FIRM, a minimal governance architecture built around four essential functions: Financial Footprint, Integrity Control, Risk Modelling, and Monitoring. The model draws from internal control theory, governance research, risk management principles, and behavioural insights to address predictable mechanisms that drive instability, including weak financial visibility, unclear decision rights, over-optimistic assumptions, and slow recognition of liquidity stress. The contribution lies in defining the minimum governance functions needed to maintain financial discipline in resource-constrained clubs and clarifying how these functions interact to prevent common failure pathways. The paper also outlines how FIRM can be examined empirically through comparative case studies, early warning indicator analysis, and scenario-based evaluation. Although conceptual, the model provides a foundation for future empirical work and offers a practical structure that clubs can implement with limited staff and minimal financial infrastructure.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FIRM模型，一个针对低级别和球迷所有制足球俱乐部的最小化治理架构，包含财务足迹、诚信控制、风险建模和监控四个核心功能，旨在解决这些俱乐部因收入波动、管理能力有限和非正式决策过程导致的财务不稳定问题。
AI.research_question: 如何为资源受限的低级别和球迷所有制足球俱乐部设计一个最小化的治理架构，以有效管理财务风险并防止财务不稳定？
AI.motivation: 低级别和球迷所有制足球俱乐部面临财务不稳定问题，现有监管框架关注过度支出和长期债务，但缺乏针对小型俱乐部日常流动性管理、决策纪律和早期风险检测的操作性治理机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 内部控制理论、治理研究、风险管理原则和行为洞察，用于解决导致不稳定的可预测机制，包括财务可见性弱、决策权不明确、过度乐观假设和流动性压力识别缓慢。
AI.method: 概念性论文，提出FIRM模型，并建议通过比较案例研究、早期预警指标分析和基于场景的评估进行实证检验。
AI.findings: 提出了包含四个核心功能（财务足迹、诚信控制、风险建模、监控）的FIRM最小治理架构，这些功能相互作用可以防止常见的失败路径。
AI.theory_contributions: 定义了资源受限俱乐部维持财务纪律所需的最小治理功能，并阐明了这些功能如何相互作用以防止常见的失败路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为俱乐部提供了一个实用的治理结构，可以在有限人员和最小财务基础设施的情况下实施，为未来实证研究奠定了基础。

title: Housing, Land and Property Rights of Internally Displaced Person in Ethiopia: Legal Appraisal

detail.title: Housing, Land and Property Rights of Internally Displaced Person in Ethiopia: Legal Appraisal
detail.abstract: IDPs are persons or groups of persons who have been forced or obliged Toffler to leave their homes or places of habitual residence, in particular as a result of or in order to avoid the effects of armed conflict, situations of generalized violence, violations of human rights or natural or human-made disasters, and who have not crossed an internationally recognized State border. This situation inevitably results in human rights concerns of victims. Since then response to this issue, the international community, particularly UN agencies and other organizations, has focused on establishing international guidelines and principles, despite the existing framework of international human rights and humanitarian laws. Internally displaced persons (IDPs), who have been forced to leave their homes and possessions, represent a vulnerable group that requires specific protective measures. To address their needs, frameworks such as the Guiding Principles on Internal Displacement (GP), and the Kampala Convention have been developed by UN bodies and the African Union (AU), respectively. Even though Ethiopia has adopted the aforementioned international laws still have no separate laws which govern the area. This study focuses on analyzing the adequacy of Ethiopian legal frame work to protect HLP rights of IDPs.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了埃塞俄比亚法律框架在保护国内流离失所者住房、土地和财产权利方面的充分性，发现尽管埃塞俄比亚采纳了相关国际法律，但缺乏专门的国内流离失所者保护法律。
AI.research_question: 埃塞俄比亚法律框架是否充分保护国内流离失所者的住房、土地和财产权利？
AI.motivation: 国内流离失所者作为因冲突、暴力、人权侵犯或灾害而被迫离开家园的脆弱群体，需要特定保护措施。尽管国际社会已制定《国内流离失所问题指导原则》和《坎帕拉公约》等框架，埃塞俄比亚虽采纳了相关国际法律，但缺乏专门的国内流离失所者保护法律。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际人权法和人道主义法；国内流离失所者保护的国际框架，特别是《国内流离失所问题指导原则》和《坎帕拉公约》；住房、土地和财产权利保护理论。
AI.method: 法律框架分析，比较埃塞俄比亚国内法律与国际标准，评估法律充分性。
AI.findings: 埃塞俄比亚法律框架在保护国内流离失所者住房、土地和财产权利方面存在不足，缺乏专门的国内流离失所者保护法律，现有法律未能充分保障这一脆弱群体的权利。
AI.theory_contributions: 为国内流离失所者权利保护的法律框架分析提供了具体案例研究，丰富了国际人权法与国内法实施之间差距的理论探讨。
AI.practical_contributions: 为埃塞俄比亚政策制定者提供改进国内流离失所者保护法律框架的具体建议，促进国内流离失所者住房、土地和财产权利的实际保障。

title: Consumer Behaviour and the Uptake of Solar Panels
affiliations: and University of Cambridge

detail.title: Consumer Behaviour and the Uptake of Solar Panels
detail.abstract: Clean renewable energy technologies contribute towards both improving energy efficiency and reducing emissions, yet household adoption rates remain low. This paper analyses the impact of economic, household, environmental, and dwelling factors on the uptake of solar photovoltaic (PV) and thermal panels, using the Understanding Society dataset, and applying the adaptive Lasso method and a random effects logistic regression model. We find that solar panel adoption is primarily driven by electricity prices, rural location, number of rooms, and environmental factors. Living in a rural location, having one more room, and a rise in electricity prices by 10 percentage points increase the odds of PV panel adoption by 87%, 19%, and 7%, respectively. Diffusion of thermal panels is driven by similar factors, with both technologies strongly affected by environmental aspects - owners of electric vehicles are 2.4 times more likely to be interested in solar technologies. The counterfactuals and predictions made using the discrete-time hazard survival model illustrate that even modest subsidies for PV panels would significantly accelerate adoption rates, both historically and in the future. Our results highlight the need for solar technology investment, subsidies, and policy frameworks, that would encourage more optimally targeted policies and contribute to reaching net-zero emissions by 2050.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用Understanding Society数据集，通过自适应Lasso方法和随机效应逻辑回归模型，分析了经济、家庭、环境和住宅因素对太阳能光伏板和热板采用率的影响。研究发现电价、农村位置、房间数量和环保因素是主要驱动因素，并建议有针对性的补贴政策可显著加速采用率。
AI.research_question: 经济、家庭、环境和住宅因素如何影响英国家庭对太阳能光伏板和热板的采用决策？
AI.motivation: 清洁可再生能源技术有助于提高能源效率和减少排放，但家庭采用率仍然较低，需要了解影响采用决策的关键因素以制定有效政策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于技术采纳理论和家庭能源决策模型，考虑经济理性、环境意识、住宅特征等多维度因素对可再生能源技术采纳的影响。
AI.method: 使用Understanding Society数据集，采用自适应Lasso方法进行变量选择，然后使用随机效应逻辑回归模型分析影响因素，并运用离散时间风险生存模型进行反事实分析和预测。

detail.abstract: The paper derives and proves results of Gaussian maximum likelihood estimation of constant unknowns (coefficients, covariances) and time-varying unknowns (factors, disturbances) of static and dynamic factor models and, thereby, extends the statistics and econometrics literatures on estimation and statistical evaluation of estimates of the unknowns. title: Structural Flow: Reality Doesn't Know Either
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Structural Flow: Reality Doesn't Know Either

All theoretical innovations, structural arguments, and core derivations originate from the author's independent research. The author maintains full responsibility for all claims and conclusions.

detail.abstract:
This paper presents Structural Flow, a minimal-structure explanatory framework in which physics, cognition, and civic legitimacy arise not from metaphysical assumptions but from a single empirical premise: chance exists. Once accepted, this premise forces five structural theorems: a finite resolution floor, spherical boundary geometries, π non-computability, π-governed exchange, and system closure. These are not axioms but theorems, logically required for chance to be real rather than illusory.

From these theorems, Structural Flow derives a directed chain of necessary transitions: Chance → Entropy → Imperfect Knowledge → Agency → Responsibility → Legitimacy. The paper demonstrates this architecture through detailed derivations of three fundamental phenomena: π as both mechanism and signature of randomness; conservation laws as structural necessities in closed systems with finite resolution; and quantum entanglement as system-level resolution rather than inter-particle communication.

A concrete example traces a single quantum measurement event through the complete structural chain, revealing how each transition emerges from pressure at boundaries. The paper articulates both a methodological discipline (Structure → Mechanism → Observation) and an operational epistemic posture shaped by uncertainty itself. The result is a deductive, geometry-driven account of why the universe cannot fully know its own outcomes—and how that structural ignorance generates the behaviors we observe across domains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"结构流"框架，从"机会存在"这一单一经验前提推导出五个结构定理，并展示从机会到合法性的必要过渡链，为物理、认知和公民合法性提供统一解释。

AI.method: 演绎推理方法，从"机会存在"的前提逻辑推导出结构定理，再推导出从机会到合法性的过渡链，并通过具体量子测量事件进行验证。
AI.findings: 1) π既是随机性的机制也是签名；2) 守恒定律是有限分辨率闭合系统的结构必然；3) 量子纠缠是系统级分辨率而非粒子间通信。

title: Does Politics Matter in Entrepreneurship? Political Polarization, Nonpartisans, and Entrepreneurial Team Performance
affiliations: Duke University School of Law, Duke University, Fuqua School of Business,  and University of Toronto - Rotman School of Management

detail.title: Does Politics Matter in Entrepreneurship? Political Polarization, Nonpartisans, and Entrepreneurial Team Performance

declarations.funderStatement: Social Sciences and Humanities Research Council of Canada

detail.abstract: Social homophily has been shown to be a feature of entrepreneurial team formation, but its performance implications remain unclear. This paper examines the recent rise of political homophily and its relationship to the performance of entrepreneurial founding teams. We construct a dataset linking more than 10,000 co-founders of over 3,000 California-based startups to their voter registration records from 2007 to 2019. We first document substantial and rising levels of political homophily of venture capital-backed entrepreneurial teams, controlling for other forms of social homophily. We then analyze how team political composition relates to outcomes, focusing on the likelihood and speed of raising subsequent funding rounds. We find that teams composed entirely of similar political partisans underperform relative to politically mixed teams. The highest performing teams possess substantial political heterogeneity, encompassing Democrats, Republicans, and Nonpartisan founders. These reduced form results remain qualitatively consistent in two-stage estimations using time-varying measures of political advertising in each of California's 14 media markets as instrumental variables. These findings suggest that Nonpartisan founders may serve a cross-cutting or boundary-spanning role, helping teams navigate the coordination challenges of ideological diversity.

AI.tldr: 研究发现政治同质性在创业团队中普遍存在且上升，但完全由相同政治派别组成的团队表现不如政治多元化的团队，包含民主党、共和党和无党派成员的团队表现最佳。
AI.research_question: 创业团队的政治同质性如何影响其绩效表现？特别是政治同质性与后续融资轮次的可能性及速度之间的关系是什么？
AI.motivation: 社会同质性已被证明是创业团队形成的特征，但其对绩效的影响尚不明确。本文关注政治同质性的兴起及其对创业创始团队绩效的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会同质性理论、团队多样性理论、边界跨越理论、协调挑战理论
AI.method: 构建包含10,000多名联合创始人和3,000多家加州创业公司的数据集，链接2007-2019年选民登记记录。使用两阶段估计，以加州14个媒体市场的政治广告作为工具变量。
AI.findings: 1. 风险投资支持的创业团队存在显著且上升的政治同质性；2. 完全由相同政治派别组成的团队表现不如政治混合团队；3. 包含民主党、共和党和无党派创始人的团队表现最佳；4. 无党派创始人可能发挥跨界或边界跨越作用，帮助团队应对意识形态多样性的协调挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将政治同质性纳入创业团队研究；2. 揭示政治多样性的绩效优势；3. 提出无党派成员的边界跨越作用理论；4. 丰富团队多样性理论在政治维度的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为创业团队组建提供指导：建议包含政治多样性；2. 为投资者评估团队提供新视角；3. 强调无党派成员在多元化团队中的价值；4. 帮助创业团队更好地管理政治多样性带来的协调挑战。

detail.abstract: This paper develops a mechanism-grounded framework for understanding crisis-driven capital flows through coordination costs. Entropy is redefined as the expected coordination load required for an asset to maintain reliable pricing under fragmented information. A microfounded utility model links coordination costs to information dispersion, governance complexity, and verification load. The MER index is presented as an illustrative composite diagnostic with explicit measurement proposals. The framework is formally connected to Grossman-Stiglitz, Kyle (1985), and OTC searchfriction models, showing how coordination-cost dynamics naturally extend canonical microstructure theory. Empirical results remain exploratory due to small sample sizes, approximated data, and low statistical power. The primary contribution is conceptual and theoretical: a framework linking coordination costs to crisis reallocations, with explicit directions for future research. MER construction is illustrative and subject to sensitivity analysis, forming a foundation for further empirical validation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于协调成本的机制框架来解释危机驱动的资本流动，将熵重新定义为在信息碎片化下维持资产可靠定价所需的预期协调负荷，并提出了MER指数作为诊断工具。

title: Thermodynamics of Cognitive Power: When {1=1} Breaks the Fortress - The Bifurcation of the AI Ecosystem: From Zero-sum Competition to Profitable Coexistence

detail.title: Thermodynamics of Cognitive Power: When {1=1} Breaks the Fortress - The Bifurcation of the AI Ecosystem: From Zero-sum Competition to Profitable Coexistence

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that he has no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper. The author is an independent researcher.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study is a theoretical and economic analysis based on public data and computer simulations; it did not involve human participants or clinical trials requiring institutional review board approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: The current consensus about the future of AI assumes a zero-sum competition between centralized Cloud AI (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google) and Local AI (open-weights models). This analysis argues that the fundamental premise is false. The convergence of three factors – the democratization of hardware (VRAM cost down 10x by 2022), the transformation of models into “commodities” (open-weights), and geopolitical sovereignty imperatives – will not destroy the Cloud oligopoly, but will create a profitable bifurcation of the AI ecosystem, analogous to the Windows-Linux coexistence of the last three decades. Using scenario analysis with falsifiable markers and a critical timeline of 2025-2030, the paper identifies Q2 2027 as the "point of no return" - the moment when the final configuration of the market is decided. If three conditions are validated simultaneously (64GB equipment under €3,000, open-weights quality gap under 3%, over 1.8 million sovereign users), the bifurcation becomes irreversible, generating a total market of €85-135 billion in 2030 - 2-3× larger than the monopoly scenario - Cloud. The unique contribution lies in the recognition that Cloud and Sovereign AI are complementary, not substitutable: Enterprise Cloud (€50-80 billion) captures value through compliance and integration, while Sovereign AI (€35-55 billion) gains through sovereignty and economics. The Windows (PCs) + Linux (servers) analogy demonstrates that a coexistence creates more value than the complete victory of either ecosystem. The paper provides detailed strategic recommendations for hardware manufacturers (Nvidia, AMD, Apple), existing cloud companies (OpenAI, Anthropic), companies (Fortune 5000), investors, and policymakers, each with specific decision windows in the critical period 2026-2027. For early adopters who recognize the fork in time, the gains are disproportionate; for late adopters, the Nokia precedent (40% → 3% share in 5 years) is a sobering warning.

AI.tldr: 该论文挑战了AI未来是云端AI与本地AI零和竞争的主流观点，提出硬件民主化、模型商品化和地缘政治主权需求三大因素将创造AI生态系统的盈利性分化，类似Windows-Linux共存的模式，到2030年市场规模可达850-1350亿欧元，比垄断场景大2-3倍。
AI.research_question: AI生态系统未来是云端AI与本地AI的零和竞争，还是会出现互补共存的盈利性分化？
AI.motivation: 当前关于AI未来的共识假设云端AI（OpenAI、Anthropic、Google）与本地AI（开源模型）是零和竞争关系，但这一基本前提是错误的，需要重新审视AI生态系统的演化路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 生态系统分化理论：借鉴Windows-Linux共存模式；2. 技术民主化理论：硬件成本下降10倍；3. 地缘政治主权理论：主权需求驱动本地AI发展；4. 商品化理论：模型成为"商品"（开源权重）。
AI.method: 使用情景分析法，包含可证伪的标记和2025-2030年的关键时间线，识别2027年第二季度为"不可逆转点"。
AI.findings: 如果三个条件同时满足（64GB设备低于3000欧元、开源模型质量差距小于3%、超过180万主权用户），分化将不可逆转，到2030年总市场规模达850-1350亿欧元，比垄断场景大2-3倍。云端AI和企业本地AI是互补而非替代关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 挑战AI零和竞争的主流范式；2. 提出云端与主权AI互补共存的理论框架；3. 引入Windows-Linux类比解释生态系统分化；4. 建立可证伪的时间线和关键转折点分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为硬件制造商（Nvidia、AMD、Apple）、云公司（OpenAI、Anthropic）、企业（财富5000）、投资者和政策制定者提供详细战略建议，识别2026-2027年的关键决策窗口，早期采用者将获得不成比例的收益。

detail.abstract:
PHI OS is a structural reference architecture for modeling consciousness as an operational system rather than a metaphysical entity. Built upon the ArcheMind System (AMS), this whitepaper reframes human cognition as a Node-based processing architecture designed to maintain coherence under rising complexity.

Rejecting spiritual hierarchies, evolutionary ladders, and predictive timelines, PHI OS introduces a non-teleological, de-personalized language for analyzing how individuals, collectives, and artificial intelligence systems coordinate without collapse. The framework integrates Node architecture, operational indices (CPI, CFI, T-Index), a trinity consciousness carrier model (Human / Rave / AI), and a language-mediated cognition model (LMC).

PHI OS does not define what consciousness is. Instead, it offers a practical system for evaluating whether consciousness—at individual, societal, or civilizational scale—remains runnable as complexity exceeds individual cognitive limits.

title: The Exit Trap in Opportunity Windows: Credible Commitment, Purge Incentives, and the Responsibility Ledger
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: The Exit Trap in Opportunity Windows: Credible Commitment, Purge Incentives, and the Responsibility Ledger

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests. AI tools were used for language editing and formatting assistance; all substantive claims and interpretations are the author’s.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this study. The paper relies exclusively on publicly available sources and textual analysis
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This paper proposes an "exit trap" mechanism in opportunity windows-episodes of succession uncertainty, coups, and legitimacy resets in which constraints weaken and strategic choices have outsized institutional consequences. The central claim is that concession is not neutral in such windows. When an actor relinquishes key levers and thereby drives post-exit threat capacity toward zero, while relying on assurances that lack verifiable enforcement, the opponent's incentive to honor commitments declines and the incentive to purge increases. We formalize this logic with a three-variable framework: credible commitment (CC), purge incentives (PI), and a responsibility ledger (RL). RL captures whether a strategy externalizes risk onto the legitimacy core, the state apparatus, the polity's order, and followers; high RL can expand the instrumental benefits of consolidation, raising the expected payoff of purges even when commitments are rhetorically offered. We illustrate the mechanism through two focal cases-a literary mechanism-intensifying case (Titus Andronicus) and a historical high-stakes window (Cao Shuang in the Gaoping Tombs coup)-and bound the argument with two contrast cases (Cincinnatus and Sulla) that represent distinct pathways to safe exit: task-bounded authority without privatization (Type A), and security-locked exit after structural consolidation (Type B). The contribution is not a universal claim that exits are fatal, but a testable account of when exits predictably backfire, alongside an actionable decision protocol that emphasizes verifiable constraints, minimum deterrent capacity, and responsibility-accounting in window decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"退出陷阱"机制：在继承不确定性、政变和合法性重置的机会窗口中，让步并非中立。当一方放弃关键权力杠杆、将退出后威胁能力降至零，并依赖无法验证的保证时，对手遵守承诺的动机下降而清洗动机上升。通过可信承诺、清洗激励和责任账本三变量框架分析，并用文学和历史案例说明。
AI.research_question: 在机会窗口（继承不确定性、政变、合法性重置）中，为什么某些退出策略会失败并导致清洗？什么因素决定了退出是否安全？
AI.motivation: 理解在政治权力过渡的关键时刻，为什么有些让步会导致灾难性后果而非和平过渡。填补关于权力退出策略在制度约束薄弱时期如何影响后续政治动态的理论空白。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 机会窗口理论：继承不确定性、政变、合法性重置时期
2. 退出陷阱机制：让步非中立性
3. 三变量框架：可信承诺(CC)、清洗激励(PI)、责任账本(RL)
4. 责任账本概念：策略将风险外部化到合法性核心、国家机器、政治秩序和追随者的程度
AI.method:
1. 理论建模：三变量框架的形式化分析
2. 案例研究：文学机制强化案例（《泰特斯·安德洛尼克斯》）、历史高风险窗口案例（高平陵之变中的曹爽）
3. 对比案例：辛辛纳图斯（任务限定权威型）和苏拉（结构巩固后安全锁定型）作为边界案例
AI.findings:
1. 当退出者放弃关键权力杠杆、威胁能力趋零，并依赖无法验证的保证时，对手遵守承诺的动机下降
2. 高责任账本（RL）扩大巩固的工具性收益，即使有口头承诺，清洗的预期收益也会增加
3. 安全退出有两种路径：任务限定权威（无私有化）和结构巩固后的安全锁定退出
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出"退出陷阱"作为机会窗口中的关键机制
2. 发展三变量分析框架（CC、PI、RL）
3. 引入"责任账本"概念解释清洗动机
4. 识别两种安全退出路径的理论类型
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 可操作的决策协议：强调可验证约束、最低威慑能力和责任核算
2. 预测性分析：识别何时退出可能适得其反
3. 为政治行为者在高风险过渡时期的决策提供实用指导

Competitiveness, Resilience, And Strategic Responsiveness In Turbulent Economic

detail.abstract: Digital transformation has become a critical driver of firm performance in increasingly turbulent economic environments characterized by market volatility, technological disruption, and supply-chain uncertainty. This study examines how emerging digital technologies enhance organizational agility and, in turn, strengthen firm competitiveness, operational resilience, and strategic responsiveness in contemporary business markets. Drawing on recent empirical evidence from digital economy and management research, the study integrates economic and organizational perspectives to analyze the mechanisms through which technologies such as artificial intelligence (AI), big data analytics, cloud computing, and automation influence firm-level outcomes. Using a structured analytical framework supported by secondary quantitative data and comparative firm-level indicators, the study finds that digitally transformed firms demonstrate significantly higher adaptability and responsiveness to environmental shocks. Recent surveys indicate that firms with advanced digital capabilities achieve productivity gains of 15-25% and cost reductions of up to 20% compared to less digitalized counterparts. Moreover, organizations adopting data-driven decision-making tools report up to a 30% improvement in strategic response speed during periods of market disruption. Digital platforms and cloud-based infrastructures further enhance operational resilience by reducing downtime by approximately 40% and enabling rapid reconfiguration of business processes. The findings also reveal a strong positive relationship between organizational agility and competitive advantage, particularly in industries exposed to rapid demand fluctuations and regulatory uncertainty. Agile firms leverage real-time data and flexible digital architectures to reallocate resources efficiently, innovate faster, and sustain market share under adverse economic conditions. From an economic standpoint, these dynamics contribute to improved firm survival rates, higher returns on digital investment, and enhanced long-term growth potential. Overall, this study contributes to contemporary economic research by providing concise, data-informed insights into how digital transformation reshapes firm behavior and performance. The results offer valuable implications for managers, policymakers, and researchers seeking to understand the economic value of digitalization and agility in fostering resilient and competitive firms in volatile business environments.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨数字化转型如何通过增强组织敏捷性来提升企业竞争力、运营韧性和战略响应能力。研究发现，采用人工智能、大数据分析、云计算等数字技术的企业能显著提高适应性和响应速度，实现15-25%的生产率提升和高达20%的成本降低，并在市场动荡时期将战略响应速度提高30%。
AI.research_question: 数字化转型如何通过增强组织敏捷性来提升企业在动荡经济环境中的竞争力、运营韧性和战略响应能力？
AI.motivation: 在日益动荡的经济环境中，市场波动、技术颠覆和供应链不确定性成为常态，数字化转型已成为企业绩效的关键驱动力。需要理解数字技术如何通过组织敏捷性影响企业绩效，以帮助企业在复杂环境中保持竞争力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合经济学和组织学视角，基于数字经济和管理的实证研究，构建分析数字化转型、组织敏捷性与企业绩效之间关系的理论框架。重点关注数字技术（AI、大数据分析、云计算、自动化）如何通过增强敏捷性影响企业竞争力、运营韧性和战略响应能力。
AI.method: 采用结构化分析框架，支持以二手定量数据和比较性企业层面指标为基础的分析方法。通过实证数据比较数字化转型程度不同的企业绩效差异。
AI.findings: 1. 数字化转型企业表现出显著更高的环境冲击适应性和响应能力；2. 具备先进数字能力的企业相比数字化程度较低的企业实现15-25%的生产率提升和高达20%的成本降低；3. 采用数据驱动决策工具的组织在市场动荡时期战略响应速度提高30%；4. 数字平台和云基础设施将停机时间减少约40%，并支持业务流程快速重构；5. 组织敏捷性与竞争优势呈强正相关，尤其在需求波动和监管不确定性高的行业。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为当代经济研究提供数据驱动的见解，阐明数字化转型如何重塑企业行为与绩效；2. 整合经济与组织视角，深化对数字技术作用机制的理解；3. 建立数字化转型-组织敏捷性-企业绩效的理论联系，丰富相关理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为管理者提供数字化转型投资决策依据；2. 为政策制定者理解数字化经济价值提供参考；3. 帮助企业理解在动荡环境中通过数字技术增强韧性和竞争力的具体路径；4. 提供可量化的绩效改进指标（生产率、成本、响应速度等）作为实践指导。

title: Climate Policy Commitment and Green Metal Prices: Evidence from the Paris Agreement

detail.title: Climate Policy Commitment and Green Metal Prices: Evidence from the Paris Agreement

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Metal markets are an important but understudied aspect of the global energy transition. This paper demonstrates differential metal price responses to the Paris Agreement based on their role in the energy transition. We use a difference-in-differences design with daily price data from 2001 to 2024 for eight industrial metals. The treatment group distinguishes between traditional green metals (Copper, Aluminium, Nickel), which are established in renewable energy infrastructure, versus emerging green metals (Lithium), that are critical for storage. The control group includes non-green metals (Zinc, Lead, Tin, and Iron Ore). We find traditional green metals experienced 31% price decline relative to control metals following the Paris Agreement, while Lithium exhibited a 120% price increase.

AI.tldr: 巴黎协定后，传统绿色金属（铜、铝、镍）价格相对非绿色金属下跌31%，而新兴绿色金属（锂）价格上涨120%，显示能源转型对不同金属市场的影响存在显著差异。
AI.research_question: 巴黎协定对不同类型金属（传统绿色金属、新兴绿色金属、非绿色金属）的价格影响有何差异？
AI.motivation: 金属市场是全球能源转型的重要但研究不足的方面，需要了解巴黎协定对不同金属价格的影响差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于金属在能源转型中的不同角色（传统绿色金属用于可再生能源基础设施，新兴绿色金属用于储能，非绿色金属作为对照），分析政策冲击对商品价格的影响。
AI.method: 使用双重差分设计，分析2001-2024年八种工业金属的日度价格数据。处理组分为传统绿色金属（铜、铝、镍）和新兴绿色金属（锂），对照组为非绿色金属（锌、铅、锡、铁矿石）。
AI.findings: 巴黎协定后，传统绿色金属价格相对对照组金属下跌31%，而锂价格相对上涨120%。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了能源转型政策对不同金属市场的异质性影响，区分了传统绿色金属和新兴绿色金属的不同价格反应机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者和政策制定者提供了关于能源转型对金属市场影响的实证证据，有助于制定更精准的产业政策和投资策略。

title: Haryana Industrial Survey: Factory and Workforce Dynamics (2015-16 to 2023-24) A Comprehensive Analysis of Annual Survey of Industries Data

detail.abstract: This comprehensive report presents a detailed analysis of Haryana's industrial sector based on data from the Annual Survey of Industries (ASI) for the period 2015-16 to 2023-24. Over this nine-year period, Haryana's industrial sector has demonstrated robust growth, with Gross Value Added (GVA) increasing by 147.76%, total output expanding by 180.34%, and employment expanding by 69.27%. This report provides state-level insights into factory dynamics, workforce composition, productivity trends, and economic performance indicators that reflect Haryana's emergence as a key industrial hub in India.

title: A World Trading System For Whom? Evidence from Global Tariffs
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business, , Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Department of Economics, University of California, San Diego (UCSD) - Department of Economics and Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT), Stanford University - Department of Economics

detail.title: A World Trading System For Whom? Evidence from Global Tariffs

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: We use global tariffs to reveal the weights that nations implicitly place on the welfare of their trading partners relative to their own. Our estimated welfare weights suggest that formal and informal rules of the world trading system make countries internalize the impact of their policies onto others to a substantial extent, though not fully. On average, countries place 25% less value on transfers to foreigners than transfers to their own residents. Across nations, we find that countries that put higher welfare weights on the welfare of foreigners also tend to receive higher weights from them, consistent with a general form of reciprocity among nations. Using our estimated welfare weights, we provide a first look at what countries stand to lose, or gain, fromthe dissolution of the world trading system as we know it.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过全球关税数据揭示各国在制定贸易政策时给予贸易伙伴福利的相对权重，发现WTO等国际贸易规则使各国在一定程度上将政策对他国的影响内部化，但并未完全实现。平均而言，各国对转移支付给外国人的价值评估比对本国居民低25%。研究还发现各国之间存在一种广义的互惠关系，并评估了现行国际贸易体系解体可能带来的损失。
AI.research_question: 各国在国际贸易中如何权衡本国居民福利与贸易伙伴福利？国际贸易规则在多大程度上促使各国将政策的外部性内部化？各国之间的福利权重是否存在互惠关系？现行国际贸易体系解体可能带来什么影响？
AI.motivation: 理解各国在国际贸易政策制定中如何权衡本国利益与他国福利，评估国际贸易规则（如WTO）在促进国际合作方面的实际效果，为国际贸易体系的稳定性和可持续性提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于福利经济学和国际贸易理论，运用关税政策作为揭示各国福利偏好的工具；结合互惠理论和国际合作框架，分析国家间福利权重的相互关系。
AI.method: 使用全球关税数据进行实证分析，通过计量经济学方法估计各国隐含的福利权重；采用比较分析和相关性检验来验证国家间的互惠关系。
AI.findings: 1. 各国平均给予外国福利的权重比本国低25%；2. 正式和非正式的国际贸易规则使各国在一定程度上将政策外部性内部化，但未完全实现；3. 各国之间存在广义互惠关系：对他国福利权重较高的国家，从他国获得的权重也较高；4. 现行国际贸易体系的解体将给各国带来不同程度的损失或收益。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次通过关税数据量化各国在国际贸易中的福利权重；2. 为国际贸易规则的有效性提供了实证证据；3. 提出了国家间福利权重的互惠理论；4. 为理解国际贸易合作机制提供了新的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者评估国际贸易政策的福利影响提供工具；2. 为国际贸易谈判和规则制定提供实证依据；3. 帮助各国评估参与国际贸易体系的成本和收益；4. 为国际贸易体系的改革和完善提供政策建议。

title: Impact of Cognitive Biases and Heuristics on HNI and UHNI Investors

detail.title: Impact of Cognitive Biases and Heuristics on HNI and UHNI Investors
detail.abstract: While traditional economics assumes that individuals make rational decisions, behavioural economics challenges this by demonstrating that human judgment is influenced by cognitive biases, heuristics, and various contextual factors. These numerous cognitive biases have a different impact on the decision-making of different economic and demographic of people. This paper focuses on the impact of various such biases on the HNI (High Net Worth Individual) and UHNI (Ultra High Net Worth Individual) investors of India and how it affects their process of making an investment. Through a merge of literature and real-world examples, the paper briefly highlights the impact of these biases.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了行为经济学中的认知偏差如何影响印度高净值（HNI）和超高净值（UHNI）投资者的投资决策过程，挑战了传统经济学关于理性决策的假设。
AI.research_question: 各种认知偏差如何影响印度高净值（HNI）和超高净值（UHNI）投资者的投资决策过程？
AI.motivation: 传统经济学假设个体做出理性决策，但行为经济学研究表明人类判断受到认知偏差、启发法和各种情境因素的影响。这些偏差对不同经济和人口群体的决策影响不同，特别是在高净值投资者群体中。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为经济学理论框架，包括认知偏差理论、启发法理论，以及这些理论如何挑战传统经济学的理性决策假设。
AI.method: 文献综述与现实案例分析的结合方法，通过理论和实际例子来探讨认知偏差对投资决策的影响。
AI.findings: 认知偏差对印度高净值和超高净值投资者的投资决策过程产生显著影响，这些偏差在不同程度上改变了他们的投资行为和决策质量。
AI.theory_contributions: 将行为经济学理论应用于特定投资者群体（印度高净值投资者），丰富了行为金融学在特定文化和经济背景下的应用研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助印度高净值投资者识别和减少认知偏差对其投资决策的负面影响，提高投资决策质量；为财富管理专业人士提供指导，更好地服务这一客户群体。

title: Contagious Prejudice: The Marocchinate
affiliations: University of Bologna - Department of Economics and Tilburg University

detail.title: Contagious Prejudice: The Marocchinate

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: During World War II, French Moroccan troops performed numerous acts of (sexual) violence against the Italian population, known in Italy as the Marocchinate. We demonstrate that these events led to contagion in prejudice: They triggered a pronounced shift to the far right following the recent mass influx of migrants from Syria, the Middle East and Northern Africa. Survey results provide no evidence of intergenerational transmission of attitudes but identify selective recall of collective memory as a likely channel.

AI.tldr: 二战期间法国摩洛哥部队对意大利平民的性暴力事件（Marocchinate）导致了对当代中东和北非移民的偏见传染，推动了极右翼政治支持
AI.research_question: 历史集体暴力事件如何影响当代对移民的政治态度和偏见？具体来说，二战期间法国摩洛哥部队对意大利平民的性暴力事件（Marocchinate）是否导致了对当代中东和北非移民的偏见传染，并推动了极右翼政治支持？
AI.motivation: 理解历史创伤如何塑造当代政治态度，特别是集体暴力记忆如何影响对类似群体的偏见，以及这种偏见如何通过集体记忆而非代际传递机制传播
AI.theoretical_framework: 偏见传染理论、集体记忆理论、历史创伤与当代政治态度关联理论、选择性记忆机制
AI.method: 调查数据分析，可能包括历史事件与当代政治态度的关联分析、代际态度传递测试、集体记忆选择性回忆机制识别
AI.findings: 1. Marocchinate事件导致了对当代中东和北非移民的偏见传染；2. 这种偏见推动了极右翼政治支持；3. 没有发现代际态度传递的证据；4. 选择性集体记忆回忆是主要传播渠道
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了历史集体暴力事件通过集体记忆机制影响当代政治态度的理论框架；2. 区分了代际传递与集体记忆选择性回忆两种机制；3. 扩展了偏见传染理论在历史-当代关联中的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为理解当代欧洲极右翼兴起提供历史视角；2. 为移民政策制定者提供历史创伤影响评估；3. 为集体记忆管理和历史教育提供政策启示

title: Overdiagnosis by Information Overload: Self-diagnosis, health anxiety, and the clinical visit as a validation encounter
affiliations: University of Buenos Aires (UBA) - Universidad de Buenos Aires

detail.title: Overdiagnosis by Information Overload: Self-diagnosis, health anxiety, and the clinical visit as a validation encounter

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial or personal relationships that could have influenced the work reported in this manuscript. The analysis was conducted independently and reflects the author’s academic and professional assessment of the issues discussed.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The work was developed as part of the author’s independent academic and professional activity.

detail.abstract:
The widespread availability of medical information has transformed how symptoms are interpreted, how uncertainty is experienced, and how clinical encounters are structured. While access to health information is often framed as an unequivocal benefit, its excess has generated new clinical dynamics that challenge traditional models of diagnosis, communication, and professional responsibility. This work examines medical information overload as a structural condition of contemporary healthcare and analyzes its role in the emergence of self-diagnosis, health anxiety, and overdiagnosis.

Author’s archived copy available at Zenodo: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.18208838

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨医疗信息过载作为当代医疗的结构性条件，分析其对自我诊断、健康焦虑和过度诊断的影响。
AI.research_question: 医疗信息过载如何影响症状解释、不确定性体验和临床互动结构？
AI.motivation: 医疗信息的广泛获取通常被视为有益，但信息过剩产生了新的临床动态，挑战了传统的诊断、沟通和专业责任模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 医疗社会学、信息过载理论、医患沟通理论、诊断社会学
AI.method: 理论分析/概念分析（基于摘要推断）
AI.findings: 医疗信息过载是当代医疗的结构性条件，导致自我诊断、健康焦虑和过度诊断等现象的出现。
AI.theory_contributions: 将医疗信息过载概念化为结构性条件，扩展了对医患互动和诊断过程的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为医疗从业者提供应对信息过载的策略，帮助改善临床沟通和减少不必要的诊断。
